plugins.description: 探索模式 · DeepSeek V4 Flash 专用 agent preset — 渠道无关命中、首轮工具面收窄、声明行交付
plugins.readme_text:
[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh.md)
# dsh-router-flash
## 实际效果 / Actual UI **预设选择器 / Preset Picker**
**首轮工具面 / First-turn Tool Face**
## In one line A model-agnostic agent preset for the dsh web GUI — matches on the model id alone, narrows the first turn's tool face, then gets out of the way. Built for DeepSeek V4 Flash, usable with any model. ## What it is A dsh **agent preset** delivered as a bundle patch layer. Installing the plugin declares one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row; restart dsh and 「探索模式」 appears in the preset picker. **Nothing is written to disk** — since DSH 0.2.0 the preset is a plugin row, not a directory. What it does: | Stage | Behaviour | |---|---| | **Match** | `isFlashModel(id) = /deepseek/i.test(id) && /flash/i.test(id)` — model- and channel-agnostic | | **Persona** | For Flash, always the weak branch (w7 guidance): classify, review, stay on topic, think deeply, close the loop | | **First turn** | Only `read` / `write` / `edit` plus the platform shell (`bash`, or `pwsh` on Windows) | | **After the first `tool/call`** | The full 29-row catalog opens and the router stops touching anything | The router hooks the `system-prompt/assemble` seam and rewrites the model catalog by turn. Mode derives from durable session events, so resume/reload keeps it. ## Model-agnostic by design This preset is the evolved branch of the earlier `dsh-router-flash` (v0.1.0, which was bound to a single provider's DeepSeek V4 Flash). The routing was rebuilt so the preset is **not tied to one vendor or model family**: - **Any channel** — the match is on the model id, not on who resells it. Any provider serving DeepSeek V4 Flash gets the same guidance. - **Any model** — models that do not match `isFlashModel` still use the preset through the generic branch: keyword classification of the first user message (build/fix) picks the routing. So `deepseek-v4-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash`, `qwen3-flash`, `gpt-5-flash` and others all work with 「探索模式」. - **One preset, many models** — the same declaration row serves every model; the router adapts per session instead of needing a preset per vendor. This is the extensibility gain: adding a new model or channel needs no preset change — only the model id and (for routing) the provider config. ## Match rule (model- and channel-agnostic) ``` isFlashModel(modelId) = /deepseek/i.test(modelId) && /flash/i.test(modelId) ``` | Model id | Match | Route | |---|---|---| | `deepseek-v4-flash` | yes | weak (w7 guidance — this preset's main path) | | `deepseek-v4-flash-0731`, `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` | yes | weak | | `deepseek-v4-pro`, `deepseek-chat` | no | keyword classification of the first user message (build/fix) | | `gemini-2.5-flash`, `qwen3-flash`, `gpt-5-flash` | no | same as above | **Why not match `flash` alone**: that would drag non-DeepSeek models (`gemini-2.5-flash`, `qwen3-flash`) into this preset's weak persona, which is a negative optimisation for them. Unmatched models can still use this preset — they just take the generic classification branch. **Why not bind to `opencode-go`**: a model's capability comes from the model, not from who resells it. Any channel's DeepSeek V4 Flash should get the same guidance; channel differences belong in the `provider` config, not the preset. ## Install Requires harness ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2; also running on 0.2.1-rc.1). ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/dsh-router-flash/main/install.sh | sh # restart DSH ``` Manual equivalent: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:taxueseek/dsh-router-flash#v0.4.1 # restart DSH ``` After the restart, the `router-flash` preset shows up in the preset picker under the display name 「探索模式」. Then point the model at **any channel's** DeepSeek V4 Flash — what goes in `provider` is your channel's business, and this preset makes no assumption about it (verified channels below). Model routing is configured in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` on the host's `dsh-agent-default-model` row, or picked directly in the GUI's model selector. Select 「探索模式」 in a new session. To make it the **default preset**, override the registry row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the preset's default comes from there): ```yaml - id: agent-preset-registry name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry' config: default: router-flash ``` > Since 0.2.0, `agent-presets.default` in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` no longer > exists. If you changed it following older docs, that setting is now neither > read nor reported — just delete it. ## Upgrade ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:taxueseek/dsh-router-flash#v0.4.1 ``` After a restart the declaration row is replaced with the patch layer; **there is no user directory to overwrite**. **The one step unique to 0.3.x → 0.4.0**: 0.3.x synced preset files into `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/router-flash/`, a directory that is no longer read on 0.2.0-rc.2 (see 「Version adaptation」). The plugin checks for it at startup and says so in the log; once you have confirmed the upgrade and restarted, you can delete it by hand — the plugin itself only does a read-only check and will not delete it for you. ## Uninstall ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-router-flash ``` After a restart the declaration row disappears with the patch layer and the preset roster no longer lists it. If a 0.3.x-era directory is still around, delete it manually. ## Usage 1. After installing, restart dsh and pick 「探索模式」 in a new session's preset picker. 2. Submit your task. The persona injects five anchors automatically — classification, review, staying on topic, deep thinking, closing the loop. **Note the exact behaviour**: for DeepSeek Flash the code does *not* classify the task type — it always takes the weak branch, and the classification is left to the model reading that line in the persona; `classifyTask()`'s keyword classification only serves non-Flash models. 3. After the session starts, the model's system prompt should contain: ``` You are a helpful assistant. Before acting, decide the task type (build or fix)... Before acting, briefly review what you have already done... Do not run environment checks (echo, whoami, uname...)... Think deeply about the architecture, edge cases... Produce when your information is complete... ``` ## Cross-platform support The preset is **platform-agnostic**; dsh picks the shell tool automatically: | OS | shell | Status | |---|---|---| | macOS | bash | measured (this round's verification environment) | | Linux | bash | not measured; same bash branch | | Windows | pwsh (PowerShell) | not measured; the `process.platform === 'win32'` check in `presets/router-flash.patch.yml` disables bash and enables pwsh automatically | > The core routing logic (persona / guidance / model detection) is > OS-independent. A missing shell is no longer fatal: the turn degrades to > file tools and logs a warning. ## Compatibility | dsh-router-flash | Harness | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | 0.4.1 | **0.2.1-rc.1 (current, running)** | Restores `time-context` + `tool-schedule`, aligns `plan-mode` wording, fixes an unreachable `FLASH_NEUTRAL` throw; composition drift 12/12 explained. | | 0.4.0 | 0.2.0-rc.2 (measured) | Breaking: preset delivered as a declaration row; no more disk sync. | | 0.3.1 | 0.1.5-rc.2 (historical) | Directory-form preset — **does not exist** on 0.2.0-rc.2. | Requires Node.js ≥ 22.19 (the floor this package is developed and tested on). plugins.description: Japanese (日本語) interface for the dsh-advisor settings page - a standalone DeepSeek Harness client plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-advisor-locale-ja [dsh-advisor](https://github.com/KnameSk/dsh-advisor) の **Advisor 設定画面を日本語化する**、独立した DSH プラグイン
## 概要 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）の **Advisor 設定画面**の文字列だけを日本語にします。 - **設定**・**相談予算**・**履歴**・**接続テスト**のタブと、その中にある項目名・説明・ボタン・エラー・確認メッセージを日本語化します。 - 翻訳がない項目は **英語でそのまま表示**されます（英語へのフォールバック）。 - **Advisor 本体とは独立**してインストール・アンインストールできます。 - **DSH 標準の言語設定に連動**します。DSH の言語が日本語のときだけ日本語で表示され、English や 中文 に戻せば元の表示に戻ります。 - **Advisor 本体の機能には一切影響しません。** このプラグインは翻訳の登録だけを行い、Advisor の設定値・相談処理・モデル呼び出しには触れません。 - 既存の翻訳辞書を壊したり上書きしたりしません。 ## 対応環境 - DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` - `dsh-advisor` `0.2.0` 以降 ## インストール GitHub から直接インストールできます。`` は実際に使用しているプロファイル名（`web` / `desktop` など）に置き換えてください。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:KnameSk/dsh-advisor-locale-ja ``` **配布物として受け取る場合は、バージョンをタグで固定してください。** `main` を指すインストールは後日の変更で中身が変わるため、再現性がありません。公開済みのタグは変更されません。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:KnameSk/dsh-advisor-locale-ja#v0.1.0 ``` アンインストールする場合は、次のコマンドを実行します。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile remove dsh-advisor-locale-ja ``` ## 使い方 1. DSH の **アカウントメニュー → Settings → General → Language**（**設定 → 一般 → 言語**）を開きます。 2. **日本語** を選びます。 3. **Settings → Advisor** を開くと、Advisor 設定画面が日本語で表示されます。 日本語を選ぶ手段は 2 通りあり、どちらでも動作します。 | 構成 | 日本語の選択肢を提供するもの | このプラグインの役割 | | --- | --- | --- | | `dsh-locale-ja` を併用 | [`@fang2hou/dsh-locale-ja`](https://github.com/fang2hou/dsh-locale-ja) | Advisor の辞書だけを追加 | | このプラグイン単体 | `dsh-advisor-locale-ja` | Advisor の辞書を追加し、**日本語の選択肢も追加** | `dsh-locale-ja` を併用する場合、このプラグインは **言語の定義を再登録しません**。言語の定義は `dsh-locale-ja` が所有し、このプラグインは Advisor の辞書だけを担当します。これにより、どちらのプラグインを先に読み込んでも衝突しません。 ## 翻訳の範囲 | 対象 | 翻訳 | | --- | --- | | Advisor 設定画面（`settings.advisor` 名前空間） | する | | DSH 全体の UI | しない | | Advisor の設定値・動作 | しない（文字列のみ） | `Advisor`・`Executor`・`Provider`・`block-tool`・`provider/model`・`/advisor`・`API`・`JSON`・`USD` などの識別子は、原文のまま表示します。 ## フォントについて このプラグインは **フォントを変更しません**。日本語表示用のシステムフォントは、言語パックである `dsh-locale-ja` が担当します。将来的に DSH 側でフォントが改善された場合に、古いフォント指定を上書きし続けないための判断です。 ## 開発 ```bash npm run check # 構文チェック + バンドルの鮮度 + manifest の整合性 npm test # ロケールサービス契約に対する検証 npm run build # dsh/client.js を再生成 ``` `dsh/client.js` は `scripts/build-client.mjs` が生成する成果物です。**手で編集しないでください。** ソースを変更したら `npm run build` を実行し、生成物もコミットします。`npm run check` はバンドルが古い場合に失敗します。 公開・タグ付け・タグ付きインストールの検証手順は [docs/RELEASING.md](./docs/RELEASING.md) にあります。公開済みバージョンは不変として扱います。 ### 構成 | パス | 役割 | | --- | --- | | `dsh/client.js` | DSH が配信するブラウザー用バンドル（生成物） | | `dsh/client/index.js` | クライアント側の入口。`locale` を inject して翻訳を登録 | | `dsh/client/japanese.js` | 言語と辞書の登録。衝突を避ける調停処理 | | `dsh/client/constants.js` | 名前空間と言語 ID | | `dsh/client/locale/ja.js` | 日本語辞書（169 項目） | | `dsh/index.js` | ホスト側の入口（Loader 行として登録するだけ） | | `cordis.patch.yml` | プラグインを有効化するパッチ | ## ライセンス [MIT](./LICENSE) ## 謝辞 このプラグインは、日本語化プラグイン [`@fang2hou/dsh-locale-ja`](https://github.com/fang2hou/dsh-locale-ja)（MIT、Copyright (c) 2026 fang2hou）が確立した **DSH Locale サービスへの登録方式**（`ctx.locale.addLanguage` と `ctx.locale.register` を `ctx.effect` で所有する構成、ホスト側を空の `apply` にして Loader 行として登録する構成、`dsh.client` で `immediately` と `inject` を宣言する構成）を手本にしています。ライセンス条件に従い、原作者に感謝します。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: restyles the conversation scrollbar to match the Visual Studio Code editor (14px, flat translucent thumb, light and dark themes).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vscode-scrollbar

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that gives the conversation the **Visual Studio Code** editor chrome:

- the **VS Code scrollbar** — a 14px always-visible bar with a flat, translucent thumb that darkens on
  hover and lightens while you drag it, and
- the **VS Code minimap** — a scaled-down preview column on the right that shows the whole
  conversation, with a viewport slider you can drag or click to navigate.

The stock Harness scrollbar is a 5px, rounded, overlay-style bar and the conversation has no minimap
at all. This plugin changes only the conversation's scroll column; every other scrollbar in the app
(menus, code blocks, sidebars, the composer) keeps the stock look.

## What changes

**Scrollbar**

| Property | Harness default | With this plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Track width | 5px | 14px |
| Track background | transparent | transparent |
| Thumb shape | pill (`border-radius:999px`, inset border) | flat rectangle, no radius |
| Thumb — light theme | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(100,100,100,.4)` (`#64646466`) |
| Thumb — dark theme | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(121,121,121,.4)` (`#79797966`) |
| Hover | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(100,100,100,.7)` (`#646464B3`) |
| Dragging (active) | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(191,191,191,.4)` (`#BFBFBF66`) |
| Scrollbar buttons | none | none |

These are VS Code's own defaults (`scrollbarSlider.*` in its light and dark themes;
`editor.scrollbar.verticalScrollbarSize` = 14). Dark mode is read from the
`body[data-ds-dark-theme]` attribute that the Harness theme service sets, so the colors follow the
active palette exactly like VS Code does — no plugin-wide color override, no second theme system.

**Minimap**

| Property | Harness default | With this plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Preview column | none | 80px column flush against the scrollbar, capped at half the window height |
| Content | none | snapshot of the whole conversation, scaled into the column; images are painted, heavyweight media (video/canvas/SVG/forms) is dropped |
| Viewport slider | none | VS Code `minimapSlider`: square translucent band, visible only while hovering the minimap or dragging |
| Checkpoint rail | right-aligned at the edge, hidden under the preview | parked 110px from the right edge, left of the column and fully visible |
| Click | n/a | jumps the conversation to that point and keeps dragging from there |
| Drag / wheel | n/a | drag scrubs the conversation, the wheel scrolls it |
| "加载更早" pages | collapsed behind a button | expanded automatically, so older turns are never folded away |
| Minimum pane width | n/a | 1180px — below that the column hides instead of covering text |

## Behaviour

- The minimap only appears when there is spare room. The chat column is capped at 920px, so on wide
  windows the preview sits in the empty right margin; on a narrow window it hides rather than covering
  the messages. It also stays hidden while the conversation is shorter than the viewport.
- The column is flush against the scrollbar and capped at half the window height. Inside that column
  the whole conversation is mapped 1:1 through the preview scale, so the slider marks the exact
  preview slice the viewport is showing. (VS Code itself uses the full editor height; the cap is this
  plugin's only deliberate deviation from it.)
- The slider is VS Code's `minimapSlider`: a square translucent band in the scrollbar-slider colors
  that only appears while the pointer is over the minimap or while dragging (`showSlider: mouseover`).
  Its size and offset come from the conversation's own numbers (`viewportHeight * scaleY`,
  `scrollTop * scaleY`), never from the native scrollbar thumb.
- Clicking anywhere in the minimap centres the viewport on that line and then keeps the same gesture
  as a drag, so press-and-drag scrubs continuously. The wheel over the minimap scrolls the
  conversation, as it does over VS Code's minimap.
- Harness's turn-navigation rail (the short checkpoint bars on the right edge) keeps its stock position
  until the preview appears, then moves out of the column's way and stays clickable.
- Harness paginates old turns behind a "加载更早" / "Load earlier" button. The plugin clicks it as soon
  as it renders (paced while the button is in its disabled "加载中" state, capped at 500 pages), so the
  conversation is not folded into that bucket. This cannot be turned off without disabling the plugin.
- The preview refreshes after new content settles, debounced by 350 ms, so a streaming answer does not
  rebuild the clone on every token. Scrolling is rAF-throttled.
- It is read-only: interactions pass through the preview, and the clone has its ids, SVG, canvas, video,
  form controls and running animations removed, so it stays cheap and cannot interfere with the real
  conversation.

## Install / 安装

Install from GitHub into the profile you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:azkbzxf/dsh-vscode-scrollbar
```

Or install a local checkout through the plugin manager tool:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "D:\\path\\to\\dsh-vscode-scrollbar" }
```

A newly added bundle activates on the running instance: the Host row is live immediately and the
Client half hot-loads into the open page. Replacing an already-installed copy needs the page to be
reloaded (or DSH restarted) before the fresh client build is used.

Remove it again with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-vscode-scrollbar
```

## How it works

The conversation scroll container ships no stable class name — its classes are CSS-module hashes
(`_727C8a_scrollBody`) that change between builds. It does ship a stable DOM contract, though: every
conversation body renders as a `[data-slot="conversation.session"]` element, and the shared shell
itself styles that relationship (its composer-overlay rules already use
`[data-slot="conversation.session"]`). Both halves start from that anchor.

**Scrollbar**

1. find each `[data-slot="conversation.session"]` anchor,
2. walk up to the nearest ancestor whose computed `overflow-y` is `auto`/`scroll` — that is the chat
   scroll container,
3. tag it with `data-dsh-vscode-scrollbar`, and
4. let a scoped stylesheet own `::-webkit-scrollbar*` for the tagged element only.

The stylesheet also carries a `:has(> [data-slot="conversation.session"])` selector branch, so the
bar renders correctly even before the marker is applied.

**Minimap**

1. A fixed-position layer is appended to `document.body` and placed from the scroll container's
   `getBoundingClientRect()`: flush against the 14px bar (`right - scrollbarWidth - 80px`), with the
   container's top, the container's width, and a height capped at half the window (or the container
   height when that is shorter). It is `z-index:30`, read-only and never takes layout space. While it
   is shown, a stylesheet rule parks Harness's turn-navigation rail (`nav[aria-label="轮次导航"]`) at
   `right:110px`, clear of the 80px column; with the column hidden the rail returns to its stock
   `right:12px`.
2. The chat column is measured on the **live** tree: every message row is a `[data-chat-flow-kind]`
   flex child of a column capped at `max-width: var(--dsh-chat-content-width)` and centred, so a
   rendered row reports the column width exactly. Measuring the clone instead would be wrong — the
   clone is detached from the ancestors that publish that CSS variable, so its rows reflow to the
   full pane width.
3. The anchor is cloned, sanitized in one tree walk, and given its own layout box: slot anchors render
   with `display: contents` (the outlet wrapper takes no box), so the clone is forced to
   `display: block`, sized from the pane's content width, and handed the measured column width as
   `--dsh-chat-content-width`. It is appended untransformed first, because the natural height is what
   the preview is fitted to.
4. The clone is transformed with `scale(sx, sy) translate(-columnLeft, 0)`: `sx = 80px / columnWidth`
   and `sy = columnHeight / naturalHeight`, so the whole conversation fills the (capped) column the way
   VS Code's minimap fits a file into its column. Images stay painted (a chat minimap with empty holes

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - # DSH Spark Insights

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that reads [spark](https://github.com/lucko/spark) performance exports from Minecraft servers and gives the agent two read-only tools for performance analysis.

## Features

- Parses spark protobuf exports:
  - `.sparkprofile` — execution, allocation, and lock sampler data
  - `.sparkheap` — heap summaries
  - raw spark health data (reports platform statistics only)
  - gzip-wrapped exports
  - legacy spark data with nested `children` / `time` fields
- Schema-generated decoder for current spark fields, with a hand-written
  fallback for legacy layouts
- Performance overview: platform/version, TPS, MSPT, CPU, heap/non-heap memory, GC, disk, players, uptime, world counts
- Sampler analysis:
  - thread-group totals with a wait / ≈on-CPU split (kernel-wait frames excluded), merge counts, and top-frame attribution
  - top methods by self and inclusive time
  - searchable call tree
  - per-window hotspots when the profile has per-window stack times
  - tick-window TPS / MSPT / CPU / entities / chunks, with a CPU-use fallback ordering when the platform records no tick statistics
  - plugin/mod source attribution
- Time-series metrics, plugin/mod metadata, world details, memory pools, network interfaces, and ping
- Heap analysis by class size or instance count
- Automatic Mojang mappings for obfuscated profiles (see [Mappings](#mappings))
- Results are cached per file version (two files), and no file contents leave the machine.

## Supported platforms

Any platform that produces spark's common protobuf format works: Paper, Spigot, Fabric, NeoForge, proxies, and the extra-platform builds.

### Nukkit

[spark-nukkit](https://github.com/lucko/spark-extra-platforms/tree/main/spark-nukkit) uses `spark-common`, so its `.sparkprofile` and `.sparkheap` files are the same format and need no conversion.

The Nukkit build currently does not implement tick hooks/reporters, so its exports have **no TPS/MSPT and no tick counts**; window statistics fall back to fixed time buckets that carry CPU use, and the tool orders and labels them accordingly. CPU, memory, GC, threads, stack hotspots, inclusive time, source attribution, and heap summaries still work. The report explicitly notes the missing tick statistics.

## Collect data

On the server:

```text
/spark profiler stop --save-to-file
/spark heapsummary --save-to-file
```

This creates a `.sparkprofile` (in `plugins/spark/` on Nukkit; the plugin data directory on other platforms) or a `.sparkheap` file.

## Tools

### `spark_analyze`

Returns a performance overview: metadata, performance snapshot, metric trends, plugins/mods, world and system details, thread totals, hotspots, worst tick windows, plugin attribution, and heap information.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `file_path` | spark export path; relative paths use the session working directory |
| `mappings_path` | optional Mojang ProGuard mappings file (see [Mappings](#mappings)) |
| `thread` | optional thread group name or substring; defaults to the server main thread ("Server thread", "main", …), else the thread with the most on-CPU time (kernel waits excluded) |
| `limit` | hotspot rows, 1–50, default 10 |

### `spark_query`

| `view` | Result |
|---|---|
| `methods` | methods sorted by self or inclusive time; supports `query` |
| `threads` | all thread groups, sorted by on-CPU time (kernel waits excluded) |
| `tree` | call tree; `query` locates a class/method, `depth` controls levels below a match, `limit` raises the line budget (default 120, max 300) |
| `windows` | tick windows; `sort=time` or `sort=worst` (worst falls back from MSPT to TPS to CPU process use when tick statistics are missing) |
| `sources` | plugin/mod source attribution |
| `metrics` | spark metric series (TPS, MSPT, CPU, memory, allocation, world, ping) |
| `plugins` | plugin/mod name, version, author, builtin flag |
| `world` | entity types, worlds, chunks, game rules, data packs |
| `system` | CPU, heap, memory pools, network interfaces, OS/Java/JVM, ping |
| `heap` | heap classes; `sort=size` or `sort=instances` |

`spark_query` accepts the same `file_path` and optional `mappings_path` as
`spark_analyze` (see [Mappings](#mappings)), plus `view`, `query`, `window`,
`depth`, `sort`, and `limit` as listed above.

`methods`, `tree`, and `sources` accept `window` (1-based tick-window index) to
analyze only that window when the profile contains per-window stack times.

Examples:

```text
spark_analyze(file_path: "profile.sparkprofile")
spark_query(file_path: "profile.sparkprofile", view: "methods", sort: "total", limit: 20)
spark_query(file_path: "profile.sparkprofile", view: "methods", window: 3, limit: 20)
spark_query(file_path: "profile.sparkprofile", view: "tree", query: "tickChunk", depth: 5)
spark_query(file_path: "profile.sparkprofile", view: "sources", limit: 10)
spark_query(file_path: "profile.sparkprofile", view: "metrics")
spark_query(file_path: "profile.sparkprofile", view: "plugins", limit: 50)
spark_query(file_path: "profile.sparkprofile", view: "world")
spark_query(file_path: "profile.sparkprofile", view: "system")
spark_query(file_path: "heap.sparkheap", view: "heap", sort: "instances")
```

## Mappings

Profiles whose sampled frames still use ProGuard-obfuscated names (typically a
vanilla server; e.g. `agh.a`) are remapped to Mojang's official names
automatically — in hotspots, the call tree, source attribution, and heap
tables. Frames that already use readable class names (Paper, Spigot,
Forge/NeoForge, Fabric, proxies) are detected from the frames themselves, so
they never trigger a version-cache lookup or download; a co-located mapping
file is still honored when the platform itself is not skipped outright.
Resolution order:

1. an explicit `mappings_path` argument pointing at a ProGuard mapping file
   (Mojang's `server.txt` / `client.txt` for the matching version);
2. a sibling file next to the export: `<export>.mappings`, `<export>.map`,
   `server.txt`, or `client.txt`;
3. the version cache at `~/.dsh/spark-insights-mappings/<version>.txt` —
   downloaded mappings are stored here, and you can also drop files in
   yourself (useful for air-gapped machines);
4. an automatic download from Mojang's piston-meta service for the profile's
   Minecraft version, written back to the cache so later lookups reuse it
   (two concurrent first-time lookups for the same version may both fetch).

Every mapping file is parsed and validated first: a file that is not a
ProGuard mapping (a stray `server.txt`, a JSON source map, a reversed mapping
file) is ignored — or reported when passed explicitly — instead of being
applied or blocking the cache/download.

Downloads share one 25-second budget, are validated before they are cached,
and a transient download failure is retried after a couple of minutes.

Notes:

- Platforms and exports that do not need Mojang mappings are skipped with an
  explanatory note: Paper/Purpur/Folia ≥ 1.20.5 already run official names at
  runtime, Fabric reports intermediary names (`class_1234`, needs a different
  mapping format), Nukkit is Bedrock, and any profile whose frames already look
  readable is skipped after a bounded sample. An explicit `mappings_path`
  overrides the skip.
- Downloads can be disabled with `SPARK_INSIGHTS_NO_NETWORK=1`; the cache
  directory can be moved with `SPARK_INSIGHTS_MAPPINGS_DIR`.
- Method resolution uses the frame's JVM descriptor to pick the right
  overload; `lambda$…` frames are rewritten too. When several overloads share

# dsh-response-model-label

DeepSeek Harness プラグイン: 各アシスタント回答のフッター（トークン数・所要時間の欄）に、生成元のプロバイダ / モデル名および reasoning level（思考強度）を表示します。

## 特徴

- **生成元モデル・Reasoning Level の正確な記録表示**: 回答生成時のイベントログ（`assistant/message` / `request/header`）に記録されたモデル名および `reasoningEffort`（`high`, `medium`, `low` 等）を読み取って表示します（例: `antigravity / gemini-3.8-flash (high)`）。モデルや設定を切り替えても過去の回答表示は変化しません。
- **推測・捏造の防止**: 記録が存在しない回答に対しては現在の選択状態から推測せず、記録がない旨を明示します。
- **自然なUI統合**: DSHのテーマデザイントークン（`--dsw-alias-label-tertiary`、フォントサイズ等）に準拠し、トークン消費数および完了時刻と同じメタデータ欄に並んで表示されます。
- **軽量・外部依存なし**: Cordis スロットおよび Trajectory スナップショットの標準APIのみを利用しており、余計な依存パッケージはありません。

## インストール

DSH のプラグインマネージャーからバンドルとしてインストールするか、プロファイル設定（`cordis.patch.yml`）に登録して使用します。

```yaml
- id: response-model-label
  name: 'dsh-response-model-label'
  disabled: false
```

## テスト

```bash
node test.mjs
```

plugins.description: In-process QQ official-bot bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QQ messages start or resume real DSH sessions inside the host and send the result back to QQ.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-qq-bridge

Bridge an official **QQ bot** to **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** — in-process.

A message in QQ starts (or resumes) a real DSH session **inside the host process**. The session shows up
in the desktop app's sidebar, can be opened and continued there, and the answer goes back to QQ as text,
image or file. QQ is just one more input/output for a normal DSH session.

## How it works

| | Separate bridge process | This plugin |
|---|---|---|
| Task execution | spawns `dsh --profile qq --json` | `ctx.agents.create()` / `resume()` inside the host |
| Where sessions live | only in that CLI profile | the host's own session store (visible in the GUI) |
| Permissions | env vars on the child process | per-session permission preset |
| Lifetime | you keep `start-bridge.cmd` running | lives as long as the DSH host |

The QQ protocol layer (token, gateway, passive-reply budget, chunking, workspaces, chat history) is shared
with the standalone bridge; only the execution side is different.

## Requirements

- A DSH host that provides the `agents`, `agentDefaultModel`, `agentPresets`, `permissionPresets`,
  `sessionTitle` and `workspaceRegistry` services (the desktop app does).
- A QQ official bot application (AppID + AppSecret) with the message intents you plan to use enabled
  (C2C, group @-message, …) on the QQ open platform.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin add github:tbb051122/dsh-plugin-qq-bridge
```

Then **restart the DSH host** — host-side plugin code is only loaded at startup.

## Configure

Config lives at `<DSH_HOME>/qq-bridge/config.json` (`~/.dsh/qq-bridge/config.json` by default).
Set `QQ_BRIDGE_HOME` to point the whole plugin at another directory (handy for testing).

A minimal config:

```json
{
  "appId": "your-app-id",
  "appSecret": "your-app-secret",
  "intents": 33554432,
  "defaultCwd": "",
  "allow": { "users": [], "groups": [] }
}
```

See [`config.example.json`](./config.example.json) for every key.

Keys that matter for the plugin:

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `appId`, `appSecret` | QQ bot credentials (from the QQ open platform). |
| `sandbox` | Use the QQ sandbox environment instead of production. |
| `intents` | Message subscription bitmask; `33554432` is C2C messages, add the group bit for group chats. |
| `defaultCwd` | Working directory for new sessions. Point it at a registered DSH workspace to have QQ sessions appear there; leave empty for an isolated directory per session. |
| `agentPreset` | Agent preset name; empty means the host default. |
| `permissionPreset` | `danger-full-access` (default, unattended), `workspace-write` or `read-only`. |
| `attachWorkspace` | When `defaultCwd` is a registered workspace, attach the session to it so the GUI shows it. |
| `allow.users` / `allow.groups` | OpenID allow-lists. Empty means "locked": use `/bind <code>` with `bindCode` to pair. |
| `maxConcurrent`, `queueLimit` | How many agent runs at once, how many conversations may queue. |
| `passiveWindowMs` | The passive-reply window QQ gives you after a user message. |
| `taskTimeoutMs` | Per-task timeout. |
| `selfTestOnBoot` | Run one end-to-end self test on first boot and post the result to QQ. |
| `titlePrefix` | Session title prefix (default `QQ`). |

## Commands (sent in QQ)

`/help`, `/id`, `/bind <code>`, `/new`, `/status`, `/stop`,
`/ws` (list workspaces), `/ws <name|index>`, `/ws 0` (back to the default directory),
`/history [n]`.

## Files

Everything the plugin writes lives under `<QQ_BRIDGE_HOME>` (default `<DSH_HOME>/qq-bridge`):

`config.json`, `state.json` (session map, allow-lists), `history/` (per session and workspace),
`workspaces/` (workspace link index), `tasks/` (default task root) and `logs/`.

## Security note

The default `permissionPreset` is `danger-full-access` so an unattended QQ task can actually do its job.
Set it to `workspace-write` or `read-only` if the bot is reachable by anyone you do not trust, and keep
`allow.users` limited to people you know.

## Development

```sh
node lib/cli.mjs --mock --once "hello"   # full pipeline with a fake runner and fake QQ
node lib/cli.mjs --selftest              # config / workspace / runner checks
```

Set `QQ_BRIDGE_HOME` to a scratch directory so the mock run does not touch real data.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 把 DSH 回答里的数学公式复制成可在 Obsidian / LaTeX 中重新渲染的 TeX：悬停公式复制、选中带公式的文本时还原源码。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-math-copy

[![ci](https://github.com/SOH4C4759/dsh-math-copy/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/SOH4C4759/dsh-math-copy/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

> 演示：[把 DSH 里的公式复制成能重新渲染的 TeX](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1vVn56pEqi)（24 秒实录，无配音）

把 DSH 回答里的数学公式，复制成 **能在 Obsidian / LaTeX 里重新渲染的 TeX**，而不是一堆字形。

回答里的公式是 KaTeX 画出来的：看得见、选得中，但 Ctrl+C 之后进剪贴板的是 `𝑒^𝑖𝜋+1=0` 这样的 Unicode 字形——粘进 Obsidian 只会得到一行怪符号。这个插件把公式还原成源码：

- **悬停任意公式** → 浮出一个小条，三个复制目标：
  - `Obsidian` → 行内 `$…$`，独立公式 `$$…$$`
  - `LaTeX` → 行内 `\(…\)`，独立公式 `\[…\]`
  - `TeX` → 只给源码，不带定界符（一次性，不改后续格式）
- **选中带公式的一段文本再 Ctrl+C** → 剪贴板里是这段文本，其中每个公式都被还原成源码（用你上次点的 `Obsidian` / `LaTeX` 目标），整段直接粘进 Obsidian 就能渲染。
- 选中里没有公式时，插件完全不插手，复制行为与原来一致。

## 为什么源码是准的

KaTeX 渲染时会在视觉标记旁边同时输出 MathML，里面带一个
`<annotation encoding="application/x-tex">`，内容就是模型写的那段 TeX 原文。
插件只读这个 annotation，不猜、不从字形反推：

- 拿不到 annotation 的公式（渲染失败、被裁掉的节点）不会出现复制条，选中路径也会跳过它；
- 支持多行环境（`\begin{aligned}…\end{aligned}` 原样保留）；
- 不修改对话 DOM，只往页面上追加自己的浮条和提示，卸载时全部移除。

上次用过的目标记在 `localStorage['dsh.math-copy.format']`，默认 `obsidian`。
`TeX` 按钮故意不写入这个记录：临时要源码，不该把「整段还原」也变成裸源码。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本仓库绝对路径>
```

也可以从 DSH 的插件页安装同一个路径。装好后 profile 里是这一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: math-copy
      name: dsh-math-copy
```

装完插件即可用。**改过 `lib/client.js` 之后要刷新页面**（浏览器端 bundle 是页面启动时
import 的）；改 Host 半边才需要重启 DSH。

## 开发与验证

```powershell
node build-client.mjs        # src/client.js -> lib/client.js（校验 loader shell）
node --check lib/client.js
node tools/verify-client.mjs # VM + stub DOM：剪贴板载荷、annotation 提取、apply 接线
node tools/harness-run.mjs   # 无头 Edge + CDP：真的把公式 DOM 建出来跑一遍
```

`node` 不在 PATH 上时用 DSH 自带那一份：

```powershell
& "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe" tools\harness-run.mjs
```

没有 Edge 时 harness 会打印 `SKIP` 与原因（不会被当成通过）。

| 路径 | 是什么 |
|---|---|
| `entry.js` | Host 半边，空的：复制公式是页面的事，不需要路由、进程或设置项。 |
| `src/client.js` | 真正的实现（悬停浮条、选区还原、剪贴板回退、提示）。 |
| `lib/client.js` | 构建产物，由 `build-client.mjs` 从源码复制并校验；CI 会验证它与源码一致。 |
| `tools/verify-client.mjs` | 在 VM 里跑纯逻辑：三种目标的剪贴板载荷、annotation 提取、`apply()` 的监听与两个空槽位消费者。 |
| `tools/harness.html` + `tools/harness-run.mjs` | 用真实 KaTeX 结构造出公式，在无头 Edge 里跑 20 条断言：浮条出现/定位/不自动关闭、四种载荷、选区还原（含「无公式不拦截」）、滚动收起。`--dump-dom` 在本机对 HTML 页面返回空，所以改用 CDP 读页面结果。 |
| `tools/serve.mjs` | 单独起一个静态服务调试 harness 用。 |

CI（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）跑语法检查、产物一致性、离线套件与浏览器 harness；
`.github/workflows/release.yml` 在 `v*` tag 或手动触发时打包 zip + npm tarball、在解包产物上
重跑离线套件，再发 Release。

## 已知边界

- 依赖 KaTeX 的 `.katex` / `.katex-display` 类名（KaTeX 自己的稳定契约），不依赖
  DSH 的 CSS Modules 哈希类名。
- 选区还原只在 `copy` 事件上生效；页面自己的「复制消息」按钮走
  `navigator.clipboard.writeText`，不经过这个事件——但它复制的是原始 markdown，
  本来就带 `$$`，不需要转换。
- 行内公式按 `$…$` 复制。源码里自带 `$` 的极端写法不做转义。
- 浮条靠悬停出现，纯键盘操作暂时取不到；需要的话可以再加一个消息级「复制全部公式」动作。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)。

# dsh-compound-memory

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-compound-memory.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-compound-memory)

English | [中文](#中文)

DeepSeek Harness bundle that launches the existing [compound-memory](https://pypi.org/project/compound-memory/) MCP server (`uvx --from compound-memory compound-memory-server`) and injects a short once-per-session usage reminder. It does not reimplement memory, it does not add a sixth MCP tool, and the server still has no LLM ([ADR-0001](https://github.com/chinwe/compound-memory)). This wrapper adds none. There are no install, lifecycle, or `postinstall` scripts.

`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` = `./cordis.patch.yml`. That file inserts two rows: the in-box [`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/mcp/mcp-client/README.md) row (`mcp-compound-memory`), and this package's own plugin (`compound-memory-rules` → `dsh-compound-memory` → `index.js`). Do not install that client yourself: DSH 0.2 already ships it, and a separately installed 0.1 client will not match ([discussion #8202](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8202)). This package declares no `@deepseek-ai/*` dependencies. The rules module does not import `@deepseek-ai/cordis` or the MCP client: Cordis calls `apply(ctx)`, and the [publish guide](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish) says to pin a peer only when the plugin must share that package's instance. `engines.dsh` is `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` so current 0.2 prereleases match and 0.3 prereleases do not ([publish guide](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish), [market index](https://www.dsh-remote.com/notes/implemented/feature/2026-10-02-plugin-market-index-format)).

| MCP tool | Name inside DSH |
|---|---|
| `memory_search` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_search` |
| `memory_get` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_get` |
| `memory_write` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_write` |
| `memory_link` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_link` |
| `memory_feedback` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_feedback` |

`memory_search` returns an object whose `hits` field is an array.

## Install

Requires the [`dsh`](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/guide/) CLI and `uv` / `uvx` on the `PATH` of the process that starts `dsh`. The first `uvx` run needs network access to fetch `compound-memory` from PyPI. `uv` supplies the tool's Python; a system Python is not required.

Package version 0.1.3, published on npm as [`dsh-compound-memory`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-compound-memory):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-compound-memory
```

From GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:chinwe/dsh-compound-memory
```

From a checkout of this repository (the plugin root, not a subdirectory):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-compound-memory
```

Git install does not need `allowBuilds`: the package has no `prepare` script. Restart `dsh`. `dsh --profile web --dump-config` should show a `# == dsh-compound-memory` layer, the `mcp-compound-memory` row, and the `compound-memory-rules` row.

If the store does not exist yet:

```bash
uvx --from compound-memory compound-memory init
```

## Environment

Set these on the process that launches `dsh`. The patch reads them with `!!js` when config loads. Unset or blank uses the default. Nothing here is a secret. The stdio child starts from a scrubbed parent environment; configured `env` is merged on top.

| Variable | Default when unset or blank |
|---|---|
| `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` | `agent-dsh` |
| `COMPOUND_MEMORY_ROOT` | `$HOME/.agents/memory` (optional; the Python server expands a leading `$HOME` or `~`) |

`agent-dsh` is this host's stable id. Set `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` before starting `dsh` when this process should be a different host. A later patch layer replaces the whole `config`. To point `command` at an absolute `uvx`, restate the row in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (same fields: `serverName`, `transport`, `command`, `args`, `env`, `failOnStartupError`).

## Usage reminder

`compound-memory-rules` listens on `agent/pre-step` with `{ prepend: true }`. On the first eligible `enter` of a live agent (the decision is `enter` and the step signal is not aborted) it appends one user-role message. Later steps of that agent do not append it again. A new agent object whose session log already contains the reminder (resume, or this process restarted) does not get a second copy. The listener does not read the memory store and does not call a model (ADR-0001).

The message text is `RULES` in [`index.js`](index.js) (356 characters, under the 400-character Claude SessionStart budget). It states:

- `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` defaults to `agent-dsh` (overridable); pass that same id as `source` and `agent`
- `memory_search` before non-trivial work; `memory_feedback` after an adopted hit compounds the store
- in a repo, prefer project-scoped memories
- five MCP tools only, named `mcp__compound-memory__memory_*`; this package does not reimplement them

The source is `{ kind: 'plugin:dsh-compound-memory', form: 'instructions' }`, and the message has a fresh `id`. Session format v4 rejects the retired `{ kind: 'plugin', plugin }` wrapper and fails the whole turn ([discussion #8432](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8432)). `plugin:dsh-compound-memory` is the producer-owned kind the v3→v4 rewriter would derive for this package. A static `systemPrompt.section` was not required: pre-step accepts the message, and injecting once keeps it out of every later step.

### Disable the reminder

Stop only the reminder. In the profile patch (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`) or the home patch (`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`), add:

```yaml
- id: compound-memory-rules
  disabled: true
```

A later layer addresses the row by id. `disabled: true` stops that loader entry. `mcp-compound-memory` is a different id and still launches `uvx`. `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-compound-memory` removes both rows.

### Verify

`dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows both `mcp-compound-memory` and `compound-memory-rules` under `# == dsh-compound-memory`.

Start a new session and send one message. The transcript should contain one user-role reminder whose `source.kind` is `plugin:dsh-compound-memory` and whose text starts with `compound-memory:`. A later step in that same session should not add another copy. `node --test` in this repository checks the listener without booting DSH.

## Skill

Usage for the five tools is [`skills/compound-memory/SKILL.md`](skills/compound-memory/SKILL.md). The injected reminder is the short hard rules. The skill is still the long-form source, and copying it is still optional. On a non-trivial task, call `memory_search` first. After a hit is actually used, call `memory_feedback` with `agent` set to `agent-dsh` (or whatever `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` is). Write only stable facts.

DSH does not load that file from inside the npm package. The filesystem provider only sees direct children of a skill root (`<root>/<name>/SKILL.md`), not a nested `skills/` tree ([skills subsystem](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/subsystems/skills.md)). Copy or symlink the directory onto one of those roots, for example `~/.dsh/skills/compound-memory`. The reminder does not do that copy.

## 中文

这是 DeepSeek Harness 的 bundle，用 `uvx --from compound-memory compound-memory-server` 拉起 PyPI 上已有的 [compound-memory](https://pypi.org/project/compound-memory/) MCP server，并在每个会话第一次进入模型步骤时注入一段短的使用提醒。不在 JS 里重写记忆，不增加第 6 个 MCP tool。server 内没有 LLM（[ADR-0001](https://github.com/chinwe/compound-memory)），这个 wrapper 也不加。没有 install、lifecycle 或 `postinstall` 脚本。

根上的 `package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch` = `./cordis.patch.yml`，插入两行：宿主自带的 [`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/mcp/mcp-client/README.md)（`mcp-compound-memory`），以及本包自己的插件（`compound-memory-rules` → `dsh-compound-memory` → `index.js`）。不要单独安装这个 client：DSH 0.2 已经带了匹配版本，另装 0.1 会对

plugins.description: A scholarly journal-desk skin for DeepSeek Harness: Nature, Science, IEEE and Elsevier covers, manuscript stages, and an editorial letter behind the conversation.
plugins.readme_text:
# Paper Skin · Journal Desk

A quiet, scholarly skin for **DeepSeek Harness**. Choose the paper you are publishing today — *Nature*, *Science*, *IEEE* or *Elsevier* — set the manuscript stage, and a professional editorial letter settles behind the conversation.

> A typographic homage only. This project is not affiliated with Nature, Science, AAAS, IEEE or Elsevier.

![Paper Skin in DeepSeek Harness](docs/preview-nature.webp)

## What it does

- **Journal masthead.** The sidebar becomes a deep cover-coloured spine with a typographic wordmark, a circular cover thumbnail, a journal descriptor and a slim colophon showing volume and stage.
- **Four covers.** Pick a journal from the small journal-cover button beside Harness **Settings**. The lower-left sidebar carries a slim colophon instead of a bulky journal switcher.
- **Manuscript progress.** Choose the stage in the same skin panel:
  - **初审 · With Editor** — initial editorial assessment
  - **中期 · Under Review** — peer review
  - **大修 · Major Revision** — revise and resubmit
  - **小修 · Minor Revision** — minor revision anticipated
  - **录用 · Accepted** — formal letter of acceptance
  - **见刊 · Published** — final article online
- **A professional letter, behind the conversation.** The selected stage renders a letter as the conversation background: a large stage word, editorial-office wording, manuscript number, date and a circular seal. It is a real CSS background layer, not a composer banner. Its visibility is adjustable from **5% to 80%**, and its colour can follow the manuscript stage or be set from a palette or the custom colour picker.
- **Journal artwork.** All four covers use the artwork in `assets/`: the Nature, Science and IEEE covers, and the Elsevier tree plus wordmark. The same artwork appears in the small journal button, the hero seal and the sidebar mark.
- **Visible paper grain.** A laid-paper texture runs across the conversation, composer, settings panel and sidebar, and can be switched off entirely.
- **Light & dark.** Paper, cover ink and watermark adapt to the Harness colour scheme.
- **Local only.** Choices live in this browser’s `localStorage` under `dsh.paper-skin.v1`. The skin makes no external network requests and collects no data.

![Paper Skin settings panel](docs/preview-panel.webp)

## Use

After installation, reload the page once.

1. The small journal-cover button sits beside Harness **Settings** at the lower left.
2. Click it to choose a journal and a manuscript stage.
3. The sidebar, cover colour, typography and the editorial letter behind the conversation change together.
4. `Accepted` uses a formal letter of acceptance; every other stage uses the corresponding editorial-office language.

The floating quick-settings pattern takes after [open-sea-skin](https://github.com/d-dev0101/open-sea-skin); the panel and skin here are an independent implementation. `open-sea-skin` is not required.

## Install

Paper Skin is a self-contained DeepSeek Harness bundle: one Host row (`paper-skin`), one Web client module, and a read-only local asset route. There are no runtime dependencies and no build step.

### From GitHub

Install the tagged release straight from the public repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:1552421144-cloud/paper-skin#v1.0.0
```

Or open Harness **Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin**, paste the same `github:...` spec, install, then enable **Paper Skin · Journal Desk**.

### From a release tarball

Download `paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz` from the [release page](https://github.com/1552421144-cloud/paper-skin/releases), then install it into the same profile that runs Harness:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz
```

For the macOS Desktop app, the bundled CLI is:

```sh
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz
```

Restart Harness, reload the page once, then open **Plugins** and confirm **Paper Skin · Journal Desk** is enabled. The bundle row is `paper-skin`.

### From npm

Once the package is published to npm, install an exact version:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add paper-skin@1.0.0
```

Or open Harness **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `paper-skin@1.0.0`, install, and enable **Paper Skin · Journal Desk**.

### From a checkout

For development against a working copy:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/to/paper-skin"
```

## Uninstall

Remove **Paper Skin** in **Plugins**, or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove paper-skin
```

Unloading removes the CSS, root attributes, background watermark and every slot entry. The localStorage key remains until cleared.

## Compatibility

Verified against DeepSeek Harness Desktop **0.2.1-rc.2** on macOS. The client half uses the standard Web slots listed below, so it also works in a `dsh web` profile that has the same client packages. It does not modify the Harness checkout.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js` | Browser skin: React slots, covers, stage letters, colour and opacity controls, CSS and the settings panel. |
| `index.js` | Host half; serves the cover artwork from `assets/`. It registers no tools, model context or session routes. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch inserting the `paper-skin` row. |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin-manager metadata (English and Chinese). |
| `icon.svg` | Original journal-cover icon. |
| `assets/*` | Optimised Nature/Science/IEEE covers, the Elsevier cover, and the transparent Elsevier tree mark. |
| `docs/*.webp` | Screenshots used by this README. |
| `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` | Trademark and artwork attribution. |

## Slots

- `sidebar.brand.mark`, `sidebar.brand.name`
- `sidebar.footer.action` (slim colophon, not a switcher)
- `conversation.hero.brand.mark`
- `shell.overlay` (the only journal/stage switcher)

The conversation letter is a CSS background on the transcript surface; it adds no transcript rows. Cover artwork is served locally by the Host half from `assets/`. No app-root replacement, no external network requests.

## Packaging a release

```sh
npm pack
```

The resulting `paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz` contains only the runtime files, locales, icon, artwork, screenshots and documentation. The repository and release are at [1552421144-cloud/paper-skin](https://github.com/1552421144-cloud/paper-skin). Publishing to npm is optional and would allow installation by package name:

```sh
npm publish
```

## Licence

MIT for the plugin code. Journal and publisher names and the cover artwork are used descriptively; they are not official endorsements, and the artwork is not covered by the MIT licence. See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). All trademarks remain with their owners.
