plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: Prompt suggestions for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the model predicts your next message and shows it as ghost text in the composer — press → to accept. 输入框幽灵文字预测你的下一句，按 → 接受。
plugins.readme_text:
**中文** | [English](./README.en.md)

# dsh-ghost-prompt

给 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 加上「预测下一句」：每轮对话结束后，模型猜你接下来想说什么，以灰色幽灵文字显示在输入框里——按 **→** 接受、变成真正的输入；直接打字则忽略。类似 Claude Code / Codex 的 prompt suggestion。

## 功能

- 每轮正常结束（`turn/end` 为 `completed`）后自动预测；出错、取消、子代理会话不预测。
- 输入框为空时显示幽灵文字，按 → 填入输入框（光标放到末尾，可继续编辑后再发送）。
- 只要你在这一轮里自己打过字，这一轮的预测就不再出现。
- 可选择预测模型（默认跟随当前会话的模型），可一键开关——都在侧边栏「插件」→「输入预测」页面里。
- 界面中英双语，跟随「设置 → 通用 → 语言」切换；测速用的示例对话也跟着换语言。
- 只在有浏览器界面看着的时候才发起预测：headless、定时任务、goal 轮次不会多花 token。同一会话开多个标签页只调用一次模型。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ghost-prompt
# 本地开发版：clone 仓库后，在仓库根目录执行
dsh plugin --profile web add link:.
```

然后把 `dsh-ghost-prompt` 加到 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`（`dsh plugin add` 通常会自动处理）。

## 配置

界面里改即可；也可以写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: next-prompt
  config:
    enabled: true          # 总开关
    provider: ''           # 留空 = 跟随会话模型；填你在 dsh 里配好的 provider id（provider 和 model 需同时设置）
    model: ''              # 预测用的模型 id，同样留空则跟随会话
    maxContextChars: 8000  # 送给预测模型的最近对话上限，越小越快
    maxOutputTokens: 512
    timeoutMs: 30000
```

## 实现说明

- **Host 端**（`src/index.ts`）：注册 `POST /api/next-prompt/suggest`（NDJSON 流式）和 `GET /api/next-prompt/models`。轮次的最后一条回复（不含工具调用）一落地就开始预测，不等 `turn/end`，也不等浏览器来请求——只对最近 30 分钟内有浏览器看过的会话这么做。模型推理强度优先选 off/minimal，第一行写完立即中断调用。
- **浏览器端**（`src/client.tsx`）：在 `conversation.input.overlay` 槽里挂一个组件，轮次结束时接入 Host 的预测流，幽灵文字逐字出现；幽灵文字用 portal 渲染在编辑器的定位容器里，并沿用原占位符的 class，所以位置和字体与占位符完全一致；→ 键在输入框外层用 capture 拦截，只在幽灵文字可见时生效。设置卡片挂在 `plugins.bundle.config`，通过 `configForms` 读写。
- **多语言**：界面文案的 zh / en 字典注册进 dsh 的 `locale` 服务（命名空间 `next-prompt`），语言包插件可以覆盖或补充；没有该服务时按浏览器语言在本地翻译。插件列表里的标题和简介来自 `locale/{en,zh}.json` 的 `meta`，Host 端 Config 的字段说明用 schemastery 的 `.i18n()` 提供 en / zh 两份。

## 构建

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build
```

plugins.description: A music dock for the DSH Web GUI: draggable bottom-right player, live blue-white spectrum, drag-and-drop local audio, Bilibili / NetEase Cloud Music / QQ Music playlist links, and seven bundled CC0 soundscapes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-music-on

DSH Web 界面右下角的音乐台。一枚可拖动的胶囊常驻在那里，点开是播放卡片：拖入本地音频即播、
粘贴 B 站 / 网易云音乐 / QQ 音乐的歌单链接自动解析入队、页面底部跟着一条蓝白频谱，
另有七个内置音景（白噪音、雨声、咖啡馆、深夜酒吧、鼓点、爵士、Lo-Fi）开箱即听。

- **不修改宿主任何文件**：只走宿主公开的扩展点（槽位 / 服务 / 路由）。
- **浏览器半边零转译**：宿主对插件客户端代码是零转译静态投递，所以全部用 `react.createElement`，不许 JSX 语法。
- **诚实降级**：拿不到直链的曲目（会员 / 版权限制）直接跳过，不伪造一个播不了的条目。

## 功能

- **播放**：队列、上一首 / 下一首、进度条拖动、音量旋钮（悬停滚轮可调）、三种循环模式、切歌淡入淡出。
- **拖入本地音频**：文件拖到卡片上即入队播放，支持 mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a / flac / aac / opus / webm。
- **粘贴链接**：B 站视频、网易云歌单 / 单曲、QQ 音乐歌单 / 单曲、直链音频；一次可粘多条，混着也行。
- **内置音景**：卡片里「音景」一排，点开是七条自带 WAV 的 chip（白噪音 / 雨声 / 咖啡馆 / 鼓点循环 / 爵士钢琴 / Lo-Fi / 深夜酒吧），点一条立即无缝循环，不起任何外部请求。
- **频谱**：圆点 / 粗柱 / 折线 / 波形四种画法，可调柱数、增益、光晕、高度、帧率、贴底通栏或嵌在卡片里。
- **封面**：内置曲目读预置封面，平台曲目读该曲自己的专辑封面，B 站曲目读视频封面。
- **设置页**：`设置 → 音乐台`，界面 / 播放 / 频谱 / 网络与缓存 / 收藏与历史五组。
- **收藏与历史**：设置页里两张表，收藏与最近播放的链接可一键回放。

## 安装

```pwsh
# 从 GitHub 装（首次会要求授权构建，按提示在 profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 里加 allowBuilds）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lilcandi/dsh-music-on
```

装上后刷新浏览器（`Ctrl+F5`）即可，右下角应出现音乐胶囊。

### 从本地路径装

```pwsh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:J:/plugin/dsh-music-on
```

### 手工挂载

1. 编辑 profile 的 `package.json`（例如 `C:\Users\candi\.dsh\profiles\web\package.json`）：

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-music-on": "file:J:/plugin/dsh-music-on"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["dsh-music-on"]
    }
  }
}
```

2. 在 profile 目录下执行 `pnpm install`。

> ⚠️ **只写 `cordis.patch.yml` 而不把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，插件不会被挂载。**
> 这是本机踩过的坑：patch 一个从未被 insert 的 entry 不会让插件启动，日志里连一行报错都没有。

### 验证装载

```pwsh
# 宿主半边是否被 Loader 认到（能看到 index.js 被读走）
Get-Content C:\Users\candi\.dsh\logs\*.log -Tail 50 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Select-String 'dsh-music-on'

# 浏览器半边是否被拼进 combo（换掉 rev 也行，看 200 / 内容）
Invoke-WebRequest 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/??dsh-music-on/client.js&rev=0' |
  Select-Object StatusCode
```

装载成功后，右下角会出现音乐胶囊；设置页左侧导航会多一项「音乐台」。

---

## 加载链路（谁在什么时候读哪个文件）

```
宿主启动
 └─ Loader 读 profile 的 bundles
     ├─ import dsh-music-on            → index.js            (宿主半边, ESM)
     │    └─ src/index.js              提供 /api/dsh-music-on/* 路由
     └─ 扫描 package.json 的 dsh.client
         └─ 服务端 readFileSync(exports["./client"]) → client.js  (browser 半边)
             └─ window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })
                 └─ 浏览器首次 require 时执行 factory
                     └─ require('react') → 内联实现（esbuild 已把 src/client/** 全打包进来）
                         └─ apply(ctx)
                             ├─ styles.ensureStyle()          注入 <style data-plugin-css>
                             ├─ registerShellDock()           挂 shell.overlay 槽位（右下角音乐台）
                             ├─ registerSettingsSection()     挂 settings.section 槽位
                             └─ registerTabType()/Seats()     右侧栏标签页形态（保留）
```

关键事实（均已在本机宿主包里核实，非推测）：

| 事实 | 证据位置 |
|---|---|
| `dsh.client` 只接受 `platform` / `inject` / `external` / `immediately` 四个字段，其余键被忽略 | `...\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-modules\lib\index.js:62`（`parseDshClient`） |
| 客户端 bundle 路径来自 `exports["./client"]`，缺了直接报错 | 同文件 `:172`（`clientExportOf`） |
| 服务端只做 `readFileSync` 后拼 combo，**全程无 esbuild/babel** | 同文件 `:274` / `:631` / `:834`（`PLUGIN_ROUTE` 一线） |
| 浏览器模块表只种 10 个包（react 系 + cordis + zod + react-virtual + 4 个 dsh-client-* ） | `...\dsh-web-frontend\dist\assets\index-*.js` 的 `staticModules`（函数 `SZ`） |
| `require()` 只认平台种子词与已注册工厂，**相对路径不解析** | `...\dsh-client-modules\lib\client.js:833-841` |

> 后果之一：`client.js` 里出现相对 require → `require("…") missed the module table` → 整插件不加载。
> 所以 `src/client/**` 全部经 esbuild 内联进单文件 `client.js`。
>
> 后果之二：真正的 JSX 语法在浏览器里会 SyntaxError → 面板白屏。
> 所以 `src/client/**` 里即使是 `.jsx` 文件也只写 `createElement as h`，**构建期才做转译**。

---

## 目录结构

```
dsh-music-on/
├── package.json            # dsh.bundle / dsh.client / exports 三处是装载的关键
├── index.js                # 宿主半边入口，只做 re-export
├── client.js               # 浏览器半边**构建产物**（__ModuleLoader__ 协议），由 scripts/build-client.mjs 生成
├── cordis.patch.yml        # bundle patch（顶层必须是 YAML **数组**，见下）
├── LICENSE                 # MIT
├── README.md / README.en.md
├── presets/                # 预置音景：manifest.json + 7 个 *.wav（CC0 原创合成）
├── scripts/                # 构建与自检（不进安装位置）
│   ├── build-client.mjs        # esbuild 打 client.js
│   ├── check-install.mjs       # 安装位置 20 项自检
│   ├── check-spectrum.mjs      # 频谱绘制 27 项自检
│   ├── simulate-browser.mjs    # vm 里真跑 client.js，验证槽位注册与首渲染
│   ├── simulate-drag.mjs       # 拖动通道（window 监听）行为验证
│   ├── submit-marketplace.ps1  # 市场投稿体检 + 开 PR（见下）
│   ├── shoot-screenshots.py    # Playwright 拍商店截图，顺带当视觉回归
│   └── verify-*.mjs            # 实网端到端自检（B站 / 平台直链）
└── src/
    ├── index.js            # 宿主半边入口：建票据单例、挂三条路由
    ├── shared.js           # 跨半边共享常量（PLUGIN_ID / 三条路径 / 槽位 id）
    ├── host/               # 只在 Node 里跑，浏览器拿不到的能力
    │   ├── resolve.js      # 平台链接解析（B站 / 网易云 / QQ / YouTube）
    │   ├── stream.js       # 音频流转发 + 平台票据通道
    │   ├── mediatoken.js   # HMAC 票据签发 / 验签（不透明句柄）
    │   └── presets-static.js  # presets/*.wav 静态资源路由
    └── client/             # 全部内联进 client.js，禁止相对 require
        ├── register.js     # 槽位注册 + React 桥 + 运行时单例
        ├── engine.js       # 播放引擎（AudioContext 单例、队列、双轨音源）
        ├── sources.js      # Track 工厂（url / preset / embed / bilibili / platform）
        ├── linkintake.js   # 粘贴文本 → 分流 → 入队
        ├── library.js      # 收藏与历史的存储层
        ├── parser.js        # 平台链接识别与 id 提取
        ├── settings.js     # 设置 schema / 默认值 / 归一化 / store
        ├── locale.js       # zh / en 字典
        ├── i18n.js         # 安全翻译层（宿主 t 的插值语义补丁）
        ├── styles.js       # 全部 CSS（类名统一 dmo- 前缀）
        ├── presets.js       # 预置清单加载
        └── ui/             # 组件（纯 createElement，无 JSX 语法糖）
            ├── ShellDock.js      # 右下角音乐台（胶囊 / 卡片 / 隐藏三态）
            ├── Spectrum.jsx      # 频谱动画（dots / bars / line / wave）
            ├── Settings.jsx      # 设置页分区
            ├── LibrarySection.jsx # 设置页里的收藏 / 历史表
            ├── PlayerPanel.jsx   # 右侧栏标签页形态（保留）
            └── PresetsSection.jsx
```

---

## 截图

| 收起态胶囊 | 展开态卡片 |
| --- | --- |
| ![胶囊](docs/screenshot-capsule.png) | ![卡片](docs/screenshot-dock.png) |

![音景](docs/screenshot-soundscapes.png)

三张图都列在 `screenshots.json` 里（商店按它决定展示顺序）。它们由 `scripts/shoot-screenshots.py`（Playwright）从真实 GUI 拍下，所以同时是**视觉回归**：改完 CSS 重拍一遍，哪里漂了一眼就能看出来。

## 三条 HTTP 路由与平台票据通道

| 路径 | 挂法 | 存在理由 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/dsh-music-on/resolve` | `connection.fetch.register` | 浏览器直连 B站 / 网易云 / QQ 必被同源策略与 Referer 校验拦下，必须宿主代取 |
| `/api/dsh-music-on/stream` | `connection.fetch.register` | 让外部音频能进 `AudioContext`，从而拿到真频谱 |
| `/api/dsh-music-on/presets/` | `webServer.register({kind:'prefix'})` | 静态 WAV；需要自己写 `ServerResponse` 以支持 `Range` |

### 网易云 / QQ 音乐：为什么不透明票据

这两个平台的 CDN（`music.126.net` / `tc.qq.com`）**不在 B 站 CDN 白名单里**。若让客户端把解析出来的明文直链交给 `stream?src=…`，那条路由立刻退化成开放代理 —— 任何人都能拿它当跳板。

所以走票据：宿主解析出直链后，用 HMAC 签发一个不透明句柄（`/api/dsh-music-on/stream?mt=<token>`），客户端**永远拿不到真实直链，也无法伪造 URL**。票据里只带 `{url, mime, platform, id, title, pageUrl, 签发时间, 过期时间}`。

- 实现：`src/host/mediatoken.js`。形态 `<base64url(payload)>.<base64url(hmac)>`，**字符集不含 `%`** —— 硬要求，因为 stream 路由拒绝任何百分号编码。
- 域名白名单分成两张表：`ALLOWED_CDN_DOMAINS`（B站，供 `src=` 通道）与 `PLATFORM_CDN_DOMAINS`（平台，**只供 token 通道**）。合并它们 = `src=` 变开放代理。
- `verify()` 先比签名再解 JSON，用 `timingSafeEqual`，**永不抛错**。
- TTL 10 分钟；宿主重启即换随机密钥 → 旧票据全失效 → 客户端重新解析（有意为之）。
- 拿不到直链的曲目（网易云 VIP / QQ 版权限制）**仍然入队**，带 `unavailableReason`，队列里标「无直链」、诊断行说明原因，并可跳原平台。绝不伪造一个 url 让它假装能播。

### 每批上限必须两端相等

`MAX_STREAM_TRACKS`（宿主，`src/host/resolve.js`）= `MAX_PLATFORM_TRACKS`（客户端，`src/client/linkintake.js`）= **60**。

这不是随手取的数，是两边必须对齐的**耦合常量**：

- 宿主只给前 60 首取直链并签票据。客户端截得比 60 小，等于把已签好的票据白扔（能播的曲目没进队列）；截得比 60 大也没意义，多出来的必然 `streamOnly`。
- 两者由 `test/host-route.test.mjs` 的「宿主与客户端的每批上限必须相等」一条断言锁死。

### 网易云歌单必须按 trackIds 补齐

`api/v6/playlist/detail` 返回的 `playlist.tracks` **只内联前 10 首**，而 `trackCount` 与 `trackIds` 是完整的。直接吃 `tracks` 的后果是：73 首的歌单只解析出 10 首，界面上却显示「解析成功」—— 比报错更难发现。

补齐走 `api/song/detail?ids=[...]`，实测（本机直连）：200 首 → 200/612KB/228ms；500 首 → 200/616KB/181ms；**1000 首 → code 400**（URL 长 11399 超限）。所以按 200 分块。

两个额外约束：

- 字段形状**两套**。内联曲目是 `ar` / `dt`，`song/detail` 是 `artists` / `duration`。只认一套会把补齐来的曲目歌手与时长全部弄丢（`neteaseArtists` / `neteaseDuration` 两吃）。
- 补齐失败**绝

plugins.description: 支持不修改排版和格式的情况下进行文字、Word、Excel、PDF 与图片等格式的dsh ai翻译插件
plugins.readme_text:
# SACC Translator for DeepSeek Harness

Windows x64 翻译插件，复用 DSH 模型选择、语音输入和文档预览，支持文本及尽量保留原格式的文档翻译。

## 状态

当前源码对应 0.1.19，适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。支持 CPU 版与自动绑定 GPU 组件的 CUDA 版。仓库只包含翻译所需源码，不包含 SACC 主应用、用户数据、密钥、日志或运行时二进制。

支持扩展名：doc/docx、xls/xlsx、ppt/pptx、pdf、png/jpg/jpeg/bmp/gif/webp、txt/md/csv/html/htm。复杂排版与 OCR 译文仍需人工复核。

## npm 安装（0.1.19）

官方“添加插件”输入 `dsh-sacc-translator-cpu` 或 `dsh-sacc-translator-cuda`。也可使用 CLI：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-sacc-translator-cpu
# 或
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-sacc-translator-cuda
```

npm 入口包约 26 KB。包管理器自动下载固定版本 GitHub Release 运行时；CUDA 额外自动下载 GPU 组件，无安装脚本。首次总下载量仍约 CPU 364 MB / CUDA 2.04 GB。不要同时启用两个版本。

基础运行时作为内部依赖 `dsh-sacc-translator-runtime` 引用已验证的 CPU 0.1.17 Release 包，用户无需单独安装或启用。npm 包不包含用户文档、设置、密钥或历史。0.1.17 完整 Release 安装方法仍可使用。

当前入口包构建：`npm pack ./packages/cpu` 和 `npm pack ./packages/cuda`。下面的完整包构建配方须先检出 `v0.1.17` 标签，避免混用版本。

## 0.1.19 更新

默认翻译并发为 5，已有设置保持不变。CPU/CUDA Bundle 均附带宿主预览配置：PDF/普通文件读取 1 GiB；Excel 256 MiB、100 万单元格、2 分钟；Office 输入 512 MiB、输出 PDF 1 GiB、转换 5 分钟。预览仍为整文件加载，大文件需要足够内存。宿主个人配置覆盖项优先。启用后重新打开 DSH，以便前后端加载配置。没有提高长期缓存上限。

这些配置作用于宿主共享预览服务，不仅是翻译面板。运行库继续使用固定的 0.1.17 / GPU 0.1.16 附件，格式支持及二进制未变更。

## 构建

0.1.17 发行包复用经过 SHA-256 校验的 0.1.16 运行时，保留已验证的格式支持。以下命令下载固定版本公开发行附件并构建三个包：

```powershell
python release/build_market.py --inputs .build/inputs --output plugins/dsh-translator/dist
```

输出 CPU、CUDA 与 GPU 附属包以及 SHA256SUMS.txt。构建只接受固定哈希的输入；源代码位于 plugins/dsh-translator，发行前端位于 packages/cpu 与 packages/cuda。GPU 二进制不存入 Git。

若修改 Python 文档处理逻辑，则需在 Windows x64 安装 requirements-build.txt，并在 .tools/libreoffice/runtime 准备官方 LibreOffice，使用 runtime/worker.spec 重新构建并完成文档回归验证，再更新发行输入哈希。Office 与 NVIDIA 等第三方组件保留其各自许可。

## 安装 0.1.17（Windows x64）

公共市场收录审核通过后，搜索“翻译 CPU”或“翻译 CUDA”。CPU 无 NVIDIA 依赖；CUDA 自动安装固定版本 GPU 附属组件，不需要手工下载 ZIP 或执行脚本。两个版本只启用一个，共用设置与翻译历史。

也可以直接使用 DSH 官方 CLI：

```powershell
# CPU（约 364 MB）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/piaomiaozhilei/dsh-sacc-translator/releases/download/v0.1.17/dsh-sacc-translator-cpu-0.1.17.tgz
# 或 CUDA（基础包约 364 MB，自动下载 GPU 组件约 1.68 GB）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/piaomiaozhilei/dsh-sacc-translator/releases/download/v0.1.17/dsh-sacc-translator-cuda-0.1.17.tgz
```

首次安装 CUDA 需要下载较大的组件，等待宿主安装完成；安装失败时在市场重试。组件不是独立 DSH 插件，无需启用，不单独列入市场。插件启用时校验 15 个 DLL 并自动挂载。运行时存放在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%/dsh-translator/runtimes` 的版本目录，避免 pnpm 深路径导致 Windows DLL 加载失败；同盘优先使用硬链接避免重复占用，跨盘才复制。该目录属于安装组件，不计入翻译文档缓存。首次校验和 CUDA 初始化可能需要一分钟。无兼容 NVIDIA GPU 时工作进程明确显示原因并回退 CPU。

已有用户请先结束翻译任务，通过宿主禁用旧版、安装新版，再启用所需版本；重启 DSH 后生效。更新不会删除翻译设置或记录。不要同时启用 CPU 和 CUDA。GPU 依赖下载失败会使 CUDA 安装失败，不会声称已完成 GPU 安装。GPU 组件校验失败会阻止文件翻译并提示重装，不会静默使用损坏文件。

0.1.17 复用已经验证的 0.1.16 文档运行时，仅更改安装依赖和组件挂载；没有模型、OCR 或文档格式逻辑变更。旧 0.1.16 ZIP/PowerShell 手动安装方法仅适用于旧版。

## 设置与隐私

模型调用由 DSH 完成，工作进程不持有模型凭据。CPU/CUDA 版本共用 DSH 数据目录下的 sacc-translator 设置和翻译记录。清理缓存会删除专属翻译产物及记录，不删除宿主共享附件。

请勿向仓库上传个人文档、翻译记录、环境配置、API 密钥或故障日志。问题报告优先使用自行构造的脱敏样例。

## 0.1.16 验证

18 种扩展名已通过本地固定模型响应的解析、回填及输出读取测试；旧版 Office 输出再转换后可读取，Excel 公式保留。GPU 可选组件安装后，三个 OCR 模型实际使用 CUDA。测试不代表对所有复杂文档或模型翻译质量的保证。

基础安装包约 364 MB；可选 GPU 组件约 1.68 GB，完整 CUDA 下载约 2.04 GB。首次 CUDA 初始化仍可能约一分钟；尚未实现跨任务引擎复用。

公共目录条目位于社区 awesome-dsh-plugin，审核通过后才能在 dshmarket 搜索。仓库 packages/cpu 与 packages/cuda 分别对应两个可安装条目，包内二进制仅通过 Release 分发。release/build_market.py 从校验过的 0.1.16 包可复现构建 0.1.17。

plugins.description: Live-preview panel for DeepSeek Harness: preview workspace pages beside the chat, auto-reload on save. · DeepSeek Harness 实时预览插件：边聊边看你的页面，改完自动刷新。
plugins.readme_text:
# Live Preview for DeepSeek Harness

[中文说明](./README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md) · MIT

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **live-preview panel** to the Web UI. Pick a workspace, browse to an HTML
page, and it renders beside the conversation — every save reloads it. The agent can open pages too, through the
`live_preview` tool.

> Built for the "let me see what you are making" loop: chat on the left, your page on the right, no window
> switching.

## Features

- Preview panel docked to the right of the Harness UI; drag its left edge to resize, width and device mode are remembered
- Workspace → directory → file browser with an `HTML` badge
- **Auto reload on save** (SSE, with a version-poll fallback), toggleable, plus a manual reload button.
  Only files the preview actually loaded trigger a reload, so unrelated workspace activity (service logs, data
  dumps) does not keep reloading your page.
- **Focus on what is being edited** — the preview scrolls to and outlines the block that just changed, and the panel
  shows an "Editing …" chip; automatic on save (HTML by source line, CSS by rule selector) and available through the tool
- Device widths: full / 768 px / 375 px, and open-in-new-tab
- **Survives a Harness restart** — the last open page is remembered in the browser and restored when the panel
  was open, so a restart no longer leaves it blank
- **Separate window** — open the preview in your system default browser and collapse the in-panel view, so the
  conversation gets its space back; live reload / focus keep working in that window
- Agent tool `live_preview` with `open` / `close` / `refresh` / `root` / `focus` / `clear`
- Read-only preview server on loopback, one-time token + HttpOnly cookie, realpath containment checks
- The previewed page runs on its own origin, isolated from the Harness UI origin

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (the `dsh web` app or the desktop app)
- Node.js 20+ on the Harness host

## Install

1. Clone this repository anywhere on the Harness host.
2. Install it as a local bundle — ask the Harness agent, or call the plugin manager directly:

   ```
   plugin_manager install_bundle(target: "/absolute/path/to/dsh-live-preview")
   ```

   (In the UI: Plugins → Add → local bundle directory.)
3. **Refresh the Web UI** (Ctrl+R). An eye icon appears in the session header.

> A local-directory install links the checkout in place. If you move or delete the folder, reinstall the bundle.

## Use

- **Eye icon** — open / close the preview panel
- **Workspace dropdown** — switch the preview root (registered workspaces only)
- **Choose file** — browse folders, click an HTML file to preview it, click a folder to enter
- **Full / Tablet / Phone** — preview width (phone = 375 px)
- **Auto reload** — whether file changes reload the page
- **Reload** — reload the current page manually
- **Open in a new tab** — hand the page to your system browser
- **Separate window** — open the preview in your default browser and close the panel, for when the panel feels
  too wide; auto reload and the edit highlight keep working there. (The desktop shell blocks `window.open`, so
  the Host opens it instead.)
- Drag the panel's left edge to resize it

Ask the agent to open a page for you:

```
Open the live preview on maas-home-preview/index.html
```

The agent calls `live_preview({ action: "open", path: "maas-home-preview/index.html" })`.

## Focus — show the block being edited

When a watched file changes, the plugin works out *where* the edit landed and tells the preview to point at it:

- **HTML** — served pages carry `data-lp-line` markers on elements. The change is diffed against the last served
  revision, and the element nearest the changed source line is scrolled into view and outlined.
- **CSS** — the selector of the rule surrounding the changed line is resolved and every matching element is outlined
  (up to 12).
- Other text files — the panel still shows "Editing … · line N" without a page outline.

The focus is carried through the reload (stored in `sessionStorage`), so it lands after the page has reloaded.
You can also drive it explicitly:

```jsonc
{ "action": "focus", "selector": "#hero" }
{ "action": "focus", "path": "index.html", "line": 312 }
{ "action": "clear" }
```

The panel shows the current target with **Locate** (re-apply) and **×** (clear) actions; it fades after ~15 seconds.

## Configuration

Edit the plugin row's `config` in your `cordis.patch.yml` patch layer:

```yaml
- id: dsh-live-preview
  config:
    port: 8123              # 0 = pick a free port; a busy port falls back automatically
    autoReload: true        # broadcast reloads by default
    roots: []               # extra absolute directories allowed as preview roots
    ignore: ["node_modules", ".git", "dist", "build", ".tmp", ".venv"]
    panelWidthRatio: 0.46   # initial panel width
```

## How it works

```
Harness Web UI (:59936, authenticated)
├── session header utilities  → eye toggle (client plugin)
├── shell.overlay             → preview panel (React, theme tokens)
│        │ fetch same-origin JSON API (/dsh-live-preview/*)
│        │ iframe → loopback preview server
└────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────
         ▼
Host plugin (zero dependencies)
├── loopback preview server :8123 (read-only)
│   ├── static files + reload script injection
│   ├── per-file fs.watch (only served files) → SSE reload (+ /__live/version fallback)
│   └── token + cookie auth, realpath containment
└── same-origin API: /info /state /tree /root /panel /refresh
```

`live_preview` opens a page by resolving the path against the caller's session working directory, then picking
the nearest registered workspace as the preview root.

## Security model

- The preview server binds `127.0.0.1` only
- Every file request needs the per-process random token (`?t=`) or the `dshprev` HttpOnly cookie
- Read-only: no write endpoint
- Each request is checked with `realpath` + containment; `..`, encoded traversal and symlink escapes are rejected
- The previewed page gets its own origin, so it cannot read the Harness UI's storage or authenticated API
- No LAN or remote access

## Limitations

- Static files only; a project that needs `npm run dev` is not proxied (planned)
- Pages that call absolute-path backend endpoints will 404
- If the page's own CSP blocks the injected reload script, the panel-side fallback still reloads it — that fallback
  needs one page refresh after installing/updating
- The boot contract (`window.__ModuleLoader__`, slot APIs) is internal to Harness; a major Harness upgrade may need a
  small plugin update

## Development

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/2011126630z-commits/dsh-live-preview
cd dsh-live-preview
npm test        # node:test — auth, traversal, MIME, injection (syntax-checked), SSE, port fallback, cleanup
```

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: 专门为 agent 打造的开源 agent 搜索工具，具备 200+的搜索源及多语言搜索能力，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。
plugins.readme_text:
中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

介绍 · 对比 · 证明 · 机制 · 快速开始 · 能力 · 配置 · 更新

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★ · [dsh-models](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-models) 模型选择 + 子代理路由 + 推理层级）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | ## 性能 Benchmark | 指标 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 热查询延迟 | ~2000ms | ~1500ms | ~800ms | **~10ms** | | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 缓存 | 无 | 页面缓存 | 页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite）** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | ## 架构 ### 主流程 ```mermaid graph LR A[用户查询] --> B[语言检测] B --> C[引擎分诊] C --> D[并行搜索] D --> E[结果聚合] E --> F[可信度评分] F --> G[JSON 输出] H[双层缓存] -.-> D I[预算控制] -.-> C ``` ### 引擎分诊流程 ```mermaid graph TD A[用户查询] --> B{语言检测} B -->|中文| C[中文引擎组] B -->|英文| D[英文引擎组] B -->|日韩| E[日韩引擎组] B -->|其他| F[通用引擎组] C --> G{领域判断} D --> G E --> G F --> G G -->|学术| H[学术引擎] G -->|代码| I[代码引擎] G -->|购物| J[购物引擎] G -->|金融| K[金融引擎] G -->|新闻| L[新闻引擎] G -->|通用| M[网页引擎] H --> N[并行搜索] I --> N J --> N K --> N L --> N M --> N ``` ### 缓存机制 ```mermaid graph LR A[查询请求] --> B{内存缓存} B -->|命中| C[直接返回] B -->|未命中| D{SQLite 缓存} D -->|命中| E[返回并更新内存] D -->|未命中| F[执行搜索] F --> G[结果写入 SQLite] G --> H[结果写入内存] H --> I[返回结果] ``` ### 可信度评分流程 ```mermaid graph TD A[搜索结果] --> B[Selection 评分] A --> C[Absorption 评分] A --> D[Freshness 评分] A --> E[共识评分] B --> F[综合可信度] C --> F D --> F E --> F F --> G{阈值判断} G -->|高于阈值| H[保留] G -->|低于阈值| I[丢弃] H --> J[JSON 输出] ``` ### 预算控制流程 ```mermaid graph LR A[搜索请求] --> B{预算检查} B -->|预算充足| C[免费引擎优先] B -->|预算紧张| D[仅免费引擎] B -->|预算耗尽| E[返回缓存] C --> F{免费引擎有结果?} D --> F F -->|有| G[返回结果] F -->|无| H{有 Key?} H -->|有| I[付费引擎搜索] H -->|无| J[返回空结果] I --> G ``` ### 整体架构 ```mermaid graph TB subgraph 用户层 A[Agent / 用户] end subgraph 接入层 B[CLI] C[MCP Server] D[Python SDK] end subgraph 核心层 E[语言检测] F[引擎分诊] G[并行搜索] H[结果聚合] I[可信度评分] end subgraph 数据层 J[内存缓存] K[SQLite 缓存] L[265+ 搜索引擎] end subgraph 控制层 M[预算控制] N[多语言支持] end A --> B A --> C A --> D B --> E C --> E D --> E E --> F F --> G G --> H H --> I J -.-> G K -.-> G L --> G M -.-> F N -.-> E I --> A ``` > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- ## 这是什么 **Argo 是给 AI Agent 用的多语言搜索基础设施。** 真实检索从来不是「一种语言 + 一个搜索框」：有人问 A 股行情，有人问 World Cup，有人用日文找动画，有人要 IMDb 上的导演信息。Argo 的出发点很朴素——**按领域、按语言、按需求选路**，把问题送到合适的源，而不是一律扫网页标题。联网搜索与本机文件搜索一体可用。 > 产出不是「链接清单」，而是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」。路选对了，证据才站得住。 ### 和「再包一层搜索 API」的差别 | 常见做法 | Argo | |---------|------| | 绑死一个引擎、一个 Key | 多引擎自动选路，免费优先、可配预算 | | 啥问题都泛搜网页 | **垂直源优先**：行情、影视、体育、宏观、化学等先给答案型结果 | | 默认只按中英优化 | **多语言识别 + 引擎语言参数 + 跨语言回退** | | 搜完直接拼摘要 | 选择门槛 × 证据密度 × 时效 × 多源共识 | | 引擎挂了整条链路挂 | 熔断、负缓存、分阶恢复（防垂直源串味） | | 每次查询都重新打网 | 双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级 | | 日常和研究一个慢 | **日常少开引擎、研究再放宽** | | Agent 上下文被长 JSON 撑爆 | MCP 响应可紧凑裁剪，snippet 可控 | --- ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.

# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-memory-refine

**简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)**

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的「记忆提炼」插件：把一场长对话提炼成候选条目，你逐条点头，再写进长期记忆文件 —— 面板里能直接看、直接改、直接删。

> 这不是商业产品，是我自己用出来的东西 —— 你要想要，拿去。（MIT）
> 它所有的判断都建立在一个前提上：长期记忆是你亲手确认过的东西，不是模型自己攒的。

![记忆提炼面板](docs/panel.png)

---

## 它解决什么

- 会话日志越滚越长（一场下来几百条事件），真正的长期记忆却只有几份 `.md`；
- 手工翻记录提炼，容易漏，更容易把**引擎注入的提示词**当成「他说的话」；
- 直接改记忆文件没有安全网：写坏了没法退，两个人（人 + 模型）同时改会互相覆盖。

---

## 安装

前提：DSH 有 profile 机制（Desktop 版或带 profile 的 CLI）。

1. 把本目录放到任意位置（示例：`D:/plugins/dsh-memory-refine`）。**下面 `link:` 后面的路径要换成你自己放的位置。**

2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加一条软链依赖：

   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "dsh-memory-refine": "link:D:/plugins/dsh-memory-refine"
     }
   }
   ```

3. 同一个文件的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里加上它：

   ```json
   { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-memory-refine"] } } }
   ```

4. **重启整个 DSH 进程**。

> ⚠️ **改代码之后必须重启整个 DSH**。ESM 模块缓存按 URL 命中，在插件管理器里开关插件**不会**重新 import 新代码 —— 你会以为改了没生效。

装好后侧边栏会出现「记忆提炼」图标。

---

## 第一次用（面板是空的？）

新装的 DSH 通常**没有** `memory/` 目录，所以第一次打开面板时左栏可能是空的 —— 不是坏了。

不用手动建目录，两条路都能起第一份记忆：

1. **让模型建**：跟它说「帮我在 `memory/` 下建一份 `示例主题.md`，先写一行占位」。`memory_write` 会自动创建 `memory/` 目录和文件。
2. **自己建**：在 `DSH_HOME/memory/` 下新建 `.md` 文件，再点面板「刷新」。

`DSH_HOME` 在 Windows 上一般是 `C:\Users\<你的用户名>\.dsh`。

> `AGENTS.md` 是 DSH 的每轮注入层，不是插件建的。没有它插件照常工作，只是左栏少一项。

---

## 写记忆的几条规矩

插件只负责「安全地写」，**写什么**还是得靠人把握。三条踩过的坑：

1. **一条记忆一个 `<!--@refine-->` 块**。一个块里塞两件事，将来想单独改或删其中一条就扯不开了。
2. **主语写清楚**。别只写「名字，某某」—— 是给助手起名，还是说你自己叫这个？模型会宁可问你，也不乱猜（它会说：猜错了会被当成事实一直带着）。
3. **写完让它复述一遍**。「你读到的这条是什么意思，归谁？」比猜它懂没懂稳得多。

---

## 五个工具

插件注册五个模型可调用的工具，全部只碰白名单内的文件。

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_list` | 列出受管文件：注入层 `AGENTS.md`、索引、常记、存档，带版本哈希与行数 |
| `memory_read` | 读一份受管文件（分页），附带层级、版本、总行数 |
| `memory_gather` | 把一场会话取成提炼素材，markdown 落盘，返回预览与统计 |
| `memory_write` | 写入受管文件。**必须用户点头**才会落盘 |
| `memory_import` | 把外部内容导入某个记忆文件（新起章节 / 追加） |

### `memory_gather` 的参数

| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session_id` | 当前会话 | 要提炼哪一场 |
| `mode` | `incremental` | `incremental` 只取水印之后的新轮次；`full` 取全程 |
| `boundary_seq` | 自动派生 | 手动指定边界（调试用） |
| `max_reasoning` | `0` | 每段保留多少推理字符，0 = 整段砍掉只留一行占位 |
| `out_dir` | 会话工作区下 `memory-refine-scratch/` | 素材落点 |

素材默认落在**会话自己的工作区**，不会往 DSH 的配置目录里堆。

---

## 面板

左侧「记忆提炼」图标 → 主面板。

- **左栏**：受管文件列表。存档默认折叠（`显示存档 (N)`），点一次展开。
- **右栏**：选中文件的正文，可以直接改。改完按「保存」。
- **顶栏**：
  - `刷新`：作废缓存，重新读磁盘。
  - `清理素材…`：删掉本会话工作区下 `memory-refine-scratch/` 里的素材文件（`material-*.md` / `tools-*.md`）。会先问一次，只认这两个前缀，不递归子目录。
- **写入后**：上方会留一条 `这版没问题，删掉备份` —— 你按下它，这次改动留下的那份备份才会被删掉。不按就留着。
- **重新读取**：选中一个文件，按「重新读取」→ 从磁盘再读一次。**保存时如果报「在你看过之后被改动过」，就用它** —— 多半是模型或另一个窗口刚写过这个文件。有没保存的改动时会先问你一句。
- **删除文件**：选中一个文件，按「删除…」→ 确认。会先整份备份到 `memory-refine-backups/` 再删。
- **导入…**：填目标文件 + 章节标题，然后在下面那个大框里放内容。大框两种填法都认：
  - **贴正文** —— 直接把要导入的文字粘进去；
  - **填绝对路径** —— 只写一个文件的完整路径（如 `D:\旧笔记.md`），它会自己去读那个文件。省得把几万字粘进来。
    判定收得很紧：**单行、长度 ≤ 4096、且是绝对路径、且文件确实存在**，四条全中才当路径；否则一律当正文。所以正文里恰好写了路径不会被误读。相对路径**不认**（Host 里没有确定的基准目录，猜错了会读到别的文件）。

> 注入层 `AGENTS.md` 在面板里**不可删除**，只能改。

---

## 安全设计

写入永远走同一条路（`index.js` 里的 `confirmAndWrite`）：

1. **版本哈希预检** —— 你手上这份的版本和磁盘上的对不上，直接中止，一个字节都不写；
2. **整份备份** —— 先落一份到 `DSH_HOME/memory-refine-backups/`；
3. **写后读回核验** —— 写完立刻读回来逐字比对，不一致就报失败。

一次成功的写入长这样（版本、行数变化、核验结果、备份路径都在一条里）：

![一次成功的写入：版本哈希、行数变化、读回核验、备份位置](docs/write-result.png)

另外：

- **写入必须用户点头**。拿不到问答服务时直接拒绝，**不静默降级**成「自动同意」。
- **白名单**：只认 `DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` 与 `DSH_HOME/memory/**/*.md`。`..` 越界、盘外路径一律拒绝。
- **斜杠命令载荷不记录**：命令注册时 `recordInput: false`，会话日志里不会重复存一份完整输入 JSON。命令通道现在只是兜底，正常不走它（见下一节）。

---

## 面板怎么跟后台通信

面板跑在浏览器里，Host 跑在另一个进程 —— 中间没有私有的插件 RPC 通道（DSH 的能力集合在构建时固定，第三方插件加不进去）。

所以插件在 Host 半边挂了一条自己的 HTTP 路由：

```
POST /memory-refine/ui          ← 面板的每一次操作都走这里
  请求 { action, sessionId, ... }
  响应 { ok: true, data } 或 { ok: false, error }
```

这条路由：

- 只接受**本机、且通过 `connection.requestRejection` 信任校验**的请求（不自己造 token）；
- 四道闸：只认 `POST`；只认 `content-type: application/json`；请求体 8 MB 上限；鉴权不过直接 401/403；
- 把 `sessionId` 翻译成 agent 后交给**同一套** `handleUiRequest` —— 白名单、版本预检、备份、读回核验，和工具那条路走的是同一份代码。

**为什么需要它**：斜杠命令（`ctx.remote.commands.execute`）是第三方插件唯一能调到 Host 的方式，但它**按设计会往会话日志里写一对 `command/run` / `command/done`**，在对话视图里显示成一条 `memory-refine · {...}` 记录。走 HTTP 路由不进命令总线，就没有这条记录。

**兜底**：要是路由没注册上（老版本 DSH 没有 `webServer`），或者请求被拦，面板会自动回退到斜杠命令，并在顶部挂一条红色警告 —— 不会悄悄留痕。

---

## 会话取料是怎么做的

直接读 DSH 的会话事件流（`sessionQuery.readSession`），不碰磁盘上的 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` —— 不用自己解多帧 zstd。

丢弃的东西：

- `<system-reminder>` 整块（AGENTS.md 变更通知就是这么进来的，**最容易被当成「他说的」**）；
- 裸运行时快照（`Current runtime context.` 之后的全部）；
- `request/header` 里的提示词清单；
- 推理正文（只留一行 `<!-- 推理已省略：本段 N 处共 X 字 -->`）。

### 水印：零外部状态

每次取料会在素材首行写：

```
<!--memory-refine:watermark session=<id> seq=<n> time=<t> turns=<k>-->
```

下次取料时，`deriveWatermark()` 扫一遍会话日志里的 `tool/result`，找上一次 `memory_gather` 留下的那行，取出 `seq` 当边界。

**好处**：不需要任何外部状态文件，不会像 `handledIds` 那样无限膨胀，天然按会话隔离。边界落在**轮**上（`user.seq > boundarySeq`），所以不会切在某一轮中间。

---

## 目录结构

```
memory-refine/
├── index.js         Host 半边：skill + 5 个工具 + 界面命令桥
├── client.js        浏览器半边：侧边栏图标 + 主面板
├── gather.js        纯函数：会话事件流 → 提炼素材（无 cordis 依赖，可单独测）
├── memory.js        受管文件访问层：白名单 + 版本哈希 + 备份 + 读回核验
├── protocol.js      提炼协议全文（作为 skill 注入）
├── test/smoke.mjs   离线冒烟测试：假 ctx + 沙盒 DSH_HOME
├── cordis.patch.yml 告诉 DSH 装哪一行
└── package.json
```

`gather.js` 刻意做成纯函数：输入事件数组，输出文本，不碰磁盘。这样可以拿导出的会话日志在沙盒里反复重放，不用重启 DSH。

---

## 测试

```
node test/smoke.mjs
```

不需要启动 DSH，也不会碰你的记忆文件 —— 它用假 `ctx` 加载 Host 半边，把 `DSH_HOME` 指到系统临时目录下的沙盒，跑完即删。

20 条断言，重点不在「功能能跑」，而在**手动点不出来的那些分支**：

- 四道闸：只认 `POST`（405）、只认已知子路径（404）、只认 JSON（415）、鉴权拒绝原样透传（403）
- 白名单越界被拒（`../../etc/passwd`）
- 写入：读回核验通过、备份文件真的生成了
- **版本不符时中止**（`deadbeefdeadbeef` → 一个字节不写）
- 导入的章节间距、删除的备份命名与「确实没了」的核验

这些分支在真实环境里要一条条制造出来，每条都得重启一次 DSH；在断言里是三行。

---

## 卸载

1. 从 profile 的 `package.json` 里去掉 `dsh-memory-refine` 依赖；
2. 从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里去掉 `"dsh-memory-refine"`；
3. **重启 DSH**；
4. 可选清理：
   - `DSH_HOME/memory-refine-backups/` —— 写入前的备份（留着也许有用）；
   - 会话工作区下的 `memory-refine-scratch/` —— 取出来的素材（可以直接删）。

卸载**不会**动 `AGENTS.md` 和 `memory/` 里的任何东西。

---

## 已知限制

- **命令通道是兜底，不是主路。** 面板默认走插件自己的本地 HTTP 路由（`POST /memory-refine/ui`），**不经过命令总线**，所以正常使用时对话视图里不会出现 `memory-refine · {...}` 记录。只有在路由不可用时才回退到 `/memory-refine` 斜杠命令，留下一对 `command/run` / `command/done` —— 这时面板顶部会挂一条红色警告，告诉你发生了降级。这组事件**不进模型历史、不烧 token、不污染取料素材**。
- 面板在「一个会话都没打开过」时无法确定会话 id，会提示先打开一个会话。
- 只在 **Windows** 上验证过。

plugins.description: 让 Qoder CN 的免费模型（Qwen3.8-Flash 等）当 DSH 的子代理：逐次选模型、逐次传权限、零提示词注入、全程留痕。
plugins.readme_text:
# @local/dsh-qoder-subagent

把 **Qoder CN 自带的 CLI**（`qoderclicn`，藏在 `resources\app.asar.unpacked\node_modules\@qoder-ai\qoder-cn-agent-sdk\dist\_worker\` 里）
当成 DSH 的**免费子代理**用。默认模型 `Qwen3.8-Flash`（实测 `billable: false`、`credits: 0`、`usd: 0`）。

## 工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `freesub_run` | 派一个子代理。`wait_ms=0` 立刻返回句柄；**结束后自动注入完成通知**；`wait_ms>0` 同步等结果 |
| `freesub_result` | 取结果（取回后该条通知自动消失） |
| `freesub_send` | 复用会话上下文继续说一句（Qoder 侧 `--resume <session-id>`） |
| `freesub_list` | 谁在跑、谁跑完了、`pending_notifications` 有几条未取回 |
| `freesub_interrupt` | 掐掉（杀进程树），被掐同样产生通知 |
| `freesub_models` | 免费模型表 + 实际发现到的 Qoder 路径 |

设计约束：**逐次选模型**（`model` 是调用参数）、**逐次传权限**（`permission: readonly / edit / full`）、
**零提示词注入**（发出去的就是 `task` 原文，另存 `runs/<id>/prompt.txt` 可逐字核对）、**逐 run 留痕**。

## 运行留痕（`runs/<agent_id>/`）

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `prompt.txt` | 实际发出的原文 |
| `events.jsonl` | Qoder 的原始事件流；**结束时若无 `result` 事件，插件会补写一条 `synthesized: true` 的终止记录** |
| `stderr.log` | 子进程 stderr（失败排查用） |
| `meta.json` | 终态、`stage`、`errorStage`、`cwd`/`cwdRequested`、`eventCount`、`lastEventAt`、`collected`、`noticeCount`、`discovery` 等 |

## v0.2.0 修的四条（对应 2026-10-16 两份报障单）

1. **完成即注入**：注册 `systemPrompt.context({ name: 'freesub-completions' })`，每次组装提示词时把
   "已结束但未取回"的子代理报给**发起它的那个会话**（`scope.id` 对 `owner`）。同一会话最多重复注入 5 次；
   `freesub_result` 取回后立即停止。→ 不再需要人肉轮询。
2. **失败也注入**：`discovery` / `spawn` / `child-exit` / `timeout` / `killed` 全部算终态，同样进通知。
3. **cwd 不存在不再谎报 ENOENT**：`spawn` 前校验 `cwd` 与可执行文件，错误里带
   `stage` / `code` / `path` / `spawnargs` / 实际 `cwd`；返回体带 `startup_failed: true` 与 `detail`。
   （根因：`child_process.spawn` 在 `cwd` 不存在时抛的就是 `spawn <cmd> ENOENT`，看起来像程序缺失。）
4. **事件流必有收尾 + meta 可判活**：见上表。

### 离线验收（不经过宿主，可直接复跑）

装好后从一个会话里跑一条普通任务即可验收这三件事：正常任务返回 `status=done`；
`cwd` 不存在时返回 `status=error` 且 `error_stage=spawn`（不会谎报成 ENOENT）；
完成通知在取回之后从 `pending_notifications` 里消失。

## 生效方式（重要）

**改插件源码不会热重载**（base bundle 的 `hmr` 默认只监听配置，不监听模块；且宿主按目录缓存已加载的模块）。
所以本文件改动后需要**重启该实例**。重启后页面访问 token 会变，用新 token 重新打开页面。

## 已知问题

- **默认 `cwd` 是插件进程的工作目录**（通常是实例目录），不是会话工作区。需要特定目录时请显式传 `cwd`。
- **不要用 profile 补丁层覆盖运行中 bundle 的行配置**：实测在 `profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里按 `id` 覆盖
  `dsh-compact` 这类**已安装 bundle** 的行不生效（组合产物 `cordis.yml` 里根本没有那一行）。
  本插件同理——目前没有可调配置，只有一个 `stateDir`/`maxConcurrent` 的 patch 默认值。
- Qoder 安装目录里存在多份 `Qoder CN.exe`（根目录 / `.qoder-versions\*`），存在版本漂移；
  `freesub_models` 会回报实际使用的那一份路径，报错时请以它为准。

## 版本

- `0.1.0`（`index-v010.js`，备份留档）：完成通知缺失、cwd 不存在谎报 ENOENT。
- `0.2.0`（`index-v020.js`，当前入口）：见上。

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: Free, dependable web_search and web_fetch for DeepSeek Harness: fused keyless search plus optional Brave, SSRF-safe retrieval with reader escalation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reliable-web

Free, dependable `web_search` and `web_fetch` for DeepSeek Harness — no paid
search API, no required sign-up, no model-specific integration. It plugs into
