plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: Token usage, cost estimation, API balance, usage trends and model share - a dashboard plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 用量看板 · dsh-usage-dashboard

DeepSeek Harness 的桌面端用量可视化看板插件。侧边栏一个图标，点开就是一整页的 Token 用量、费用估算、账户余额、使用趋势和模型占比 —— 所有数字都从你自己的会话日志里实时算出来。

![用量看板](docs/screenshot.png)

## 功能

| 区域 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **读数条** | Token 总量（含调用次数与缓存命中率）、今日费用、本月费用、历史累计费用、API 余额（充值钱包 + 赠送额度；未登录时显示状态而不是报错） |
| **Token 构成** | 堆叠比例条 + 明细表：输入（未命中缓存）/ 输出 / 缓存命中 / 缓存写入，各自数量与占比，底部给出缓存命中率 |
| **模型占比** | 按总 Token 排序的模型份额条，含 Token 数与各模型费用；同一模型跨多个 provider 会自动合并，悬停可看来源 |
| **使用趋势** | 平滑折线（单调三次插值，零用量日不会被画到基线以下）+ 悬浮十字线 + 当日明细卡片；7 / 30 / 90 / 182 天可切换，`←` `→` 逐日移动 |
| **活跃热力图** | 近半年逐日方格，颜色越深用量越大；悬停格子会描边高亮，并在下方图例行原位显示当天明细（浮层不会遮挡网格） |

折线与热力图统一使用 DeepSeek 蓝配色阶 `#dff2fe → #a0dcfd → #60b3fe → #0c70f3`；其余结构与控件全部沿用宿主主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`），亮色/暗色自动跟随。

## 安装

### 安装后长什么样

- 侧边栏底部、设置上方，多出一个柱状图图标
- 点击它，中栏整页变成看板
- 插件管理页里能看到「用量看板」条目及其图标

### 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.x
- Node.js `>= 20`

### 安装方式

**方式一：本地目录安装（推荐，改代码即时生效）**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JeffKeeping/dsh-usage-dashboard.git
```

然后在 Harness 里执行（把路径换成你的实际克隆路径）：

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<绝对路径>/dsh-usage-dashboard
```

或用 CLI：

```bash
dsh plugin install <绝对路径>/dsh-usage-dashboard
```

安装立即生效。若界面还没出现新的侧边栏图标，按 `Ctrl+R` 刷新一次窗口（客户端代码是模块化加载的，刷新后才换成磁盘上的最新版本）。

**方式二：从 npm 安装**

```bash
dsh plugin install dsh-usage-dashboard
```

### 验证安装

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:<你的端口>/dsh-usage-dashboard/snapshot
```

返回 `{"ok":true,...}` 即 Host 半已就绪。首次打开会扫描全部会话日志，通常一两秒；之后走 revision 缓存，只有变动的会话会重读（实测冷读约 800ms，热读约 25ms）。

## 配置

价格表在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，安装后也可在插件管理页修改：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-usage-dashboard
      name: dsh-usage-dashboard
      config:
        historyDays: 182      # 日序列与热力图窗口（折线图从中切片）
        maxSessions: 600      # 最多扫描最近 N 个会话
        pricing:
          currency: CNY
          unit: 1000000       # 单价按「每 N 个 token」计
          default: { miss: 2, hit: 0.2, write: 2, output: 3 }
          models:
            deepseek-v4.1-flash: { miss: 2, hit: 0.2, write: 2, output: 3 }
            deepseek-v4-pro: { miss: 4, hit: 1, write: 4, output: 12 }
```

- 模型键先按 **完全匹配**，再按 **最长前缀** 匹配（`deepseek-v4-pro` 也覆盖 `deepseek-v4-pro-2026`），都不中的落到 `default`
- 费用公式：`(miss × 输入 + hit × 缓存命中 + write × 缓存写入 + output × 输出) / unit`

> ⚠️ 内置单价是**估算的起点**，不是账单。改成你实际付费的价格。看板页脚始终显示当前生效的币种与单位。

### 计费口径

会话日志里的 `TokenUsage` 遵循 Anthropic Messages 语义（DeepSeek 路由走的就是这套协议）：

- `inputTokens` 是**未命中缓存**的输入
- `cacheReadTokens` / `cacheWriteTokens` 是**独立计数**，不是 `inputTokens` 的子集
- `prompt = input + cacheRead + cacheWrite`，`tokens = prompt + output`

## 工作原理

全部数字都从会话日志推导，插件本身不持有事实来源：

```
assistant/message ─┬─ data.usage          → 四类 token 计数
                   └─ data.message.source → provider + model
```

- Host 半通过 `sessionPersistence` 读取日志，按 `SessionPersistenceSnapshot.revision` 做增量缓存（缓存挂在 `Symbol.for` 全局上，HMR 重挂载不会重新全量扫描）
- 只读一个路由：`GET /dsh-usage-dashboard/snapshot[?refresh=1]`，`no-store`
- 客户端只负责渲染，每 60 秒拉一次快照，手动刷新会同时重读账户余额

## 卸载

```
plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-usage-dashboard
```

## 已知限制

- 只统计本进程 `sessionPersistence.list()` 能看到且没有被 `maxSessions` 截断的会话
- 余额需要宿主挂载 `deepseekAccount`；没有时会显示「未启用」而不是失败
- 会话日志若被其他工具归档移走，不会计入

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: DSH prompt optimizer plugin: composer star button that rewrites the current draft in place
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-prompt-optimizer

DeepSeek Harness 桌面端「提示词优化」插件。在对话框右下角、切换大模型按钮的**左侧**加一个**小星星**按钮：点击后调用**当前会话正在使用的模型**，把输入框里已有的提示词改写得更清晰、更可执行，并写回输入框；首次优化之后，星星左侧会出现一个**重新优化**按钮（螺旋箭头），在原结果基础上再改进一次。

- 客户端不直接访问任何模型供应商：它只通过已有的、已鉴权的 Remote 连接调用宿主端方法。
- 没有任何独立状态：提示词读自当前会话的输入框，写回同一个输入框，其余全部是局部变量。

---

## 一、目录结构

```
dsh-plugin-prompt-optimizer/
├── package.json          # 包清单：DSH 双端入口 + 客户端依赖声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 加载器补丁：插入一条 id 为 prompt-optimizer 的条目
├── README.md             # 本文件
└── lib/
    ├── index.js          # 宿主端（Node）：promptOptimizer 服务 + optimize(request, signal) 远程方法
    └── client.js         # 客户端（浏览器）：星星 / 重新优化按钮 + 远程契约声明
```

安装到 DSH 之后，宿主端还会被 pnpm 链接到 profile 的 `node_modules` 下（如
`C:\Users\a2419\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-plugin-prompt-optimizer\`），
那里会多出 pnpm 生成的 `.modules.yaml`/锁文件相关内容，以及真实运行需要的 `node_modules`；插件本身仍然只有上面这几个文件。

## 二、安装与启用

本机环境：DeepSeek Harness 桌面版，profile 名 `desktop`。

```powershell
# 用 Harness 自带的 CLI 安装（推荐：会同时写好依赖与 bundle 列表）
& "D:\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add C:\Users\a2419\.dsh\plugins\dsh-plugin-prompt-optimizer
```

等价的手工方式（本插件当前采用的就是这一种）：把本目录放到
`C:\Users\a2419\.dsh\plugins\dsh-plugin-prompt-optimizer`，然后在
`C:\Users\a2419\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json` 里

1. `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-plugin-prompt-optimizer": "link:C:/Users/a2419/.dsh/plugins/dsh-plugin-prompt-optimizer"`；
2. `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组增加 `"dsh-plugin-prompt-optimizer"`。

> ⚠️ 路径必须是 ASCII。**不要把插件放进带中文的目录再用 `file:`/`link:` 引用**：
> 中文路径在写入 profile 清单时可能被按非 UTF-8 代码页回转，生成无法解析的 JSON，
> 触发 Harness 的原生致命恢复（会把 `cordis.patch.yml` 备份为 `.bak-<毫秒时间戳>`，
> 并把 `dsh.profile.bundles` 重置为只有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`）。

**宿主端改动需要重启 Harness 才会生效**（加载器的插件集合在启动时组装一次）；
客户端 bundle 改动刷新页面即可。

## 三、功能与交互

| 位置 | 控件 | 行为 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `conversation.input.right` 插槽（模型切换按钮左侧） | 星星（`IconSparkleMedium`） | 读取当前输入框草稿 → 让当前模型改写 → `inputActions.setDraft()` 写回 |
| 星星左侧（仅首次优化成功后出现） | 重新优化（`IconRefreshOutlineMedium`） | 把已优化文本连同上一版原文一起送给模型，做第二轮改进 |

禁用规则：

- 草稿为空（`draft.trim() === ""`）或正在请求时，星星禁用；
- 输入框处于 `submitting`（正在提交）或 `adjudicating`（正在裁定）阶段时，两个按钮都禁用——这两种阶段 DSH 会拒绝任何草稿写回；
- 重新优化按钮只在 `original` 与 `optimized` 都已记录后渲染（即至少成功优化过一次）。

过程与结果反馈：请求中图标替换为 `IconLoadingOutlineMedium`；成功/失败信息写在根节点的 `title` 上
（`data-prompt-optimizer="idle|running|done|error"` 便于排查）。文案通过 `locale` 命名空间
`prompt-optimizer` 注册，内置 `zh`/`en`。

## 四、交互流程

```
用户在输入框输入草稿
        │ 点击 ✨
        ▼
lib/client.js  PromptOptimizer.run("optimize")
  ├─ useInput(s => s).draft                    ← 读草稿（InputState）
  ├─ sessions.binding(sessionId)
  │    .session.projections.faceOf("modelSelection").getSnapshot()
  │    → snapshot.next ?? snapshot.lastUsed    ← 当前会话正在用的模型
  ├─ remote.promptOptimizer.optimize({ text, kind, provider, model, reasoningEffort, sessionId })
  │        │  （已鉴权的 /api Remote 调用）
  │        ▼
  │   lib/index.js  PromptOptimizerService.optimize(request, signal)
  │     ├─ validateRequest(request)            非空、≤20000 字符、kind ∈ {optimize, refine}
  │     ├─ resolveRoute(ctx, request)          请求里的模型 → Agents 会话请求头 → agent.options
  │     ├─ ctx.get("llm").stream({ provider, model, messages, system, maxTokens: 4000, reasoningEffort?, sessionId?, signal })
  │     └─ 拼接 text-delta，按 finish.kind 映射错误，剥离整体代码围栏，返回 { text, kind, usage? }
  └─ result.ok === true → inputActions.setDraft(value.text)   ← 写回输入框（仍可继续编辑）
                          setOriginal(text) / setOptimized(value.text) → 出现「重新优化」
```

### 请求字段（`request`）

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | **必填**，要改写的草稿；空/全空白 → `prompt-optimizer/empty-draft`；超过 20000 字符 → `prompt-optimizer/draft-too-long` |
| `kind` | `"optimize" \| "refine"` | 省略时按 `"optimize"`；其他值 → `prompt-optimizer/invalid-request` |
| `provider` / `model` | `string` | 客户端传入的当前模型；宿主端缺失时按 `sessionId` 回退 |
| `reasoningEffort` | `string` | 可选，随当前模型选择一起透传 |
| `sessionId` | `string` | 可选，用于宿主端解析模型路由 |
| `previous` | `string` | `kind: "refine"` 时由客户端自动带上：上一轮优化前的原文 |
| `note` | `string` | 预留：人工补充的修订要求 |
| `history` | `string` | 预留：会话上下文（仅供改写参考，不会续写） |

### 返回值

成功返回 `{ text: string, kind: "optimize" | "refine", usage?: object }`；
Remote 层把异常包成 `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }` 返回给客户端。

### 错误码

| 错误码 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `prompt-optimizer/invalid-request` | `request` 不是对象，或 `kind` 非法 |
| `prompt-optimizer/empty-draft` | 草稿为空 |
| `prompt-optimizer/draft-too-long` | 草稿超过 20000 字符 |
| `prompt-optimizer/no-model` | 既没有请求里的 `provider`/`model`，也无法从会话解析出模型 |
| `prompt-optimizer/no-llm` | 宿主端取不到 `llm` 服务 |
| `prompt-optimizer/model-error` | 模型报错（具体码沿用 `finish.failure.code`） |
| `prompt-optimizer/aborted` | 请求被取消 |
| `prompt-optimizer/max-tokens` | 输出触到 `maxTokens` 上限 |
| `prompt-optimizer/empty-result` | 模型返回空文本 |
| `gateway/cancelled` | 网关侧取消（客户端静默处理，不弹错） |

## 五、技术要点

**宿主端暴露远程方法的机制（SRC 反射式 Remote，无需代码生成、无需 zod）：**

1. `optimize` 必须定义在**类的原型**上，且参数只能是**两个普通标识符**、`signal` **必须在最后**——
   网关通过 `Function.prototype.toString()` 解析参数名（中间件拒绝解构、默认值、剩余参数）。
2. 在原型上手工打标：`Object.defineProperty(PromptOptimizerService.prototype, "@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol/remote-methods", { value: { version: 1, methods: [{ method: "optimize", invocation: { kind: "direct" } }] } })`。
3. 实例上挂协议绑定：`service.typertRemote = Object.freeze({ service, serviceKey: "promptOptimizer", namespace: "promptOptimizer" })`，然后
   `ctx.provide("promptOptimizer", service)`。网关据此认领端点 `promptOptimizer/optimize`。
4. `signal` 是**取消参数**，不算线上字段：网关自己把调用方的 `AbortSignal` 追加为最后一个实参。

**客户端契约**要点（与宿主端一一对应）：

- 客户端 `$mount` 只校验每个参数的 `codec.mode === "strict"`，因此一个六行的
  `{ parse: v => v }` 就足够，**不需要生成 schema，也不需要内联 zod**。
- `parameters` 里**只列业务参数 `request`**；`cancellation: { parameter: "signal" }` 单独声明。
  如果把 `signal` 也写进 `parameters`，`prepareInvocation` 会认为少传一个实参而直接报错。
- 远程命名空间必须先 `$mount` 再注入，且只在**点击时**惰性解析：

  ```js
  const disposeRemote = await ctx.remote.$mount(TYPERT_REMOTE);
  ctx.inject(["slots", "sessions", "locale", "connection"], (scope) => { /* … */ });
  // 组件内：root.get("remote.promptOptimizer") —— 注册时不能提前捕获
  ```

**LLM 调用的硬性约束（`ctx.llm.stream`）：**

- `purpose` 是 `'compaction' | 'session-title'` 的**封闭联合类型**，本插件**不能传**。
- 采样参数只支持 `temperature` / `maxTokens` / `stop`；`reasoningEffort` 可以传。
- 每次流式调用最后必定有一个终结块 `finish`，失败时 `finish.kind` 为 `error`/`aborted`，需要主动抛错。
- 插件取宿主服务要用 `ctx.get("llm")`（`this.ctx.llm` 在本环境不可用）。

## 六、权限与依赖

- 宿主端被 `ctx.provide` 暴露出去的业务面**只有** `optimize` 一个方法；
- 声明了两个对等依赖：`@deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.1`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm ^0.2.0-rc.1`；
- 客户端 bundle 只 `require` 平台种子词 `react` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`，
  其余包（locale / api-gateway / connection / ui-conversation）通过 `dsh.client.inject` 声明为启动图边。

## 七、排错清单

| 现象 | 检查点 |
| --- | --- |
| 输入框右侧没有星星 | 宿主端是否加载：`cordis_inspect` 查宿主服务 `promptOptimizer`；客户端查插槽 `conversation.input.right` 的占用者 `id: "prompt-optimizer"` |
| 点击星星报「远程服务尚未就绪」 | 宿主端未注册（多为改完依赖没重启 Harness）；或 `$mount` 失败 |
| 点击报参数数量错（expected N argument(s)） | `parameters` 与 `optimize(request, signal)` 的数量必须对应：**只列 `request`** |
| 应用起不来 | 看 `%TEMP%\dsh-restart.log` / `%TEMP%\dsh-repair.log`，以及 profile 下是否出现新的 `cordis.patch.yml.bak-*`、`package.json.broken-*`（原生致命恢复的痕迹） |
| 改了客户端不生效 | 刷新页面；改的是宿主端则必须重启 |

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: 功能：可选择会话中的语句，代码段进行标记
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-code-marks

[![test](https://github.com/petex7238/DSH-Tag-Plugin/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/petex7238/DSH-Tag-Plugin/actions/workflows/test.yml)

> Select code or a sentence in a DeepSeek Harness conversation, tag it, and jump back to **that exact line** later — from a rail of deep-blue bars on the conversation's right edge, or from a right-sidebar tab. Marks live outside the transcript, so the next twenty follow-up questions cannot push them away.

在 DSH 对话里**选中一段代码或一句话 → 打个标签**，它就固定下来：对话右边缘长出一根深蓝短条，右侧栏的「标记」页签里也有一条记录。点任意一处，那段原文**瞬时**跳到**可视区正中间**、闪一下并选中。

解决的是这件事：追问一多，正确题解就被顶上去，回看要翻很久。标记存在对话流之外，所以**永远顶不掉**。

- 标注对象：助手回答里的代码段与文字（跨行选也支持）
- 标签自定义：可新建 / 改名 / 换色 / 删除，6 种颜色
- 跳转精确到**字符**，不是"大约回到那条消息"
- 不上传、不同步、不进会话日志：全部存在本机 `localStorage`

## 装上

需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更新（桌面端或 `dsh web`）。

装的是"插件组合包"，所以 DSH 只认 **安装 spec**（不是搜索词）。在桌面端走：侧栏 **插件** → 安装 → 粘贴下面任一 spec；或者用 CLI `dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<spec>"`。**装完不用重启，刷新一次页面即可。**

### 一 · 从 GitHub 装（不需要 npm 账号）

三种写法，效果一样，按你的网络和工具选：

```bash
# 1) git 协议（pnpm 会浅克隆）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:petex7238/DSH-Tag-Plugin#main"

# 2) tarball 直链（没有 git 也能装，https 一次下载）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "https://github.com/petex7238/DSH-Tag-Plugin/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz"

# 3) 下载 ZIP → 解压 → 用本地路径装
#    浏览器打开仓库 → 绿色 Code 按钮 → Download ZIP → 解压到任意目录
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "D:/tools/DSH-Tag-Plugin"
```

三点提醒：

- **网络**：GitHub 装法要能访问 github.com。国内环境下 git 协议还需要给 git 配代理（`git config --global http.proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890`），tarball 直链走的是 https，通常更容易通。
- **固定版本**：把 `#main` 换成 `#<commit sha>` 或 `#v0.1.0` 就不会被后续改动带着跑。
- **更新**：`github:` / tarball 装的不会自动升级，重新执行一次安装命令即可（同一包名会覆盖）。

### 二 · 从 npm 装（发布后可用）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-code-marks
```

或在插件页填 `dsh-code-marks`。npm 的版本号即包版本，升级同样重装一次。

### 三 · 本地路径（改代码 / 开发）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/petex7238/DSH-Tag-Plugin.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "/absolute/path/to/DSH-Tag-Plugin"
```

仓库目录会被 `link` 进 profile，改 `plugin/client.js` 会被客户端 HMR 直接热替换，不用重启 DSH。

### 装完怎么确认

右上/侧栏 **插件** 列表里出现 `dsh-code-marks` 且为启用状态；在对话里选中一段助手回答，右边缘会冒出一根深蓝短条。

## 怎么用

1. 在助手的回答里，用鼠标选中一段代码或一句话（也支持跨行选）。
2. 松手后浮出标签条，点一个标签（`核心逻辑 / 疑问 / 易错点 / 待复习`，或点 `＋` 现建一个）。
3. 松手处冒出一句「已标记「核心逻辑」」，1.5 秒后自己消失；对话右边缘的上部同时长出一根深蓝短条。

**不会自动打开右栏**——标记不该抢你的视线和焦点。确认只发生在原地，要跳回去就点右边那根条。

回到标记有两条路：对话右边缘的**深蓝短条**（不用开右栏，悬停看名称、点击跳转），或右栏「标记」页签里的条目——两者跳的是同一处。

面板关掉以后怎么找回来：右栏页签条的 **添加** 按钮 → 引导页 → 「标记」胶囊。

## 面板里能做什么

| 操作 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 点一条标记 | 跳回原文并居中（旧内容没加载时会自动点「加载更早」把历史拉回来，最多 16 次） |
| 悬停一条标记 | 在对话里临时高亮它（不跳转） |
| 名字（有就显示） | 标签旁边显示你给这条标记起的名字；起名在右边缘长条的右键菜单里 |
| 标签 chip 行 | 按标签筛选，括号里是该标签的条数 |
| 搜索框 | 按选中原文或备注过滤 |
| ✎ | 给这条标记写/改备注（比如「这里为什么要 -1」） |
| × | 删除这条标记 |
| ⚙ | 标签管理：新建、改名、换颜色、删除（删除标签时它的标记会转到第一个标签） |

高亮颜色跟着标签走，6 种颜色可选，深浅色主题都用同一套半透明底色。

## 右边缘的深蓝色短条

对话右边缘的上部会挂一排**深蓝色短条**，一条对应一个标记，从上到下就是对话里的先后顺序。它和 DSH 自己那条"轮次刻度"是同一套形状（20×2 圆角、10px 节距、右对齐），所以看起来是对话的一部分，不是外挂。

- **不用打开右栏**：鼠标挪过去就能用，点击直接跳到那段原文（该翻页会自己翻）。
- **悬停**：左边浮出小卡片，显示标签名、原文前几行、第几轮；同时对话里那一段会亮起来，方便确认是不是你要找的那条。
- **右键菜单**：在长条上点右键弹出小菜单——「跳转到这条标记」「重命名名称」「删除这条标记」。**右键本身不删任何东西**，误触只是弹个菜单；真删掉后还有 5 秒「撤销」兜底。键盘也通：Tab 聚焦长条后按 `Delete`/`Backspace`（同样有撤销）。
- **给标记起名**：菜单里选「重命名名称」，会就地变成一格输入框，回车保存、`Esc` 取消（留空则回到显示原文）。名字只属于这一条标记——标签（`核心逻辑` 等）是全组共用的，名字是你给它的备注标题。起了名字之后，悬停小卡片和右栏面板都优先显示名字。
- **不会打架**：长条只占对话列上部约 42% 的高度，标记多了在轨道内部滚动；右栏开合、窗口缩放时它会跟着对话列移动。
- 当前会话一条标记都没有时，整排长条不出现。

这两个浮层（框选后弹出的标签条、长条悬停出的小卡片）固定用 **`#232324` 深底 + 浅色字**，不跟随主题：深色浮层在浅色页面上更抓眼，浅色主题下也不会变成白底黑字看不清。文字对比度都在 4.5:1 以上（正文 7:1 以上）。

## 数据与隐私

都在这台机器的浏览器存储里（`localStorage`），不上传、不进会话日志、不产生任何网络请求：

- `dsh.code.marks.v2.<sessionId>`：这个会话的标记（原文、位置、标签、备注、时间）
- `dsh.code.marks.v1.tags`：标签表（全局共享，所有会话通用）

每个会话的标记互相独立；换会话就看那个会话的标记。清空：清站点数据，或删掉这两个 key。

插件本身**没有 Host 半侧逻辑**：`plugin/index.mjs` 是一个空 `apply()`，只为了让 DSH 有一个可加载的 Loader 条目、从而把浏览器半侧的 bundle 发出去。

## 它是怎么做到「跳得准」的

一条标记不存 DOM 节点（React 会重渲染、代码块会从 plain 换成高亮版、流式输出一直在追加），只存四样东西：

1. `data-chat-node-key` / `data-chat-anchor-key`：这条消息在对话里的身份（原样存，不解析）
2. 消息内文本偏移 + 选中的原文
3. 前后各 48 个字符的上下文
4. `data-chat-turn`：第几轮（兜底用）

解析时按四级降级：精确锚点 → 同 node 的行 → 精确原文 → 上下文打分（含「空白全部忽略」的兜底，所以重新缩进的代码也能认出来）。

高亮用 **CSS Custom Highlight API**（`CSS.highlights` + `::highlight()`），只建 Range 不改 DOM，所以不会被 React 的 diff 冲掉；对话变化时以 240ms 去抖重建 Range。

跳转是按"标记文本的 Range"算的，不是按消息行：一条长回答可以几千像素高，行居中会让人"跳过去却看不见"。落点对齐到对话可视带的中线（扣掉底部输入框占位），并且**瞬时**完成、不做滚动动画。

## 已知限制

- **折叠起来的过程组**里的文字选不到；要先展开它。标记落在被折叠的内容里时，点标记会尝试点开那个组，失败则提示「先往上滚一点」。
- 原文被改写（比如重新生成过这条回答）到认不出来的程度时，只能定位到这条消息，高亮位置对不上——面板会明确提示，不会瞎标。
- 跳转是程序化滚动，DSH 会认为「读者自己滚了」，于是暂停「跟随最新」；对话自己跳轮次也是这样。
- 只对**助手的回答**（`assistant-step`）开放标记；工具调用、终端输出暂不支持。
- 标记只存在本机浏览器，不跨设备同步；也没有导出/导入。

## 卸载

DSH 设置 → 插件 → 找到 `dsh-code-marks` → 停用或卸载。卸载后浏览器里的标记数据仍在，重装即回来。

## 开发

插件是**手写的浏览器 bundle**，没有构建步骤：`plugin/client.js` 就是一个 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 的经典脚本，DSH 的模块系统直接发它。

```bash
npm install          # 只为测试台装 puppeteer-core
npm test             # 108 项断言，headless Chrome
```

测试台 `tools/harness/` 用一份合成的对话 DOM 跑真实 Chromium，覆盖：锚定与四级降级、重复原文、代码块 plain→Shiki 换 DOM、流式追加、翻页、悬浮标签条、边缘长条（含右键菜单/重命名/撤销）、深色浮层对比度、跳转居中与瞬时落位、面板渲染。

- `CHROME_PATH` 可指定浏览器；否则自动找 Chrome/Edge/Chromium。
- 没有 `puppeteer-core` 时会退而使用 DSH profile 里已有的那一份（需要 `DSH_HOME` + `DSH_PROFILE`）。
- `设计说明.md` 记录了每个设计决策的理由与验证矩阵（中文）。

### 发布（维护者）

包名 `dsh-code-marks`，`publishConfig.access` 已是 `public`。两条路，选一条：

**A. 本机发**（需要先 `npm login`）：

```bash
npm publish
```

**B. 让 GitHub 代发**（本机网络/登录不顺时用这条）：

1. 在 npmjs.com 生成 **Automation** 类型 token（不会弹 OTP），权限 Read and write；
2. 仓库 → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → 新建 secret `NPM_TOKEN`；
3. 发一个 GitHub Release，或手动跑 `publish` workflow。

`publish` workflow 会先 `npm pack --dry-run` 打印将发布的文件清单，再 `npm publish`；版本冲突时 npm 会直接报错。

发新版：`npm version patch`（或 minor/major）→ push → 再走上面任一方式。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: VeriScope 离线门禁重放 · DSH 插件
plugins.readme_text:
# VeriScope 门禁重放

**中文** · [English](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/README.en.md) · [日本語](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/README.ja.md) · [한국어](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/README.ko.md)

**给 AI 回答质量做发布门禁**：判定一批已经评测过的结果能不能发布，并留下可复验的回执。

- **两条通道**：重放 VeriScope 归档（调原 Python 门禁）；或仅用 Node 对任意已有逐条评分做阈值判定——不需要 VeriScope、Python 或 pandas
- **三态**：通过／失败／待复核。待复核永不转为通过，已确认失败不被附加异常掩盖
- **回执**：绑定输入、策略、判定器与环境；条件一变，旧结论自动失效
- **不评分、不调用模型**：只消费已有结果，不重新评测

[GitHub](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope) · [Gitee 手动镜像](https://gitee.com/kkbushishou/dsh-plugin-veriscope) · 完整 VeriScope：[主仓库](https://github.com/4444wjt/RAG_Evaluation_Demo)／[镜像](https://gitee.com/kkbushishou/rag-hallucination-evaluator)。Issue 和 PR 请提交到 GitHub。

## 支持哪些宿主

| 宿主 | 形态 | 怎么接入 |
|---|---|---|
| **DSH** | 插件（cordis bundle） | `dsh plugin --profile <名称> add dsh-plugin-veriscope` |
| **Claude Code** | MCP server | `claude mcp add --transport stdio --env VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR=<目录> -- node <绝对路径>/mcp.js` |
| **Codex** | MCP server | `config.toml` 内加 `[mcp_servers.veriscope]` |
| **无宿主 / CI** | CLI | `veriscope-check --archive … --policy …` |

DSH、Claude Code、Codex 三种宿主均有实测调用记录；MCP 与 CLI 不提供 `bind`／`complete` 与原生结果卡。配置示例见 [MCP 接入说明](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/MCP.md)。

> **升级提示（0.4.0 起）**：旧回执的当前有效性将进入 REVIEW，历史 PASS／FAIL 不会改写。升级前请备份完整状态目录及原归档，并使用插件外的持久状态目录；包内 `.local` 可能随重装丢失，单独导出回执不是完整备份。ReceiptV1 重新 replay，ReceiptV2 重新 check，取得新版回执。

---

下方“原 VeriScope 路径”及其 Python 说明仅适用于 replay。

支持原 VeriScope 归档，以及 B2 的 GateArchiveV1 和指定 Ragas records 布局。不支持的格式明确拒绝，不猜测或换算。

## 已有评分直接用：B2（0.6.0 本地候选）

已经用 Ragas 得到了评分？导出评分 JSON，写明要检查的指标和阈值，让插件执行门禁并保存回执。**无需安装 VeriScope，也不会重新调用模型评分。**

只需 Node ≥22.19，在宿主启动前显式设置 `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR` 为可写持久目录。没有 settings UI，不读取 `.env`。B2 不使用 VeriScope／Python 路径。

> 使用 `veriscope_gate_check` 检查 `D:\data\scores.json`，策略为 `D:\data\policy.json`，格式为 `ragas-records-v1`，告诉我是否通过和原因。

源码可直接试构造样例：

```powershell
$env:VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR = 'D:\your-data\veriscope-state'
node scripts/check.mjs --archive examples/builtin/ragas-records.json --policy examples/builtin/policy.json --format ragas-records-v1 --json
```

- 支持 `GateArchiveV1` 和 Ragas `result.to_pandas().to_json(orient="records")` 布局；策略显式选择 `GatePolicyV1` 或 `GatePolicyV2`，不猜测字段或阈值。
- 对全部输入记录算等权均值；缺失值不补零、不跳过。完整均值不达标，或已知有效行违反显式逐条阈值，为 FAIL；其余缺证据为 REVIEW，全部完整达标才 PASS。
- 不把 `faithfulness` 改成 `pos_faithfulness`；B2 的 PASS 不等同原门禁，不证明评分或回答事实正确，也不检查导出前被删掉的记录。
- DSH／MCP 都提供 check；CLI 安装后的命令为 `veriscope-check`。`doctor({engine:"builtin"})` 不探测 Python；status／list 支持两种回执。
- B2 使用 ReceiptV2，首版只有文本，不接入 bind／complete；DSH 导出支持 JSON／Markdown，B2 暂不支持 share。回执仍无限保留，不自动清理。

**均值通过，仍可看到最差一条。** 每指标显示最差有效行及未达均值阈值的条数；诊断本身不改裁决。需要逐条拦截时，用 `GatePolicyV2` 加 `row_threshold`，沿用该指标的方向和单位。例如构造分数的均值为 0.81、其中一条为 0.41：只查均值可 PASS，显式要求每条 ≥0.5 才 FAIL。V2 使用 JSON 原数字词元作精确十进制比较；V1 原浮点判定保持不变。

规范、策略和导出方式见包内 `docs/B2.md`、`schemas/`、`examples/builtin/`。样例为文档构造，非真实评测。0.6.0 已发布至 npm；Windows 与 Ubuntu 远端 CI（含固定上游真实回放）均已验证，Claude 完整结构化错误交付仍待验。0.5.0 历史验收保留在 `docs/acceptance-b2-v0.5.0.json`。

## 原 VeriScope 路径：配置后上手

配置好环境后（见下一节），在 DSH 中依次输入：

1. “使用 `veriscope_doctor` 检查本机环境，告诉我需要修复什么。”
2. “使用 VeriScope 检查 `D:\数据\评测结果.json`，说明是否通过及原因。”
3. “使用 `veriscope_gate_list` 列出最近的门禁回执与当前有效性。”

之后还可以说：

> 检查上次的门禁结果现在是否仍然有效。

体检的“环境就绪”仅表示环境可用，门禁通过需实际重放。聊天能否自动选中工具取决于 DSH 的模型配置；需要时直接写出工具名。

三个常见的小场景：

- **想发给维护者**：“把这次门禁失败整理成可分享的求助摘要。”使用 `format: "share"` 生成本地 Markdown，先预览、再自行分享；不是回执。
- **归档打不开**：重放会在能确认时给出异常行列或字段位置，帮助定位；不会自动改文件。
- **昨天通过、今天待复核**：状态检查会列出已确认的阈值、版本、输入摘要等变化；无法核实的范围明确保留。

需要约束任务完成时，可以要求绑定本次检查；只有绑定的回执当前有效且为 PASS，才能登记完成。

**使用前请配置 VeriScope 与 Python 路径；插件不会重新调用评测模型。**

## 安装与配置

本文对应 **0.6.0 本地候选**，提供 DSH 插件和独立的 `veriscope-mcp` 入口。npm 可用版本以[包页面](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-veriscope)为准；MCP 配置与待验范围见下文。在已验证的 DSH CLI 中，需显式指定 profile；以下使用独立的 `veriscope-demo`：

```powershell
# 安装
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add dsh-plugin-veriscope
# 查看已安装版本
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo list dsh-plugin-veriscope --depth 0
# 卸载
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo remove dsh-plugin-veriscope
```

二次开发可走**本地目录安装**，与 npm 包名安装分开：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add 'D:\your-workspace\dsh-plugin-veriscope'
```

以上目录路径须替换为源码实际位置；不要将目录／link 安装结果当成 registry 安装证明。**安装成功不等于门禁通过**，原 replay 首次使用需配置 `VERISCOPE_ROOT` 与 `VERISCOPE_PYTHON` 并运行体检；只用 B2 则仅配置状态根。npm 包不含测试；同包包含 `docs/B2.md`、格式规范和 B2 样例，其余文档见仓库；`npm test` 仅供源码开发；`node scripts/verify-replay.mjs` 也仅在完整源码仓库及其验证材料就绪时可用，不属于安装包能力。完整文档请查看仓库。

0.3.x 历史已验证：Windows、DSH NEXT 2.0.18-next，内部 DSH／tools／skill **0.2.1-alpha.2**。Node ≥22.19；其他宿主版本未验证。另需兼容上游及 Python／pandas，固定依赖见 [上游说明](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md)。插件不附送完整上游或业务归档。

DSH 入口要求 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 为 `0.2.1-alpha.2`，加载前核对版本，加载后检查 `defineTool`。缺失、不兼容、加载失败分别报 `SDK_MISSING`、`SDK_INCOMPATIBLE`、`SDK_LOAD_FAILED`，不会自动安装或切换版本；这些检查不代替宿主验收。MCP 不加载 DSH SDK。

### 配置项

**没有 settings UI，不自动读取 `.env`。** 路径只读宿主进程环境变量；cordis patch 只接受 `completionMode`。宿主自己的环境加载策略由宿主决定。

| 配置 | 入口 | 默认值与要求 |
|---|---|---|
| `veriscopeRoot` | `VERISCOPE_ROOT` | Windows 默认 `D:\RAG_Evaluation_Demo`；POSIX 必须显式设置 |
| `pythonPath` | `VERISCOPE_PYTHON` | 依次探测 `.venv`／`venv`：Windows 为 `Scripts/python.exe`，POSIX 为 `bin/python`；不回退 PATH |
| 状态根 | `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR` | 原 DSH replay 默认 `<插件目录>/.local`；B2 和所有 MCP 工具必须显式设置持久目录 |
| 提醒模式 | cordis patch `completionMode` | `off`；只允许 `off` 或 `remind`，非法值报错 |

三个环境变量的显式值须为非空绝对路径，无效值不静默回退。在**启动 DSH 的同一终端**设置后启动或完全重启宿主：

```powershell
$env:VERISCOPE_ROOT = 'D:\your-workspace\VeriScope'
$env:VERISCOPE_PYTHON = 'D:\your-workspace\VeriScope\venv\Scripts\python.exe'
$env:VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR = 'D:\your-data\veriscope-state'
# 若从 GitHub 安装，可用此命令替代前文的 npm 安装命令
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add github:4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope
```

先准备独立 profile 和对应宿主 CLI；安装命令不创建完整宿主配置。插件 bundle 已插入默认条目；在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<名称>/cordis.patch.yml` 按已有 `id` 覆盖配置，不要再次 `insert`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-veriscope
  config:
    completionMode: "remind"
```

`off` 关闭停止事件提醒，全部工具仍可使用。`remind` 只提醒未完成的绑定任务，不承诺普通聊天全局阻断。路径不能写入这个 config。

## 跨宿主 MCP

MCP 仍为五个工具；V2 策略复用 check／status／list，不增加入口。0.5.0 历史实调用与未验范围见 `docs/acceptance-b2-v0.5.0.json`，不替代本候选验证。以下仅回顾 0.4.0 历史验收。

0.4.0 已在独立 Claude Code／Codex 宿主通过真实工具调用（控制接口，无模型对话），Windows 与 Ubuntu 真实回放均已验证。Claude 错误路径只返回文本，完整结构化交付仍有待验项，详见验收记录。使用绝对 Node 路径启动源码 `mcp.js`，配置及独立环境示例见 [MCP 接入说明](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/MCP.md)。无需加载 DSH SDK。首版只有 `veriscope_doctor`、`veriscope_gate_replay`、`veriscope_gate_status`、`veriscope_gate_list` 四工具，无原生卡片。batch／export 及 bind／complete 仍只在 DSH；会话绑定不会移植，MCP 报告的 `execution.session_id` 为 `null`。

当前 MCP 五工具都要求显式、合法的 `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR`；未设置时返回待复核，不回退包目录。doctor 会写入并清理临时探针，replay 会写报告和回执，二者及新增 check 不是只读；status／list 为只读。业务 FAIL 不等于工具执行错误。宿主工具调用、Linux 真实回放及本版本验收状态以 [验收记录](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/acceptance-mcp-v0.4.0.json) 为准；注册成功或自写客户端通过不能替代宿主验收。

## 九个工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `veriscope_gate_check({archive_path, policy_path, format?})` | Node 独立阈值判定；消费已有逐条评分，生成 ReceiptV2，不需要 Python |
| `veriscope_doctor({engine?})` | 默认检查原 replay 环境；`engine:"builtin"` 只检查 Node 和显式状态根，附修复建议 |
| `veriscope_gate_replay({result_path, baseline?, faith?, ctx?})` | 实际执行已有归档门禁，保存独立记录，符合条件时生成 ReceiptV1 |
| `veriscope_gate_status({run_id, faith?, ctx?, baseline_run_id?})` | 只读检查回执当前有效性，不重放、不评分、不生成回执 |
| `veriscope_gate_list({limit?})` | 默认列出最近 50 条，允许 1–200；逐条复用 status，损坏记录另列 |
| `veriscope_gate_batch({paths?, dir?, baseline?, faith?, ctx?})` | 路径数组与目录二选一；顺序重放，最多 200 份，可取消，逐份留痕 |
| `veriscope_gate_export({run_id?, run_ids?, format})` | 导出 1–50 条记录到状态根 `exports/`；`share` 为白名单求助摘要，`md` 为完整报告，`json` 为原回执；不覆盖旧文件 |
| `veriscope_gate_bind({task_id, run_id, faith?, ctx?, baseline_run_id?})` | 在宿主提供的本会话内绑定受管任务与当前回执 |
| `veriscope_gate_complete({task_id, run_id})` | 复验本会话绑定，只在当前有效 PASS 下登记完成 |

### 参数与使用规则

- 原 replay 阈值默认 0.8，须为 0–1 有限数值，不为获得 PASS 自动调低。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: shows the DeepSeek account's remaining balance in the composer bottom bar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-account-balance-pill

A [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that shows the remaining balance of the signed-in DeepSeek account in the composer bottom bar — the stat row under the message box that already carries `N turns · M steps`, tokens/s, token usage and the context ring.

```
[welcome icon] 余额 ¥12.34        [stats] 1 轮 160 步 · 254 tok/s     [usage] 10.9M tok · 缓存命中 98%   (ring) 9%
```

The pill shows the **total spendable balance** (topped-up + granted) per currency, e.g. `余额 ¥17.34`; hovering it breaks the total down into topped-up and granted amounts, shows when it was last refreshed, and reminds you that a click refreshes it.

- Package name: `dsh-account-balance-pill`
- Shape: one DSH **bundle** — a Host row inserted by `dsh.bundle.patch` plus a Web Client half; no dependencies, no build step
- Rendering: a single entry (id `account-balance`) in the slot `conversation.composer.dock`, next to the shipped `activity` and `usage` pills
- Data: the account Remote that ships with DSH (`ctx.get('remote.account').getBalance(...)`, the same call the **Settings → Account** panel makes). The plugin stores nothing, reads no credential file, and makes no network request of its own.

## Install / 安装

Install from GitHub into the profile you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:azkbzxf/dsh-account-balance-pill
```

A newly added bundle activates on the running instance (the Host row is live immediately and the Client half hot-loads into the open page). Replacing an already-installed copy needs a DSH restart for the fresh client build.

Inside DSH Desktop you can also use the plugin manager:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "D:\\path\\to\\dsh-account-balance-pill" }
```

Remove:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-account-balance-pill
```

## What it shows / 显示规则

| Account state | Bottom bar |
| --- | --- |
| Signed in with a balance | Wallet icon + `余额 ¥12.34`; tooltip with the topped-up / granted breakdown, last-update time and a click-to-refresh hint |
| Signed out, or no account grant (the Remote returns `null`) | Nothing — no placeholder, no error |
| Read failure (offline, host refused) | Keeps the last known value, dimmed as stale; stays hidden if no value was ever read |
| Currencies | `¥` for CNY and `$` for USD; topped-up + granted are combined per currency, CNY first |

Amounts are formatted by truncating to cents, matching the official Settings page so the pill never shows more money than is actually available; thousands are grouped. `0` shows `¥0.00`, anything under one cent shows `<¥0.01`.

## Refresh / 刷新时机

1. immediately when the pill mounts;
2. every 30 s while the page is visible (skipped while hidden, one catch-up read when it becomes visible again);
3. 1.5 s after a turn completes (when the `sessionStats` projection's `steps` changes);
4. when the window regains focus or the page becomes visible (only if the data is older than 15 s);
5. as soon as a late-loading account Remote appears;
6. on click.

One request is in flight at a time, requests are at least 3 s apart, and failures back off exponentially from 4 s up to 60 s before recovering automatically.

## Compatibility / 兼容性

- Targets the DSH Web GUI (the browser UI shared by DSH Desktop and `dsh web`), verified on DSH Desktop 2.0.18 with client `0.2.1-rc.2`.
- Uses only supported extension points: the list slot `conversation.composer.dock` and the shipped account Remote. It never replaces or edits existing UI, never reads another plugin's DOM or styles, never appends to `document.body`.
- Styles use Harness theme tokens only (`--dsw-*` / `--dsh-*`), so light/dark themes and font-size changes are inherited. All visible text goes through the DSH client locale service (zh/en) and follows the interface language.
- Every dependency is optional: no account Remote → the plugin loads and stays hidden; a read failure keeps the last value; a render failure is caught by an error boundary scoped to this one entry, so the rest of the dock is unaffected.
- The account service is read through the service registry (`ctx.get('remote.account')`) because the `ctx.remote.account` property chain is only readable from contexts that declare that dependency explicitly.
- `package.json` exports `"./package.json"` because DSH's client-module composition locates the package manifest through that export, and the `dsh.bundle.patch` row `name` matches the package name.
- The Host half is a no-op: it registers no credential, network client, tool or session resource.

## Configuration / 可调参数

The poll interval can be overridden globally (milliseconds, clamped to 5 s – 1 h):

```js
window.__DSH_ACCOUNT_BALANCE__ = { intervalMs: 60000 };
```

## Development / 开发

`test/harness.mjs` is an offline smoke test: it loads `client.js` with stub React/document/locale/slots/remote implementations and asserts the slot registration, locale namespace, request metadata, formatting, hidden/stale states and timer counts.

```sh
node test/harness.mjs client.js
```

File map: `client.js` — Client half (pill, store, formatting, styles); `index.js` — no-op Host half; `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch; `locale/{en,zh}.json` — display metadata for the plugin list; `icon.svg` — artwork.

## Known limitations / 已知限制

- The balance comes from the DeepSeek account platform and is up to a few seconds behind, not ledger-real-time.
- The dock row only renders while a session's composer is visible (existing behaviour of the shipped slot).
- If the platform keeps failing while signed in, the plugin keeps backing off and logs one console warning on the first failure; it never opens a dialog.

## License

MIT.

plugins.description: Live Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: read the document the user has open in Word/Excel/PowerPoint, screenshot the app window, and edit it in place through COM.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-office-live

Live Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: read, screenshot and edit **the document the user
currently has open** in Word / Excel / PowerPoint — no file round-trips, no "close and
reopen", the change appears in the window the user is looking at.

Unlike `dsh-office-tools` (which reads and writes `.docx`/`.xlsx`/`.pptx` files), this plugin
attaches to the **running Office application** through COM and works on the live document —
including whatever the user has typed since the file was saved.

## Demo

A live Word window after `office_live_edit` appended two sections and a table — the change is
already on screen, nothing was saved:

![live Word edit](docs/images/word-live.png)

Excel: `office_live_read` returned the evaluated formula values, then `excel.set_cell` wrote a
new "备注" column into the open workbook:

![live Excel edit](docs/images/excel-live.png)

PowerPoint: `ppt.set_text` rewrote the bullet list and `ppt.add_slide` added the second slide:

![live PowerPoint edit](docs/images/powerpoint-live.png)

> How it is built (three layers, the JSON bridge, why results go through a UTF-8 side file,
> why edits are not saved by default): **[docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md](docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md)** (in Chinese).

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `office_live_status` | Which of Word / Excel / PowerPoint is running and which documents are open |
| `office_live_read` | Read live contents as JSON (Word paragraphs + styles, Excel cells with evaluated formulas, PowerPoint shapes) |
| `office_live_shot` | PNG screenshot of the application window (ribbon and page) |
| `office_live_snapshot` | `read` + `shot` in one call — best starting point before editing |
| `office_live_edit` | Batch live edits (paragraphs, find/replace, tables, cells, slides) |
| `office_live_open` | Open a file in the real application so edits are visible on screen |
| `office_live_close` | Close the window (optionally saving) |

`office_live_edit` operations:

- Word — `word.append_paragraph`, `word.insert_paragraph_before`, `word.set_paragraph`,
  `word.replace`, `word.insert_table`, `word.insert_page_break`
- Excel — `excel.set_cell`, `excel.set_range`, `excel.add_sheet`
- PowerPoint — `ppt.set_text`, `ppt.add_slide`

## Requirements

- Windows with a desktop Microsoft Office installation (COM ProgIDs `Word.Application`,
  `Excel.Application`, `PowerPoint.Application`). Tested with Office LTSC 2024.
- Windows PowerShell 5.1+ (`powershell.exe`); override with the `OFFICE_LIVE_POWERSHELL`
  environment variable (for example `pwsh.exe`).
- Maybe counter-intuitive but real Office only. Microsoft Store "Office" stubs and web
  versions expose no COM automation; WPS Office uses different ProgIDs.

## Safety

- Attaches to an **already running** instance; it never creates a hidden copy of a document.
- Edits are **not saved** unless `save: true` is passed, so the user can review the change
  in the window, undo it with Ctrl+Z, or ask for more changes first.
- Word reads are capped at the first 400 paragraphs; Excel reads the active sheet's used
  range up to 200 rows × 40 columns.
- Taking a screenshot brings the window to the foreground (it steals focus for a moment).

## Install

```bash
# from the plugin market UI: add  dsh-office-live
# or from a checkout / tarball:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-office-live-0.1.0.tgz
```

Then restart DSH. The tools appear in every new session.

## How it is wired

`lib/index.js` registers the seven tools with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and shells out to
`assets/office-live.ps1`, passing `-ResultFile` (a UTF-8 side file, so Chinese text is not
mangled by the Windows console code page). The script does the COM and screenshot work and
prints one JSON object per call.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH PTC run_code parse-error position plugin (line + code frame)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ptc-parse-frame

> 给 DSH 的 PTC（Programmatic Tool Calling）补上「解析失败时的行号 + 代码框」。

## 这是什么

在 DSH 里，`run_code` 的程序在执行前会先经过 TypeScript 类型剥离
（`stripTypeScriptTypes`）。语法出错时，DSH 只把 `error.message` 转发给模型，
丢掉了错误栈里的行号和 `^^^` 代码框。于是漏一个逗号只会得到：

    code run failed (exception): Expected ',', got 'string literal'

模型不知道是哪一行、哪个字符串列表漏了，只能整段重吐重试。

本仓库提供一个 Host 插件，把这段位置信息补回去（真实结果还会带运行时自己的
`File sandbox:` 行，插件把代码框插在解析消息之后、这些后缀之前）：

    Error: code run failed (exception): Expected ',', got 'string literal'
    run_code.ts:1
    const a = ["x" "y"];
                   ^^^
    File sandbox: workspace-write.

## 状态

**0.2.0 已实现并安装。** 这是一个 Host-only 的 profile bundle：

- 监听 `tools/post-execute`，只在 `run_code` 的解析失败上改写结果；
- 自带 23 个单元测试，覆盖行号、代码框、运行时异常、幂等、配置与回退；
- 已通过 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 安装到 `desktop` profile；
- 端到端用例已在 PTC 会话中通过（用例 1–5、13，见 docs/verification.md）。

## 安装

仓库目录本身就是 bundle 根目录（`package.json` 声明了
`dsh.bundle.patch`）。首选官方入口：

    plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <本仓库绝对路径>

安装会：

1. 把本目录作为 `link:` 依赖加入 profile；
2. 把 `dsh-ptc-parse-frame` 加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`；
3. 立即应用 bundle patch（`patchReload: live`）。

卸载：

    plugin_manager  action: remove_bundle  target: dsh-ptc-parse-frame

> 修改 `index.js` 之后，需要让 Host 做一次 profile recomposition（例如
> 开关一次 bundle）或重启 DSH NEXT，运行中的进程才会加载新的模块版本。

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 的默认行：

    - insert:
        - id: ptc-parse-frame
          name: dsh-ptc-parse-frame
          config:
            enabled: true
            maxFrameLines: 10
            sourceName: run_code.ts

| 配置 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 设为 `false` 时插件完全 no-op（但保持已安装）。 |
| `maxFrameLines` | `10` | 代码框正文的最大行数（1–40），优先保留 caret 附近的行。 |
| `sourceName` | `run_code.ts` | 行号前缀，也是「已经带位置」检测用的名字。 |

## 行为边界

插件只在以下条件**同时**成立时改写结果：

1. 工具名是 `run_code`；
2. 结果 `isError: true`；
3. 工具参数里有原始 `code`；
4. 错误消息以 `code run failed (exception): <parser message>` 开头；
5. 用与运行时相同的包装重新解析原始 `code` 仍然失败，且解析器消息与第 4 步一致；
6. 结果文本里还没有 `run_code.ts:<数字>` 形式的位置。

任一条件不满足就原样返回。运行时异常（例如 `throw new Error("boom")`）的程序
能正常解析，因此不会被误判；其它工具的结果完全不经过改写。

插件自身抛错时返回下游 listener 的原始 decision，绝不改变失败原因。

## 兼容性

| 版本 | 形态 | 本仓库是否适用 |

| DSH Desktop 2.0.17（PTC 0.2.0-rc.2） | resources/app 解包 | 旧方案：文件补丁（legacy，见 docs/compatibility.md） |
| DSH NEXT 2.0.19-next（PTC 0.2.1-rc.2） | resources/app.asar + profile 插件 | **本插件** |

## 开发与测试

无运行时依赖，测试直接使用 Node 24 的 `node:module.stripTypeScriptTypes`：

    npm test

等价于：

    node test/plugin.test.mjs

`node --test` 在 DSH 沙箱里会因为测试运行器需要 spawn 子进程而报 `EPERM`，
所以脚本直接运行测试文件（`node:test` 在单文件模式下进程内执行）。

# dsh-delete-archived

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin to permanently delete **archived** conversations.

[中文](README.zh.md)

## What it does

- **Host side** (`lib/entry.js`) registers two HTTP routes and one agent tool:
  - `POST /plugin/dsh-delete-archived/delete` with `{ "sessionId": "..." }`
  - `GET  /plugin/dsh-delete-archived/list`
  - Tool `delete_archived_conversation(sessionId)` — callable by the assistant in a conversation.
  - Deletion removes the session's JSONL storage directory (all format generations) and clears
    the workspace registry: the archive marker, the pin marker, and each workspace's session
    accounting. Sessions that are not archived, or still resident in memory, are refused (a live
    session would rewrite its log on the next flush and resurrect the data).
- **Client side** (`lib/client.js`) adds a "Delete conversation" entry to the per-session "..." menu
  in the sidebar, shown **only for archived sessions** (two-step confirm, inline error on refusal).

## Difference from dsh-archived-chats

The community index already lists `dsh-archived-chats`, which also lists and permanently
removes archived conversations. This plugin does not re-implement that capability: the
increment here is (a) a "Delete conversation" row in the sidebar's per-session "..." menu for
archived sessions only, and (b) the model-callable `delete_archived_conversation` tool. If you
only need bulk cleanup, `dsh-archived-chats` is the smaller dependency.

## Destructive tool

`delete_archived_conversation` is **model-invocable**: the assistant can call it without any
second confirmation. It removes the session's JSONL directory and its workspace registry
entries, and the deletion cannot be undone. The sidebar entry is the human-confirmed path
(two-step confirm); treat the tool as an automation-level capability and keep it out of
workflows you do not want deleting archived sessions on their own.

## Behavior notes

- Only **archived** sessions can be deleted; archive a session first.
- Deletion is serialized per session. Being still held by the host is not a reason to refuse:
  archiving already stopped the agent and the host's `ArchivedSessionGate` refuses further steps,
  so the log is no longer written; the response reports `heldAtDelete` as evidence.
- The session-search index in this deployment is `:memory:`/`openAt: never`, so no index cleanup is
  needed; deployments that enable content search clean up the SQLite rows automatically on the next search.
- Content-addressed image attachments may be shared across sessions and are intentionally not reference-counted.

## Install

```sh
# Local directory — quit the Desktop app first; --profile is required.
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <absolute/path/to/this/dir>

# From GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-delete-archived
```

Then restart Harness so the new bundle composes. This package has **zero runtime dependencies** and
ships plain JavaScript, so a GitHub install needs no `allowBuilds` code-execution approval.

## License

MIT

# dsh-relay-reasoning

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Real reasoning levels — **off / low / medium / high / max** — on every model of your OpenAI-compatible relay, right in the DSH model picker.

## The problem

Relays such as a self-hosted gateway fronting many models accept the `reasoning_effort` request parameter, but DSH offers no reasoning control for them. The reason is structural: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` only publishes selectable levels for a model whose `reasoningEfforts` field declares them, so a route configured by hand shows nothing.

Declaring those levels by hand means repeating seven lines for every model — and re-doing it whenever the model list changes.

## What this plugin does

On activation it writes `reasoningEfforts` into the `llm-pi-ai` profile entry for every model on the configured providers, and the picker immediately offers those levels. No restart, and no editing of your model list.

## Why these five levels

pi-ai understands seven levels, but a relay does not distinguish all of them. Measured over three prompts and two passes on one relay route, median reasoning tokens per level:

| Level | median reasoning tokens |
|---|---|
| off | 0 |
| minimal | 108 |
| low | 122 |
| medium | 155 |
| high | 142 |
| xhigh | 125 |
| max | 359 |

`max` is roughly double every other level, so it is a genuinely stronger tier and is included by default.

The five middle levels (`minimal` through `xhigh`) land within each other's noise on this route, so publishing them would only duplicate choices. They stay out by default but can be requested through `levels` if a route of yours does distinguish them.

If your relay turns out to ignore `max`, drop it with `levels: [off, low, medium, high]` so the picker does not offer a level that does nothing.

## Install

From the DSH workshop (Settings → Workshop → Plugins), or directly:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle → dsh-relay-reasoning
```

Development builds can also be installed from a checkout:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle → <path to this repository>
```

## Configuration

The plugin row takes an optional config:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: relay-reasoning
      name: dsh-relay-reasoning
      config:
        target: llm-pi-ai                 # profile entry id to configure
        providers: []                     # empty = every provider on that entry
        levels: [off, low, medium, high, max]  # published levels, ascending
        force: false                      # true = rewrite even if already correct
        debugLog: ""                      # optional file path for diagnostics
```

`providers: []` means the plugin covers every provider on the entry, so adding a new relay needs no plugin change.

`levels` defaults to `off, low, medium, high, max`. Narrow it if your relay ignores a level:

```yaml
levels: [off, low, medium, high]
```

Any subset of `off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max` is accepted; names are published in ascending order and unknown names are dropped.

## Idempotent

Re-running the plugin rewrites nothing when every model already declares exactly the configured levels. Updating the package therefore never churns your configuration, and any leftover declaration from a manual setup is detected and rewritten.

Changing `levels` does rewrite the affected models, because their current declaration no longer matches.

## How it works

Two details are worth knowing if you read the source.

**It does not override the `llm-pi-ai` row.** A Cordis loader patch replaces a row's `config` wholesale rather than merging it, so a patch that added `reasoningEfforts` would erase `baseURL`, the credential reference, and the whole model list. The plugin instead calls `settings.mutate()` with path-scoped operations, touching only `providers.<name>.models[i].reasoningEfforts`.

**It writes outside the activation transaction.** The HMR config editor refuses to nest transactions, and its guard reads an `AsyncLocalStorage` store that survives awaits and timers, so deferring is not enough. The plugin waits for the Loader to settle, then runs the write through `hmr.executing.exit()` — the same mechanism `dsh-hmr` uses when wiring a config watcher from inside a transaction.

## Compatibility

- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.1`.
- No runtime dependencies: only `node:fs` and Host-provided services.
- Works with any OpenAI-compatible route declared on the `llm-pi-ai` entry, not just one relay.

## License

MIT

# dsh-balance-card

给 DeepSeek Harness 的一张**「余额与用量」浮层卡片**：图片按钮可拖动，**点一下从图片左侧滑出卡片、
再点一下缩回**（带点击回弹动画），显示官方账户余额（含赠金/充值拆分）与本地会话的 token 用量
（今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月）和人民币估算花费。

- 余额：先走官方 `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`（密钥由 DSH 的凭据服务**现读**）；
  API key 未配置或被拒时，**回退到 DSH 账号登录态**
  （`platform.deepseek.com/api/v0/users/get_user_summary`，令牌同样由凭据服务现读，
  请求头 `x-dsh-auth-token`），令牌永不落盘、永不出宿主。
- 用量：直接折 DSH 原生会话日志（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`），三段计价（缓存命中 / 未命中 / 输出），
  **只统计当前工作区**。
- 形态：自己往 `document.body` 插一层浮层，**不进任何 slot** —— 官方 0.2.0 删过一个第三方插件在用的
  slot，这是实测教训。
- 卡片在图片**左侧**：图片与卡片都常驻，图片永远在最上层；开合是 `transform`/`opacity` 过渡，
  支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
- 客户端**不打包**：`exports["./client"]` 直接指向源文件，宿主原样伺服，改完刷新即可。
- 按钮图标是**位图**（黑塔戴巫师帽那张），经宿主白名单路由下发；取不到就退回内置 SVG。

> GitHub 仓库：<https://github.com/HerTa-st/dsh-balance-card>

---

## 按钮图标怎么换

按钮就是**角色本人的抠图**：没有圆形裁切、没有边框、没有底色，靠 alpha 站住，
显示尺寸 **192×236**（竖长，与抠图 239:268 同比，不拉伸；`button-size.json` 是唯一真相）。问号是保留的。

### 尺寸只有一个来源

**`button-size.json`**（仓库根）是唯一真相。三处需要知道尺寸 —— 客户端 CSS、出图脚本的像素、
验收脚本的断言 —— 靠"改的时候记得同步三处"必然有一天遗忘，所以：

```jsonc
// button-size.json
{ "width": 192, "height": 236 }
```

```powershell
# 改完尺寸跑一次：既重新出图，也会把数字写回客户端的标记区
& 'E:\node\node.exe' scripts\build-icon.mjs
```

`build-icon.mjs` 会按标记区（`// >>> BUTTON_SIZE_START` … `// <<< BUTTON_SIZE_END`）替换
`lib/client.js` 里的 `DOT_W`/`DOT_H`。**标记缺失就直接报错退出**，而不是"大致找个地方改" ——
静默改错地方会让 CSS 尺寸与图片像素不一致，表现为图被拉伸或模糊，极难查。

资产都在 `lib/assets/`：

| 文件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `icon.png` / `icon@2x.png` | 实际下发的 192×236 / 384×472（`srcset` 自动选 2x） |
| `icon-source.jpg` | **原始素材存档**（296×279） |
| `character-cutout.png` | 抠图结果（紧贴包围盒裁切，带 alpha） |
| `character-full.png` | **未裁剪**的透明全图，用于核对取舍 |
| `character-*-preview-checker.png` / `-dark.png` | 棋盘格 / 深色底预览，用来确认透明与暗底可读性 |
| `icon-preview-*.png` | 显示尺寸放大 8×，肉眼确认小尺寸下认不认得出 |
| `icon-shot.png` | 验收时抓的实拍截图 |

### 从原图重做一遍

```powershell
$py = 'E:\deepseek Desktop\resources\runtime\primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe'
# 1) 抠图（保留主角 + 问号；丢掉左侧淡色残影与纸张杂点）
& $py scripts\extract-character.py lib\assets\icon-source.jpg lib\assets\character-cutout.png
# 2) 由抠图出按钮资产（按 button-size.json 的尺寸等比放进透明画布，并同步客户端尺寸）
& 'E:\node\node.exe' scripts\build-icon.mjs
# 3) 验收（解码 / 尺寸 / 2x / 不拉伸 / 抠图成立）
& 'E:\node\node.exe' scripts\verify-icon.mjs 'http://127.0.0.1:3210/?token=<token>'
```

**改尺寸只需改 `button-size.json` 一处**，然后重跑上面的第 2 步。

### 抠图的判定规则（是量出来的，不是拍的）

`scripts/list-components.py` 会把原图每个连通块的位置、均色、亮度列出来。实测：

| 块 | 面积 | 均色 | 判定依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 主角 | 35353 | `(135,121,141)` | 面积最大 |
| 问号弯钩 | 1080 | `(146,119,202)` | **紫调**（B−R=56）且离左边 > 40px |
| 问号下点 | 179 | `(144,124,191)` | 同上 |
| 问号第三小块 | 37 | 紫调 | 同上 —— **面积门槛必须 < 37**，否则问号缺一角 |
| 左侧淡色残影 | 7377 | `(201,193,198)` | 太靠左；且不是紫调（B−R=−3） |
| 顶部杂点 | 119–199 | `(210,210,210)` | 不是紫调 |

> 四个踩过的坑（都写进脚本注释了）：
> ① 「外圈全透明」这个判据是错的 —— 抠图紧贴包围盒裁，人物必然贴住右边/下边；
> ② 「四角 4×4 全透明」太敏感 —— 右下角恰好压到肩膀，一个像素就判失败；
>   正确判据是**整条边框里透明像素的比例**（实拍 69.7%，矩形白底图会是 0%）。
> ③ 截图里按钮周围的界面文字会被像素判定当成按钮的一部分 → 截图时把它停到**空白处**；
> ④ 靠心算坐标（pad / scale / ratio）取样，算错过三次 → 改成用**连通块自动定位**。

---

## 点开与缩回（交互与动画）

**形态**：图片按钮和余额卡片**都常驻**在同一个浮层 root 里，图片永远在最上层（`z-index:1`），卡片在它下面（`0`）。
点一下图片，卡片从图片**左侧**滑出；再点一下图片（或卡片右上角的 ✕），卡片缩回图片背后。

**点击动画**：图片按下时 `:active` 立刻缩到 `.96`（即时反馈），松手再跑一次 420ms 的 keyframe
（`.93 → 1.045 → 1`，带回弹）。keyframe 由 `data-tap` 触发、460ms 后复位，所以连点也能再触发。

**开合动画**：只碰 `transform` / `opacity`（不触发布局）。收起态 `translateX(60%) scale(.95)` + `opacity:0`，
展开态归位；展开 280ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.06)`（轻微过冲），收起 160ms。
`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 下过渡与回弹都关掉，直接到位。

**落位**：卡片右边缘 = 图片**可见**左边缘 − 8px，垂直中心与图片中心对齐；视口四周留 8px。
卡片（276px 高）比图片（236px）高，靠近视口底部时「居中」会被 8px 边距顶住 —— 这时贴边更优先，
中心会差几像素（实测 3.8px）。视口窄到左边放不下时，卡片会被夹进视口并压到图片上 ——
图片层级更高、仍然可点，所以「缩回」不会失效。

**为什么坐标写在卡片自己身上**：root 的定位只表示「图片在哪」（`localStorage` 里的 `x/y` 就是图片框左上角），
卡片是 root 的绝对定位子元素、用相对 root 的负 `left`。拖动图片时卡片自动跟随，只需要在拖动/尺寸变化时重算夹取，
不需要维护第二套坐标，也不会出现「刷新一下卡片被拽回原处」。

**给验收脚本的诊断属性**：`data-open`（root 上，唯一的展开真相）、`data-dot-box`（图片 viewport 矩形
`left,top,w,h`）、`data-place-info`（`paintedLeft=… card=WxH left=… top=… gap=8`）。
旧版的 `data-align`（`above-button` / `below-button`）随「卡片在按钮上方」的落位一起删了。

---

## 实拍（无头 Edge，真机渲染）

| 收起 | 展开中（约 120ms） |
|---|---|
| ![收起](docs/screenshots/closed.png) | ![展开中](docs/screenshots/mid-open.png) |

| 展开 | 收起中（约 110ms） |
|---|---|
| ![展开](docs/screenshots/open.png) | ![收起中](docs/screenshots/mid-close.png) |

---

## 为什么这么做（每条都有理由，不是随手定的）

| 决定 | 理由 |
|---|---|
| 余额走官方 `/user/balance`（主）| `total_balance / granted_balance / topped_up_balance` 一次给全，且与浏览器登录态无关。DSH 自己那条账号链不是唯一来源。 |
| 余额回退到 DSH 账号链 | 桌面版默认用 `deepseek-account` 账号登录，很多环境里 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 没配或已失效（实测：DSH 里存的那把 key 被官方 401）。DSH 账号链在 0.2.1 里返回 `normal_wallets`（充值）与 `bonus_wallets`（赠金），**同样能拼出拆分**（`total = 充值 + 赠金`），所以 API key 不可用时没有理由让卡片空着。令牌取自凭据服务记录 `deepseek-account-platform/default`，只读不删 —— 卡片不会因为一次查询把用户登出。 |
| 用量走原始会话日志 | 官方给第三方插件的 `ctx.sessionQuery` / `sessionProjections` 只有**会话累计**，没有按天、没有按模型分桶。要「今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月」+ 按 provider 拆分，只能自己折叠。 |
| **逐帧**解压 zstd | 会话文件是**拼接的 zstd 帧**（每追加一次一个帧）。整文件一次 `zstdDecompressSync` 只解出第一帧（约 202 字节的会话头），静默丢掉几 MB 事件。 |
| 三段分开计价 | 实测缓存命中 1.82B、未命中 12.5M。`deepseek-flash` 命中价只有未命中的 1/50，不分段会把花费估到 5 倍以上。 |
| 只读当前工作区 | 本机有两个工作区（`HerTa` 与它的上级目录），混算会分不清「这个项目花了多少」。会话目录名是 cwd 的不可逆编码，用来精确比对。 |
| 增量缓存（mtime+size，只解新增帧） | 全量重算一次实测 **约 2.5 秒**（70 文件 / 45 MB / 34,350 帧 / 63,689 行）。剖析显示瓶颈**全在 CPU**：zstd 解压 59%、JSON 解析 34%、读盘只有 1.6%（帧平均 1.3 KB，小帧固定开销叠加）。同步跑会卡住宿主事件循环。 |
| 已解析事件**落盘缓存** | 进程重启后第一次打开也要快。缓存的是**原始事实**（不是派生结果），键带 `size + mtimeMs + 已消费字节`，文件一变只重解新增部分 → **不可能陈旧**。实测 2571 ms → 23 ms（约 110×）。`cachePath` 设 `-` 可关闭。 |
| 不进 slot | 官方 slot 都是固定座位，做不了「随意拖动」；且 0.2.0 真的删过 slot。 |
| 不打包客户端 | 没有构建步骤，改完刷新页面就生效；文件由 `exports["./client"]` 原样伺服。 |
| 失败不写缓存 | 一次断网不该把「半死」状态锁住 5 分钟。 |
| 峰谷价不做 | 只按**高峰价**估（偏保守），卡片上标明。按时段把每次调用分桶是另一个量级的工作。 |
| 无单价就不算钱 | 小米 token 套餐 / bailian 的 qwen 系列没有公开单价，`estimateCost` 返回 `null` 而不是 0 —— 0 会被误读成「免费」。 |
| 按钮用角色抠图（位图），不用自绘轮廓 | 用户要的是原画里的角色。宿主侧白名单只放两条 `icon.png` / `icon@2x.png`，**写死文件名**，所以不存在路径穿越，不需要写 `../` 过滤。取不到图时客户端退回内置 SVG，按钮不会变空白。 |
| 抠图**保留问号**、丢掉淡色残影 | 问号是画面的一部分（用户明确要）；残影是原画的水印式重复人物。判据用「紫调 + 离左边 > 40px」（实测问号 B−R=56、残影 B−R=−3，分得很干净），不是靠眼睛挑。 |
| 展开后卡片落在**图片左侧** | 用户要的落位：点图片后卡片从图片左侧弹出、再点缩回。卡片右边缘对图片**可见**左边缘（`object-fit: contain` 的实画区，192×236 的框里实画 192×215）留 8px 缝，垂直居中。 |
| 图片和卡片**都常驻** DOM | 旧版展开时把图片换成卡片，于是「再点一次图片缩回」无处可点；而且卡片要从图片背后滑出，就必须让图片压在它上面。现在图片 `z-index:1`、卡片 `0`：图片既不会被盖住，点它也永远命中它。 |
| 点击动画用 CSS keyframe | 按下 `:active` 缩到 `.96` 给即时反馈，松手跑一次 420ms 回弹。用 `data-tap` 触发、定时器复位 —— 不靠 JS 逐帧算 transform，掉帧也还是合成器的事。 |
| 开合动画只碰 `transform`/`opacity` | 不触发布局、不重排卡片内容。收起态只是 `visibility:hidden` + `pointer-events:none` + `inert`，**DOM 不卸载**：动画可以反向、数据不丢、再点开立刻有内容。 |
| 卡片坐标用**相对 root 的负 left** | root 的定位就是图片位置（也是拖动持久化的 `x/y`），卡片跟着 root 走 ⇒ 拖动时自动跟随、刷新不会被「拽回自动位置」。视口夹取在 `onMove` 里每帧重算。 |
| 视口窄时允许卡片压住图片 | 卡片比图片宽（320 > 192），图片贴着屏幕左边时左侧放不下。夹到视口 8px 内、宁可重叠：图片层级更高仍可点，缩回不会失效。 |
| 落位量 **root**、不量按钮 | 点开那一瞬间按钮正在跑点击回弹 keyframe（scale .93→1.045），量它得到的是**缩放后**的框 —— 实测据此落位卡片整体偏高 9～12px，而且动画结束后不会自动纠正。root 不参与动画，`offsetWidth/Height` 就是未缩放的外框。 |
| 窗口缩小后把按钮夹回视口 | 拖动坐标在窗口变小 / 换分辨率后可能落在视口外，按钮就再也点不到了（实测 1400×1500 拖到 x=1188，缩到 400×700 后整块出屏、`elementFromPoint` 返回 null）。所以 resize 时**先**夹 root 并写回 `x/y`，**再**重算卡片。 |
| 「等数据到位再落位」已删 | 新落位只依赖图片位置与卡片尺寸，与数字无关；卡片变高由 `ResizeObserver` 重算。 |
| 「记住收起态矩形」已删 | 图片常驻、随时能量，`lastDotRectRef`/尺寸校验那一套补丁都不需要了；`data-dot-box` 留作诊断。 |

---

## 安装

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME='<你的 DSH_HOME>'

# A) 从 npm 装（预构建，免 allowBuilds 授权）
& '<DSH 安装目录>\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-herta-balance-card

# B) 或者克隆源码后从本地路径装（本仓库用 herta-lab 验证过）
```
