plugins.description: Agent Teams 泳道看板 for DeepSeek Harness — 依赖 DAG 连线 + 通讯流，布局移植自 cc-haha
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-team-canvas

Agent Teams 泳道看板 · 依赖 DAG 连线 · 通讯流
DeepSeek Harness 插件 · 布局移植自 cc-haha 开源实现

--- ## 它是什么 在 DSH 会话输入框上方放一块 **Agent Teams 可视化画布**：队长居中、成员在下、任务按依赖深度分泳道排列，中间用 **SVG 贝塞尔虚线**画出「谁依赖谁」和「谁正在做哪个任务」。 CC-haha 桌面端的 Agent Teams 面板有一套很好用的视觉语言 —— 泳道底板、虚线总线、任务卡状态徽章。这个插件把那套布局搬到 DSH 的 Web UI 里，用的是原版几何常量与路径算法，不是照着重画的近似版本。 ## 长什么样 ``` ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 🤖 Agent Teams [tally-squad] [实验特性] │ ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ 3/6 2 8 1 │ │ 并行执行 完成 进行中 待办 │ ├───────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┤ │ 1 · 团队 · 队长居中，成员在下 │ 通讯 88 条 │ │ │ 全部 | 报告 | 私信 │ │ 🤖 team-lead ├──────────────────────────┤ │ 协调·等待汇报·收件箱 51 │ 👩‍💻 frontend-dev 17:15 │ │ ┆ ┆ ┆ ┆ │ P1 已修，mobile.png... │ │ 👨‍💻 🧪 🔍 👩‍💻 │ │ │ backend qa-eng reviewer frontend│ 🤖 team-lead 17:15 │ │ │ 后端 8000 已停... │ │ 2 · 共享任务列表 · 按依赖排层 → │ │ │ ┌─无依赖·可立即做─┐┌─第2层─┐┌收尾┐│ 👩‍💻 frontend-dev 17:14 │ │ │ #1 后端实现 ═══╪╪═▶#4 ││ #6 ││ 你抓到的真实 bug... │ │ │ #2 前端实现 ═══╪╪═▶#5 ││ ││ │ │ │ #3 QA 阶段一 ✓ ││ ││ ││ │ │ └────────────────┘└──────┘└────┘│ │ ├───────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┤ │ ┄┄ 依赖未满足 ┄┄ 依赖已满足 ┄┄ 正在执行 ┄┄ 刚解锁 ┄┄ 飞行中 │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 连线怎么画的 这是本插件的核心。四条连线各司其职： | 连线 | 形状 | 虚线 | 含义 | |---|---|---|---| | **任务依赖** | 三次贝塞尔，前置任务右缘 → 后继任务左缘 | `7 7` | 满足时用负责人强调色并流动，未满足用边框色 | | **队长总线** | 折线：队长脚下 → 横向总线 → 各成员顶部 | `6 6` | 汇报关系 | | **成员 peer 总线** | 折线：成员脚下 → 横向总线 → 成员脚下 | `4 7` | 同级通讯 | | **执行 tether** | 三次贝塞尔，成员脚下 → 任务顶部 | `8 6` | 正在执行该任务的成员，流动动画 | 依赖边的路径函数： ```js function dependencyPath(from, to) { const fromX = from.x + TASK_WIDTH const fromY = from.y + TASK_HEIGHT / 2 const toX = to.x const toY = to.y + TASK_HEIGHT / 2 const middle = fromX + (toX - fromX) / 2 return `M ${fromX},${fromY} C ${middle},${fromY} ${middle},${toY} ${toX - 5},${toY}` } ``` 泳道划分用「最长依赖路径」算深度，带环与缺失节点兜底： ```js function depthOf(id) { if (depths.has(id)) return depths.get(id) if (visiting.has(id)) return 0 // 环 → 回退 0 const task = byId.get(id) if (!task) return 0 // 缺失节点 → 0 visiting.add(id) const deps = task.blockedBy.filter(d => byId.has(d)) const depth = deps.length === 0 ? 0 : 1 + Math.max(...deps.map(depthOf)) visiting.delete(id) depths.set(id, depth) return depth } ``` 卡片是普通 DOM 绝对定位，连线是叠在上面的一层 `

plugins.description: SOLIDWORKS for DeepSeek Harness: dsh models parts, assembles them, checks interference, counts the BOM and makes drawings in a running SOLIDWORKS 2016+, on the same PC or in a Windows VM. Your files read-only by default.
plugins.readme_text:
``` ___ _ __ dsh-solidworks / __| \ / / \__ \\ \/\/ / SOLIDWORKS for DeepSeek Harness: |___/ \_/\_/ model, assemble, check, draw and export, in the SOLIDWORKS on your desk ``` **dsh drives the SOLIDWORKS you already have open: 2016 and later, on the same PC or in a Windows VM on your Mac.**

21 tools · verified on SOLIDWORKS 2016 SP1 and 2019 SP0 · one bridge exe, no runtime to install, no admin · your files read-only by default · MIT

Watch it · Get started · Tools · What it will not do · How it works · Proof · When to skip it · llms.txt · 中文

---

**One paragraph in, a flange out.** You describe the part; dsh models it in the SOLIDWORKS on your desk, checks the volume against its own arithmetic (158,983.493 mm³ both ways), and looks at it from four sides. It can also put parts together, check them for collisions, count a bill of materials, make the drawing, and work on the files you already have, read-only unless you say otherwise. ## Watch it Every clip is a real session: dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 with `deepseek-flash`, SOLIDWORKS 2019 SP0 in a Parallels VM, recorded from the SOLIDWORKS window. The captions are the session's own tool calls and results, and its own closing words. Time spent thinking is fast-forwarded; nothing is cut or reordered. [How the clips are made](scripts/clips/README.md). ### Point at it You select a face in SOLIDWORKS and say what to do with it. dsh reads your selection (the flange's top face, 8 edges), rounds every edge of it at 2 mm, and explains why the volume went down by 360.218 mm³ even though one fillet adds material.

### Put parts together, check they fit A shaft is modeled, both parts saved, and assembled with the shaft through the bore and the flange 40 mm up. Interference: 0 pairs. dsh also counts faces that only touch, and points out that a 30 mm shaft in a 30 mm bore is a line-to-line fit. Then the bill of materials.

### Draw it The drawing lays its views out in projection at the largest standard scale that fits, brings in the model's dimensions, and comes back to your workspace as a PDF.

Left: the PDF as exported. Right: sw_view, four views on one picture, which is how dsh looks at what it made.

## Get started You need dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 or later (its `dsh plugin add` uses pnpm, so pnpm on the PATH) and a running SOLIDWORKS 2016 or later. ### dsh and SOLIDWORKS on the same Windows PC ``` dsh plugin --profile web add @dshworks/dsh-solidworks ``` Start SOLIDWORKS, start dsh, ask. The plugin runs its bundled `swbridge.exe` on the first SOLIDWORKS question; there is nothing to pair or install. ### dsh on a Mac, SOLIDWORKS in a Windows VM 1. On the Mac: `dsh plugin --profile web add @dshworks/dsh-solidworks`, then start dsh once. It listens for the bridge and writes a pairing kit. 2. In the VM, signed in as the person who uses SOLIDWORKS, open `\\Mac\Home\.dsh\dsh-solidworks\windows\` (Parallels shares your Mac home folder there) and double-click `pair.cmd`. That installs the bridge for that Windows user, connects it to dsh, and starts it at every sign-in. No administrator, no firewall rule: the bridge dials out to dsh, so Windows never opens a port. If you ask dsh before pairing, the answer says where the kit is. On VMware, another PC, or a Mac without Parallels sharing, copy the `~/.dsh/dsh-solidworks/windows/` folder to the Windows machine and run `pair.cmd` there. If the VM reaches your Mac on an address the kit did not list, set it: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: dsh-solidworks config: advertise: ['10.211.55.2'] # Parallels' usual host address ``` Undo it in the VM with `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-solidworks\swbridge.exe uninstall`. ### Any other MCP client, on the Windows PC `swbridge.exe mcp` is a plain stdio MCP server with the same 21 tools: ``` claude mcp add solidworks -- C:\tools\swbridge.exe mcp ``` The exe is in this package at `bin/swbridge.exe` and on every [GitHub release](https://github.com/dshworks/dsh-solidworks/releases) with its SHA-256. ## Tools Lengths are millimetres, angles degrees, mass kilograms, whatever units the document uses; field names say so (`value_mm`, `mass_kg`). Geometry is addressed in one space everywhere: model-space points `[x, y, z]` in mm, Y up, the front plane at z = 0, top at y = 0, right at x = 0. Faces and edges are picked by a point on them. `doc` is a path, file name or title of an open document and defaults to the active one.
All 21 tools | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `sw_status` | Release (2016 SP1, 2019 SP0, ...), every SOLIDWORKS instance, the open documents, and any dialog SOLIDWORKS is waiting on. Called first. | | `sw_open` | Open a `.sldprt`, `.sldasm` or `.slddrw`, read-only unless asked, and activate it. | | `sw_new` | A new, empty part or assembly from SOLIDWORKS' default template. | | `sw_inspect` | Type, units, configurations, material, custom properties, bounding box, body and component counts. | | `sw_features` | The feature tree with suppression state and rebuild errors. | | `sw_parameters` | Every dimension (`D1@Sketch1`, value, unit, driven or not) and equation, global variables marked. | | `sw_components` | An assembly's component tree: file, configuration, state, fixed, position. | | `sw_mass_properties` | Mass, volume, surface area, density, centre of mass. | | `sw_probe` | What is at a point: the face, edge or vertex there, with its surface or curve, area or length, normal or axis, diameter and the feature that made it. Without points, whatever the user has selected in SOLIDWORKS right now. Two entities also give the distance and angle between them. | | `sw_edit` | In memory, then one rebuild: configuration, suppress/unsuppress, global variables, dimensions, custom properties. Each change comes back with before, after and its own outcome. | | `sw_build` | Model a part in steps: sketch (lines, polylines, rectangles, circles, arcs, centerlines) on a plane or a face, extrude or cut (blind, through all, mid-plane, draft), revolve, fille

plugins.description: Miran Fann for DeepSeek Harness: motion-graphics tools, a Miran settings page and DeepSeek motion skills. Needs the Miran Fann engine (npx miran-fann setup).
plugins.readme_text: # Miran Fann for DeepSeek Harness Motion graphics on this Mac, from a dsh session. The plugin starts the Miran engine, hands its tools to the model as `mcp__miran__*`, and adds a **Miran** section to dsh Settings. ```text dsh session ──tool call──► dsh mcp-client ──stdio──► ~/.miran/bin/miran mcp ▲ │ └────────────── frame, video, project JSON ◄───────────┘ ``` ## Install The engine comes first; the plugin only connects to it. ```sh npx miran-fann setup # the engine in ~/.miran/bin/miran ``` Setup adds the plugin to the `web` profile by itself when dsh is installed, and every automatic update of the engine brings the plugin of the same version. To add it by hand, use **Plugins** in the dsh web sidebar with the address below, or: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:rakibulrocky14/miran-fann-dsh#v0.1.6-beta.1 ``` dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer is needed (`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@next`). Restart `dsh web` after the install. `dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows the `miran-fann` layer when it loaded. ## Sign in Miran's tools run only for a signed-in install. Open **Settings → Miran**: the page shows the account, the engine version, the GPU backend and whether the tools are connected. **Sign in** runs the real flow (the browser opens miranfann.com, the engine receives the code); **Sign out** ends it. The plugin never fakes the sign-in and never works around it. ## Settings Everything on **Settings → Miran** is read from and written to the engine, so dsh, Claude Code and Codex agree: | Part | What it does | | --- | --- | | Account | Who is signed in; sign in and out through the engine | | Engine | Path, version, GPU, setup command when missing | | Workspace | Folder the engine reads and writes | | Tools | Tool surface (default, lean, full); the engine's own choice | | dsh tools | Connected state, reconnect | | Live viewer | Start the viewer, viewer theme, time units, preview quality | | Render defaults | Export quality, file-size limit, default voice | | API keys | Google Gemini, ElevenLabs, OpenRouter, fal, Replicate | | Generation | Image, video and draft models, per-call and per-day caps, spend so far | | Voices | Default voice, cloud voices, built-in voice | | Feedback and updates | Share feedback, auto-update, version, update now | | Skills | The skills this plugin gives the agent | Keys go to dsh's credential store **and** to Miran's own key store, as secret fields. The page only ever shows the last four characters. An environment variable with the same name wins over both. The **Built-in plugins → Miran** tab shows the same state as a card, with **Open live viewer**. ## Tools and skills The model sees the engine's tools as `mcp__miran__`. The default list is the engine's own `MIRAN_TOOLS_DEFAULT`; **Settings → Tools** offers the engine choice, `lean` (about 30 tools, the rest through `runScript`) and `full` (every tool in the schema). Skills ship in `skills//SKILL.md` and load into dsh's skill registry, so `/miran-...` and model-side loading use the same files. ## Configuration Profile settings live in `cordis.patch.yml`; every field has a default. | Field | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `enginePath` | `""` | Engine binary; empty means `~/.miran/bin/miran`, then `PATH` (`MIRAN_BINARY` also counts) | | `workspace` | `""` | Folder the engine reads and writes; empty leaves it to the engine | | `tools` | `"default"` | `default` follows `MIRAN_TOOLS_DEFAULT`, `lean` lists about 30 tools, `full` lists all | | `viewer` | `true` | Start the live viewer with the engine | | `viewerPort` | `47800` | Preferred viewer port; the next free one when taken | ## Troubleshooting **"Miran engine not found"** — run `npx miran-fann setup`, or set `enginePath` to the binary. The settings page prints the path it looked for. **Tools connected, but a call says sign-in is required** — open **Settings → Miran** and sign in; the engine gates every tool call on the account. **No Miran section in Settings** — the browser half did not load. Check that `dsh --profile --dump-config` lists `miran-fann`, then restart `dsh web` and reload the page. **A render returns no image** — the engine sends images as MCP image parts; dsh shows them in the session. If a call returns text only, the engine refused the render and the message says why. **The viewer will not open** — the port is taken. Change `viewerPort`, or stop the other viewer.

plugins.description: Pi 扩展 + DSH bridge：把当前上下文镜像成普通文件，由模型自己删除 stale block。灵感来自 Facebook Research 的 CLM harness。
plugins.readme_text:
# oh-my-clm

一个可直接加载到 Pi 的精简 live-context 扩展，参考
[Facebook Research context-language-models](https://github.com/facebookresearch/context-language-models/tree/main/clm/clm_harness)
的“把当前上下文镜像到普通文件、由模型自行整理”思路。

## 核心体验

Pi 为下一次请求构建当前 branch 的 projection 时，扩展会把可编辑部分镜像到当前 session 的临时目录：

```text
/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md
```

`${sessionId}` 是运行时 session ID。多个 session 即使使用同一个工作目录，也不会共享或覆盖 mirror。旧版本生成的 `.pi/clm` 文件不会被自动迁移或删除。

模型可以调用 Pi/DSH 都提供的 `cleanup({ blockIds: [...] })` 工具，按 editable block ID 删除 stale、重复或自指噪声。cleanup 在一次工具调用内完成 host-side 变更，不依赖完整 block body 或 `old_string`。需要缩短已有 block 时，rewrite 脚本要在同一个 host-side 工具调用内完成 read+write；普通 edit 只适用于完整且未截断的 body。DSH 会等触发文件编辑的 session event 发布完成后再应用 native replacement，所以脚本必须在工具返回前写完，不能在后台持续重写 mirror：

```text
<!-- clm-v2 -->
<!-- CLM_SNAPSHOT ... -->

[[CLM_ENTRY id=1 role=assistant]]
这段旧内容可以被改写成一句更短的事实摘要。
[[/CLM_ENTRY id=1]]
```

- 只修改 block body；保留 `CLM_SNAPSHOT`、`CLM_ENTRY` 和 closing marker。
- `id` 是从 `1` 开始的可读编辑序号；不要改 ID，也不要重排 block。扩展内部仍用 Pi 的 opaque entry ID。
- 删除一个可编辑 block 会从后续 projection 中省略该消息；删除最后一个 block 时保留 `<!-- CLM_EMPTY -->`。
- 初始用户任务受到保护，不会出现在可编辑区域中；user-authored block 可以被省略，但不能被模型改写。
- mirror preview 有固定的单 block 和总大小上限；截断只影响显示，不改变 canonical source。
- `cleanup({ blockIds: [...] })` 按当前 1-based editable ID 删除 block；load-bearing block 1 始终保留，assistant/tool-result 配对也会整体处理。未知、重复、过期或协议损坏的 ID 会整体拒绝。
- DSH 的 runtime context 会包含当前可编辑 block 的 `<oh-my-clm-block-index>`，每条记录给出 cleanup 使用的 1-based ID、role 和短 preview。列表较长时只显示头部 40 个和尾部 40 个，中间省略并给出 ID 区间。`cleanup` 的 tool result 也会返回刷新后的 index。所以清理时不需要为了确认 ID 或内容去读 `LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md`；只有需要完整、未截断的正文做 rewrite 时才读 mirror。
- 如果工具结果读取了 `LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md`，该结果会在未来 projection 中替换成短指针，避免 mirror 自我复制。
- 改写或删除 assistant tool turn 时，配对的 tool result 也会一起处理，避免孤立的 tool message。
- 合法修改在 `turn_end` 通过 Pi 原生 `context_edit` 持久化；原始 session JSONL 不会被改写。

由于 context edit 属于当前 branch，`/tree`、fork 和 session resume 继续遵守 Pi 的分支语义。

## 试用

在仓库根目录运行：

```bash
pi --extension ./extensions/clm.ts
```

或以 Pi package 方式临时加载：

```bash
pi -e .
```

开始一项会产生几轮工具输出的任务。需要整理历史时，模型可以按 block ID 调用 `cleanup({ blockIds: [...] })`，也可以按系统提示对
`/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md` 做同 call 的 rewrite/edit；手动压缩直接使用 Pi 原生 `/compact`。扩展不额外发送 “compact LLM turn”。

## 命令

```text
/clm
/clm status
```

`/clm` 与 `/clm status` 等价，Pi 扩展和 DSH 插件都提供。Pi 侧显示 mirror 路径、字节数、可编辑/保护 block 数、preview/canonical 估算 token、Pi context usage、目标预算、shrink-only 策略和 branch 上已持久化的 context edit 数量。DSH 侧显示当前 session 的 mirror 路径、mirror 与 canonical projection 是否一致、字节数、可编辑/保护 block 数、preview/canonical token 估算、DSH surface 节点数、shrink-only 策略和 mirror 限制；命令只读，不修改 session 或 mirror。两个宿主都不提供 `/clm refresh`。

扩展会在 session start、branch 切换和请求前自动刷新 mirror；没有 `/clm refresh` 命令。在 agent turn 之外直接修改 mirror，会在下一次同步时被恢复为 canonical projection，避免未经校验的内容进入 session。

## 预算与生命周期

`CLM_CONTEXT_BUDGET` 是一个近似的目标预算，不是第二个 context window，也不会阻止已经过大的请求。接近目标时，扩展会在 `context` hook 返回一条临时 nudge，要求模型只做一次 mirror 编辑；该 nudge 不写入 session history。没有设置预算时不发送 nudge。

超过 Pi 自身 context window 时，交给 Pi 原生 auto-compaction；需要手动整理时使用 Pi 原生 `/compact`。这避免在已经过大的完整上下文上再追加一次 `/clm-compact` LLM 请求。

```bash
CLM_CONTEXT_BUDGET=32000 pi --extension ./extensions/clm.ts
```

所有接受的 mirror 编辑都采用固定的 shrink-only 策略：按 Pi 的结构化估算，编辑后的上下文必须严格短于编辑前。不能安全缩短上下文的编辑会被拒绝。系统 prompt 等 mirror 之外的固定 token 会计入预算估算。

mirror 的显示上限是固定的：单 block 约 `12000` 字符，总 mirror 约 `96000` 字符。

token 计数使用共享格式层的 provider-independent `estimateMessageTokens(message)`，按消息分别估算。对当前 Pi 支持的 text、thinking、tool call、图片、system sections 和 tool declarations，它采用与 Pi host 一致的 `3.5 chars/token` 近似及 rounding。共享层不导入 Pi runtime，所以 DSH 的 `reasoning`、`tool-call`、`tool` 和其他自有消息形状仍走 fallback 估算。当前 Pi extension 的公开 `ExtensionContext` 只提供 effective system prompt，`fixedRequestTokens` 因此只计该 prompt；tool declaration overhead 只有在 host 传入结构化 system message 时才会被计入，否则这个估算就不完整。它不是 provider 的精确 tokenizer；Pi/DSH 自身的 context window 仍是最终约束。

生成的 `/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md` 位于系统临时目录，不属于发布包，也不应提交到 Git。目录默认使用 `0700`，mirror 文件默认使用 `0600`；宿主仍负责临时文件清理和内容审计。

## DeepSeek Harness（DSH）适配

仓库同时提供一个最小 DSH/Cordis host bridge，契约依据官方
[`deepseek-harness`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/)（`master`）的 Cordis plugin、agent-loop、session projection 资料，并参考
[`dsh-ops`](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops) 的 Community v0.15 manifest 形态；它保留同一份
`src/features/live-context/context-format.ts` 镜像、解析、snapshot 和编辑规划实现：

- 社区插件发现入口是 [`dsh-plugin.json`](./dsh-plugin.json)，host entry 为构建后的 `dist/dsh/index.js`；官方 bundle 安装元数据位于 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 和 [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml)。在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 中，实际生效的是 bundle 元数据；`dsh-plugin.json` 的 Community permissions 目前不应被描述为运行时强制隔离。
- DSH 生命周期使用官方 Harness 的 Cordis `agent/created`、`agent/pre-step`、`session/event`、`systemPrompt.section()`、`systemPrompt.context()` 和 `tools.register()` 扩展点；cleanup 直接对当前 session surface 执行按 ID 的 native replacement，不读取 mirror 文件。`systemPrompt.context()` 负责把 block index 放进模型可见的 runtime context；DSH 自己的 runtime-context snapshot 也会从 mirror records 中排除，避免 index 递归列出自身。普通 mirror 编辑的 `session/event` 只排队 reconcile，实际 mutation 延迟到 `Session.append()` 发布完成、且 `step/start` 打开新 step 之后执行；`agent/pre-step` 只等待已排队的收敛，不执行 mutation。session projection 仍由 DSH 提供，session log 仍是事实来源。
- DSH 会按当前 session ID 生成 `/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md`。DSH 文件工具可以直接编辑这个 host-side mirror；sandboxed bash 可能拥有不同的 `/tmp`，除非宿主显式共享该 session 目录。
- DSH 注册 `/clm` 命令（`/clm` 与 `/clm status` 等价）：从当前 session surface 实时计算 mirror 状态，报告 mirror 路径、artifact 是否与 canonical projection 一致、字节数、可编辑/保护 block 数、preview/canonical token 估算、DSH surface 节点数、shrink-only 策略和 mirror 限制。它只读，不写 mirror、不追加 session event，也不缓存状态，因此在第一次 bridge pass 之前也能给出准确结果。
- bridge 会对 mirror 编辑执行与 Pi 侧相同的 snapshot、结构安全和 shrink-only 校验；合法编辑通过 DSH 原生 `Session.append()` 的 `surfaceOp: { op: "replace" }` seam 写入当前 session，处理后再把 mirror 重写为新的 canonical DSH projection。
- 当前 bridge 会改变 DSH active surface，这与 Pi 的 branch-local `context_edit` 不是一回事：cleanup 和普通编辑会追加 `tool/result` content replacement 或 `developer/message` replacement（omission 用空 content，assistant 改写用缩短后的文本），原始事件仍保留在 append-only session log 中，`deriveMessages()` 使用新的 surface。DSH 明确禁止 `assistant/message` 携带 `sourceEventSeqs`，而每个 replacement 又必须引用所有被遮蔽的节点，所以 assistant block 不能原地替换成另一个 assistant message。改写后的文本以 developer 身份进入模型可见历史，不再归属原模型回复。它不生成 proposal/receipt 文件，也不注册自定义 session event；reconcile 在事件回调之外串行执行，避免 `Session.append()` reentrant failure。所有 omission 和 assistant 改写都使用 append 时真正打开的 `turn`/`step`（正数），`tool/result` replacement 保持原 event envelope、只改 `content`，并带 `sourceEventSeqs: [targetSeq]`。
- host entry 不复制 `dsh-ops` 的 Rust 工具、shell、PTC 或 TUI 矩阵，只做 live-context 适配。DSH 仅依赖 host 提供的 Cordis 生命周期，运行时不导入 Pi 的 coding-agent 包。

安装 DSH bundle 时，按官方 Harness 的插件管理流程把本仓库目录（或 `npm pack` 产物）交给当前 profile；不要手写 profile 的 `package.json`、`dsh.profile` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`。外部 E-012 报告验证了 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的安装、Cordis activation、system prompt 和真实 mirror/file-tool 路径；本地实现另外依据官方 Harness commit `1517a4dbca0a2789ff1d41ba439600f8547d23fa` 的 `Session.append()`/surface replacement 契约，通过 mock seam 回归测试验证 active-surface mutation。

版本更新说明（0.1.0–0.1.6）已移至 [changelog.md](./changelog.md)。

本地检查 DSH bridge：

```bash
npm test
npm run check
npm run typecheck
npm pack --dry-run
```

如果要交给 DSH 插件管理器安装，使用专门的 DSH 打包脚本：

```bash
npm run build:dsh:plugin
# 默认输出：artifacts/oh-my-clm-<version>.tgz

# 也可以指定输出目录或具体文件
node scripts/build-dsh-plugin.mjs ./out
node scripts/build-dsh-plugin.mjs --output ./out/oh-my-clm.tgz
```

这个脚本会先编译并检查 host entry，再生成只包含 DSH host、运行时 `dist`、manifest、bundle patch、locale、icon 的 npm tgz；Pi extension、TypeScript 源码、测试文件和开发依赖不会进入该专用包。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 仅作为可选 peer 声明用于兼容性检查，不产生运行时依赖，也不得改回 `dependencies`（原因见 [changelog.md](./changelog.md) 的 0.1.1 说明）。普通 `npm pack` 仍用于构建同时包含 Pi 与 DSH 内容的完整包。

`npm run build:dsh` 会从 `src/features/live-context/dsh-bridge.ts` 和共享格式层生成 `dist/`；`npm pack` 的 `prepack` 也会执行这一步。仓库测试主要是 mock host 和契约/包检查；外部 DSH 验证报告另外覆盖了真实 CLI 安装、bundle activation、system prompt 和 mirror/file-tool 生成。DSH 文件工具运行在宿主侧时可以访问 `/tmp/clm-*`；sandbox 内的 bash 不一定共享同一个 `/tmp`，应按提示使用文件工具编辑 mirror。`Session.append()` 的 replacement 会走正常 `session/event` 发布路径；需要立即验证后端崩溃持久性的部署应由宿主使用官方 `session/flush` 检查点，插件本身不

plugins.description: 强制模型思考（内部推理 / reasoning / 思维链）过程始终使用中文的 DSH Host 插件。 回答语言不受影响，仍跟随用户提问的语言。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chinese-thinking

强制模型**思考（内部推理 / reasoning / 思维链）过程始终使用中文**的 DSH Host 插件。
回答语言不受影响，仍跟随用户提问的语言。

## 原理

向 `ctx.systemPrompt` 注册一个系统提示词段落（`dsh-chinese-thinking`，默认排序 `10`，
紧随部署人设前缀之后）。每次组装系统提示词时都会带上该段落，因此对主会话、
子代理与工作流子代理统一生效。

## 文件

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host 插件入口（`apply(ctx, config)`） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 把插件行 `dsh-chinese-thinking` 插入 profile 配置树 |
| `package.json` | 组合包清单（`dsh.bundle.patch`） |

## 配置

在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 row `config` 中调整（patch 替换整份 config，请保留想留下的字段）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-chinese-thinking
  name: '@devilspiderx/dsh-chinese-thinking'
  config:
    enabled: true    # false 临时关闭
    order: 10        # 系统提示词段落排序
    text: |          # 可选：覆盖默认指令全文
      ...
```

## 安装

```
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=<本目录绝对路径>
```

安装后如未即时生效（`restart-required`），重启 DSH 即可。
卸载：`plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=@devilspiderx/dsh-chinese-thinking`。

plugins.description: A permanent 'Delete session' action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a confirmation dialog.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

A permanent **Delete session** action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a
confirmation dialog that tells you what is about to go.

DSH ships a *Archive* action, which is reversible and keeps the session in the
Archived list. This plugin adds the irreversible counterpart, and — unlike a
naive `rm` of the session log — it actually makes the row disappear.

## What it does

Adds one row to the per-session `…` menu in the left sidebar, ordered after
Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive. Choosing it opens a modal that reports:

- whether the session is **still open on this machine** (it cannot be reopened afterwards),
- the **log size** about to be removed,
- **running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders** bound to the session,
- how many reminders are deleted with it.

Confirming stops the session's work, unlinks its session directory and projection
checkpoint, and releases the id from every registry that would otherwise keep
listing it. Then the sidebar refreshes and the row is gone.

There is **no undo and no trash folder**. The dialog says so.

## Why it is not just `rm`

A session's directory is not the only thing that makes it appear. The Host's
session corpus is `persistence ∪ live`, so a session the Host still holds live
keeps coming back after its log is deleted:

1. the browser drops the row,
2. the next `sessions.refresh()` rebuilds the rows from the Host list and folds
   the live summary back in,
3. the row **returns**.

The visible symptom of this is that deleting several sessions in a row makes the
earlier ones reappear, and that archived rows come back stuck in Archived forever
(the old id was never removed from the archive set, so it accumulated dead ids).

`release()` therefore detaches through the same teardown the owning fiber uses,
in the order the agent loop's own disposal uses — **agents first, then
sessions** — plus `unarchiveSession(id)` and `workspace.detachSession(id)`. The
browser keeps its own `retired` set and re-applies every retirement after each
refresh, so rows stay retired until the Host's `api-session/removed` agrees.

## Install

This package ships a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so `dsh plugin` installs it as a
profile layer by itself — **you do not need to edit `cordis.patch.yml`**. Bare
`@deepseek-ai/*` imports are resolved by the host itself, so the package declares
**zero dependencies** — do not add them.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add wilsonchengassistant/dsh-session-delete
```

`dsh plugin` is a pnpm passthrough, so from a clone the same spec works with a
`file:` path (`dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-session-delete`),
or you can clone and install by hand.

That command does two things: it adds the package as a dependency, **and** it
appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`. The second
half is the one people miss — without it the package is just an unused
dependency, because the bundle patch in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)
is only read for packages the bundle list names.

Verify it joined the tree — the entry must appear under a banner naming the
plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is the part that is easy to miss:

```bash
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -B1 session-delete
```

```
# == …/dsh-session-delete/cordis.patch.yml
- id: session-delete
  name: dsh-session-delete
```

A row under a banner for the *profile's* `cordis.patch.yml` means something
inserted this plugin by hand and it is **not** installed as a bundle — the
dependency is present but the layer never composes. `--dump-config` never
mounts, so it is safe against the live profile.

Finally **restart the harness**. The bundle is composed at boot, so there is no
partial effect: until it restarts, the menu row is not there.

### If nothing happens

- **Re-running the same add is a no-op** — same spec, same version.
  `rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-delete` first, or
  the profile keeps serving the old copy forever.
- pnpm **copies** the package into the profile rather than symlinking it, so
  editing your clone does not change the running plugin. Copy
  `lib/*.js` into `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-delete/lib/`.
  `client.js` hot-reloads; `index.js` is host-side and needs a restart.
- `dsh plugin` needs `pnpm` on `PATH` (`corepack enable pnpm`), or it fails with
  "pnpm was not found".
- pnpm installs a version **older** than the registry `latest` when a release is
  less than 24 h old — that is `minimumReleaseAge`, a supply-chain guardrail, not
  a stale cache. Wait, or use a `^x.y.z` range so the newer release arrives on
  its own.

## Design notes

**A Typert `Remote` service, not an HTTP route.** The host half registers one
`TypertRemoteService` named `sessionDelete` with `describe` and `deleteSession`.
The Gateway auto-claims every endpoint a live `TypertRemoteService` declares, and
the browser calls it over the ordinary channel:

```js
ctx.connection.rpc.call('/api', `sessionDelete/${method}`, { args: { request } })
```

So there is no route to register and no permission to grant — the browser peer is
the owner principal.

**It deliberately does not check `Origin`.** In the desktop app the renderer
origin is the custom scheme `dsh-app://app`, and the shell's `protocol.handle`
strips `origin`, `host`, `cookie` and `sec-fetch-site` before forwarding to the
Host. A plugin route that validates `origin === 'http://' + host` therefore 403s
*every* request from the desktop app while working fine under `dsh web`. The
Remote-service path avoids the question entirely.

**The postcondition is checked against the disk.** A successful `rm` is not
treated as proof; `removeLog()` stats the path afterwards and throws
`delete/failed` if it survived.

## Files

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: `TypertRemoteService`, the delete sequence, registry release. |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the menu row and the `shell.overlay` confirmation dialog. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch named by `dsh.bundle`; inserts this plugin into a profile. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin titles for the Plugins panel. |

The in-app dictionary lives in `lib/client.js` (`zh` is the key-set source of
truth, `en` is checked complete against it); `locale/*.json` is the metadata the
Plugins panel reads.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: 奶蛙（bellylaugh）桌宠 DSH 插件：常驻 Deepseek harness 界面右下角，跟着 Agent 工作状态切换动作，任务完成时捧腹大笑。零依赖，支持热换宠物与笑声。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-bellylaugh · 奶龙桌宠 > 一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH）桌面宠物插件：把奶龙放在 Web 界面右下角， > 动作跟着 Agent 的工作状态走，任务完成时捧腹大笑，并放一段「哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈」。

- 🐣 **零依赖**：宿主半只用 Node 内置模块，浏览器半只碰 DOM / fetch / Audio - 🎞️ **状态驱动**：待机 / 工作中 / 工具跑完 / 任务完成 / 出错，五种反应 - 🖱️ **可拖动**：拖着走、松手记住、右键归位 - 🎵 **音频可热换**：往 `assets/` 丢一个 `laugh.*` 就换掉了，不用改代码、不用重启 - 🧩 **素材可换**：覆盖 `assets/spritesheet.webp` 就是换宠物（8 列 × 9 行、单帧 192×208） ## 目录 ``` dsh-pet-bellylaugh/ ├─ package.json # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 声明 ├─ cordis.patch.yml # bundle 自带的 loader 插入项 ├─ lib/host.js # 宿主半：监听 Agent 事件 + 提供 HTTP 接口 ├─ lib/client.js # 浏览器半：渲染桌宠、播动画、放声音 ├─ assets/spritesheet.webp # 默认宠物（8×9） ├─ assets/pet.json # 默认宠物的名字 ├─ assets/laugh.mp3 ├─ assets/pets/<名字>/ # 可选：放别的宠物，优先于默认那只 ├─ preview/*.png ├─ tools/preview.mjs # 假宿主预览，不装 DSH 也能看 ├─ LICENSE # MIT（仅覆盖代码） └─ NOTICE # 素材版权说明 ``` 两半的分工刻意做得很薄：宿主只负责把"现在忙不忙 / 刚干完什么"变成一个 JSON， 浏览器端每 500ms 拉一次。没有 RPC、没有 SSE、没有 WebSocket，出问题一眼就能看出来。 ## 安装 ```yaml # 在你 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 末尾追加 - insert: - id: ui-pet-bellylaugh name: 'dsh-pet-bellylaugh' ``` 再把本目录放进该 profile 的 `node_modules/`（软链、junction 或直接 `dsh plugin --profile add <本目录>` 都行）。 生效方式： - 改 `cordis.patch.yml` 后配置**热重载**，不用重启应用； - 浏览器端插件是在渲染 `index.html` 时注入的，所以要**刷新一次页面**才看得到宠物； - 改了 `lib/host.js` 需要重启 DSH（Node 的 ESM 缓存按包名留存）。 ## 开发时预览（不装 DSH 也能看） 浏览器端的动作完全由 `/state` 驱动，所以可以拿一个假宿主单独渲染： ```bash node tools/preview.mjs 18999 # 打开 http://127.0.0.1:18999/?mode=idle|busy|tool|done|error ``` ## 动作映射 精灵图是固定的 8 列 × 9 行网格（单帧 192×208），每一行是一段现成的动画。插件只做"选行 + 播帧"： | 状态 | 触发条件 | 精灵图 | 表现 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 待机 | 没有 Agent 在跑 | 第 0 行 · 6 帧 · 5.5fps | 站着呼吸、眨眼 | | 工作中 | 有 Agent 处于 `running` | 第 7 行 · 6 帧 · 7fps | 手在肚子上揉来揉去 | | 工具跑完 | 每次 Tool 调用结束 | 第 1 / 2 行 · 8 帧 · 13fps | 左右小跑两圈（方向随机） | | 任务完成 | 最后一个 Agent 回到 `idle` | 第 5 行 ×3 → 第 8 行 | 捧腹大笑再招手，气泡「哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈」，同时放笑声 | | 出错 | 本回合有 `agent/error` | 第 6 行 + 抖动 | 气泡「哎呀，好像出错了」 | | 被戳一下 | 鼠标点宠物 | 第 8 行 · 6 帧 · 9fps | 招手 | 没被用到的第 3、4 行（笑得更凶的两段）保留在表里，想换台词改 `ANIMS` 即可。 ## 素材来源 - **形象**：原样拷贝自本地 Codex 的 `~/.codex/pets/bellylaugh/spritesheet.webp`，一像素没改。 - **声音**：由作者从用户本地提供的一段音频转换而来。原文件是 **WMA(ASF) 容器套了个 `.flac` 后缀**， Chromium 放不了，所以用 Windows Media Foundation 转成了 `assets/laugh.mp3` （192 kbps / 48 kHz / 9.98 s，240 KB）。每次播放 4.2 秒后淡出，不会一直响。 ⚠️ 形象和音频属于第三方素材，**不在 MIT 许可范围内**，详见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。 ## 操作 | 动作 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 单击（不拖动） | **越戳越嗨**，见下面「互动」一节的递进表 | | 长按 0.7 秒 | 抚摸它：眯起来摇三下 + 「❤️ 呼噜呼噜…」 | | 按住拖动 | 把宠物挪到任意位置；拖的时候会**朝拖动方向跑动**，松手记住位置（存 `localStorage`，刷新后还在） | | **Shift + 单击** | 立刻大笑一次，用来试听当前的音频 | | 鼠标右键 | 回到右下角默认位置（复位） | | 悬停 → 右上角 🔊 | 静音 / 取消静音 | | 悬停 → 右上角「龙」 | **隐藏**桌宠（黄底小圆，字取宠物名的**最后**一个字） |

## 互动 ### 点击递进 连着戳会一路升级，1.6 秒内没有下一次点击就重新计数： | 第几次 | 动作 | 台词（每次随机） | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | 招手（第 8 行） | 嗨～ / 在呢在呢 / 有事吗？ / 戳我干嘛～ | | 2 | 拍肚子（第 7 行） | 嘿嘿～ / 舒服～ / 再来一下 / 咕噜咕噜 | | 3 | 怕痒（第 3 行） | 痒～哈哈哈 | | 4–6 | 捧腹大笑（第 5 行）+ **笑声** | 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈 | | 7+ | 不高兴（第 6 行 + 抖动） | 别戳啦！ / 晕了晕了 / 再戳要生气咯 / 住手住手 | 第 4~6 下会真的放笑声（就那段奶龙大笑），每次戳都从头重放、1.8 秒后淡出， 所以连戳是"哈哈哈…哈哈哈…"的节奏，不会叠成一团。静音状态下照旧不出声。 第 7 下之后计数清零，再戳又从头开始；停手 1.6 秒也会归零。 ### 抚摸 按住不动 0.7 秒算抚摸（移动超过 4px 就变成拖动，不会误触）。抚摸会打断正在播的动作， 换成拍肚子三圈 + 爱心台词。 ### 自己找乐子 空闲时每 42 秒掷一次骰子：45% 概率随便演一段（招手 / 待机 B / 拍肚子）， 50% 概率冒一句话；说话内容会根据 Agent 忙不忙切换（「发呆中…」vs「我帮你盯着」）。 隐藏、正在拖动、或已有动画在播时不会插话。 三段台词表和节奏档位都在 `lib/client.js` 顶部，改文案直接改数组即可： ```js const CLICK_STREAK_MS = 1600; // 连击窗口 const LONG_PRESS_MS = 700; // 长按阈值 const IDLE_TALK_MS = 42000; // 闲聊间隔 const GREET_LINES = ["嗨～", …]; ``` ## 隐藏与恢复 隐藏和恢复是**一对同款小黄圆**，各自取宠物名的一个字： | 位置 | 内容 | 作用 | | --- | --- | --- | | 悬停时右上角 | 「龙」（名字**最后**一个字） | 点击隐藏 | | 隐藏后原地 | 「奶」（名字**第一**个字） | 点击恢复 | 默认宠物叫「奶龙」，所以就是龙 ↔ 奶；换成豆包就自动变成「包」↔「豆」。

恢复入口是 **26px 的黄色小圆**，刚出现时会脉冲三下提醒位置，鼠标移上去会放大。 点它、或者按 Tab 聚焦后回车，宠物就回来了。隐藏状态记在 `localStorage` （`dsh-pet-bellylaugh:hidden`），所以刷新页面也还是隐藏的 —— 但那个小圆始终在， 不存在「藏了找不回来」的情况。想彻底不留痕迹就别用隐藏，直接按下面「怎么卸载」关掉插件。 隐藏期间插件**不轮询、不放声音**（省得一有任务完成就凭空传来笑声）； 重新显示时会静默对齐状态，不会把隐藏期间攒下的事件一次性补播。 ## 怎么换音频 **不用改代码，也不用重启** —— 丢文件就行： 1. 把音频放进 `dsh-pet-bellylaugh\assets\`，文件名以 `laugh` 开头，比如 `laugh.wav`。 2. 目录里**修改时间最新**的那个 `laugh.*` 会被选中，旧的不用删。 3. 宿主每 1.5 秒重扫一次目录，`/state` 里带出文件名和版本号（mtime）；版本一变， 浏览器端就换上新的 URL —— 连刷新页面都不必，下一次大笑就是新声音。 4. 一个 `laugh.*` 都没有时，会退而选 `assets\` 里最新的任意音频文件。 支持的格式：`mp3 / m4a / aac / wav / ogg / opus / flac / webm`（Chromium 能解的那些）。 > ⚠️ **WMA / ASF 不行**。Chromium 解不了这两个容器，得先转成上面任一格式再丢进来。 > 本项目自带的 `laugh.mp3` 就是从这样一个"WMA 套 .flac 后缀"的文件转出来的。 ## 怎么换宠物 跟音频一个待遇 —— **不用改代码**。两种方式： **A. 换掉默认那只**：直接覆盖 `assets\spritesheet.webp`（刷新页面生效）。 **B. 单放一个宠物目录**（推荐，可以和默认那只共存）： ``` assets/ ├─ pet.json # 默认宠物的名字，可留 ├─ spritesheet.webp # 默认那只 ├─ laugh.mp3 └─ pets/ └─ doubao/ # 目录名随意 ├─ pet.json # 可选：{"displayName": "豆包"} └─ spritesheet.webp ``` 规则： 1. 只要 `assets\pets\` 下有宠物，就**优先用它**（多个时取修改时间最新的那个）。 这条比"按时间取最新"更明确 —— Windows 的普通复制会保留源文件 mtime， 光比时间会让"刚拷进来的宠物反而不生效"。 2. 网格**列数/行数从图片实际尺寸算**：`宽 ÷ 192`、`高 ÷ 208`。 所以 8×9（1536×1872）和 8×11（1536×2288）两种 Codex 素材包都能直接用， 不会把 11 行压成 9 行。 3. 名字取同目录 `pet.json` 的 `displayName`，没有就退回目录名 —— 会用在提示气泡和 tooltip 上。 4. 宿主每 1.5 秒重扫，`/state.pet` 里带 `id / name / columns / rows / v`，版本一变浏览器就换图， 连刷新都不必。 > 你本机 `~/.codex/pets/` 里那 8 只里，`gugu-gaga` 和 `nai-long-2` 是 8×11 的 v2 素材包， > 其余是 8×9；把整个文件夹（`pet.json` + `spritesheet.webp`）拷进 `assets\pets\<名字>\` 就能换过去。 行序沿用同一套 Codex 约定（第 0 行待机、第 1/2 行跑、第 5 行大笑、第 7 行拍肚子、第 8 行招手）， 所以换任何一只 Codex 宠物，动作映射都成立。 ## 怎么卸载 两种，从轻到重： **① 临时关掉**（保留文件，随时能开回来） ```yaml # profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里，给这条加上 disabled - insert: - id: ui-pet-bellylaugh name: 'dsh-pet-bellylaugh' disabled: true ``` 配置**热重载**，改完刷新页面就没了；想开回来把 `disabled` 删掉即可。 DSH 的「设置 → 插件」页面里也有同样的开关。 **② 彻底移除**：删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那条 `insert` 项，再删掉 `/node_modules/dsh-pet-bellylaugh`（如果是 junction，删链接即可，源目录还在），刷新页面。 > 只想让它安静但不想消失？悬停宠物，点右上角出现的 🔇 图标静音即可（记在 localStorage）。 拖拽用 `pointerdown/move/up` + `setPointerCapture`，位移小于 4px 视为点击，所以"点一下"和"拖一下"不会互相打架。 位置按"距右下角的距离"存储，窗口缩放时会自动夹回可视区域内。 ## 可调参数 | 想改什么 | 改哪里 | | --- | --- | | 大小 | `lib/client.js` 的 `--dsh-pet-fw` / `--dsh-pet-fh`（保持 12:13，否则会裁帧） | | 默认位置 / 层级 | `.dsh-pet { right / bottom / z-index }`，默认位置另见 `DEFAULT_POS` | | 音量 | `VOLUME`（默认 0.85） | | 笑声时长 | `LAUGH_MS`（任务完成后，默认 4200）/ `GIGGLE_MS`（点出来的，默认 1800） | | 轮询频率 | `POLL_MS`（默认 500） | | 哪一行演什么 | `ANIMS` 表 | | **眨眼快慢** | `ANIMS.idle.frames`：这是个**显式帧序列**（不是帧数），想更少眨眼就把两次 `1` / `4`（闭眼帧）之间多塞几帧睁眼姿势；`ANIMS.idle.fps` 控制整体速度 | | 拖起来跑多快 | `ANIMS.runR` / `ANIMS.runL` 的 `fps` | | 连击节奏 / 长按阈值 | `CLICK_STREAK_MS`（默认 1600）/ `LONG_PRESS_MS`（默认 700） | | 自动闲聊间隔 | `IDLE_TALK_MS`（默认 42000），设成 `0` 之外的大数即可近似关掉 | | 互动台词 | `GREET_LINES` / `HAPPY_LINES` / `ANNOYED_LINES` / `PET_LINES` / `IDLE_LINES` / `BUSY_LINES` | | 挪不动了想复位 | 右键宠物 | > `ANIMS` 里 `frames` 写数字时表示"播 0..n-1 全套"，写数组时表示"按这个顺序播"， > 两者都支持。待机之所以用数组，是因为直接循环 6 帧会让它每 1.1 秒眨一次眼， > 现在改成 30 帧的序列，眨眼间隔约 2.9–3.8 秒。 ## 接口 | 方法 | 路径 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | GET | `/pet-bellylaugh/state` | 当前快照：`busy`、`running`、`lastTool`、`toolSeq`、`doneSeq`、`errorSeq`、`clientMountedAt`、`laugh{file,v,size}`、`pet{id,name,columns,rows,v}` … | | GET | `/pet-bellylaugh/sheet` | **当前生效的精灵图**（由目录扫描决定），带版本号 ETag | | GET | `/pet-bellylaugh/audio` | **当前生效的笑声**（由目录扫描决定），带版本号 ETag | | GET | `/pet-bellylaugh/assets/` | `assets/` 里白名单扩展名的文件，带 mtime ETag | | POST | `/pet-bellylaugh/report` | 浏览器端挂载上报，纯诊断 | 文件名只接受纯文件名（拒绝 `/`、`\`、`..`），扩展名必须在白名单里，所以请求路径拼不进文件系统。 媒体一律 `Cache-Control: no-cache` + 基于 mtime/size 的 ETag：文件换了就换校验值，没换就 304。 `clientMountedAt` 非空说明宠物真的挂到页面上了。 ## 已知边界 - plugins.readme_text:
---
description: "Gemini subagent: drive the official Google Gemini CLI as a one-shot coding subagent inside DeepSeek Harness (subagent_gemini delegation tool)."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

# dsh-subagent-gemini

> **发布状态：暂未发布到 npm / DSH 插件市场。**
> Gemini CLI 目前尚未提供 Gemini 4，且本插件需要用户自备 Gemini API key 才能完成端到端验证；
> 在验证通过前不提交市场收录，避免把未经验证的插件放给用户。代码、测试与 CI 均已就绪，验证后可发布。
>
> 想用 Gemini 4 请安装 [`dsh-subagent-antigravity`](https://github.com/PipeDream941/dsh-subagent-antigravity)。

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Adds a **Gemini subagent** to DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a parent session can call
`subagent_gemini` to run a Google Gemini CLI coding agent in a **separate process**
inside the parent workspace, let it edit files and run commands on its own, and
get only the final answer back.

The shape is the same as the official Codex subagent (`subagent_codex`) and the
community Cursor subagent (`cursor_code`):

- **Fresh process, fresh session** — every delegation spawns a new `gemini --acp`;
- **Final answer only** — the child's thoughts, tool calls and stderr never enter the parent conversation;
- **One task per run** — no follow-up input or continuation (use the native `subagent`/`fork` backends for those);
- **Safe diagnostics** — failures report fixed stage/category facts, never stderr, paths or credentials.

> Community plugin; not affiliated with Google. Gemini CLI is Google's official CLI — this plugin only drives it from DSH.

## How it works

```
parent session (DeepSeek model)
   │  calls tool subagent_gemini({ description, prompt })
   ▼
DSH subagent seam (ctx.subagents)
   │  provider: gemini (registered by this plugin)
   ▼
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp (official ACP subagent backend)
   │  spawn, ACP handshake, auto-answered permissions, process-range cleanup, safe diagnostics
   ▼
gemini --acp --skip-trust  (separate process, parent cwd)
   │  uses Gemini CLI's own tools (file edits / shell / search / MCP …)
   ▼
final answer → parent conversation
```

This plugin owns the Gemini-specific parts — **locating the executable**, **validating configuration**
and **detecting credentials at load time with actionable guidance**. Process lifecycle and the ACP
protocol are handled by DSH's official backend, so a DSH upgrade does not require rewriting the protocol here.

## Requirements

| Dependency | Version / notes |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.2` series (provides `ctx.subagents` and the ACP subagent backend) |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24` |
| Google Gemini CLI | a build that supports `--acp` (`0.60+`, latest recommended) |
| Gemini credential | Gemini Developer API key (recommended), or Vertex AI / Code Assist variables |

Install the CLI:

```bash
npm install -g @google/gemini-cli
gemini --version
```

## Install the plugin

**From the DSH plugin market (recommended):** search for `dsh-subagent-gemini`, install and enable it.

**From the command line:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-gemini
```

Then add the package to that profile's `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart (or let the
profile recompose):

```json
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": ["…", "dsh-subagent-gemini"]
  }
}
```

Once enabled, every agent sees the global tool `subagent_gemini` (a running session picks it up on its next request).

## Credentials (important)

Gemini CLI needs its own credential. **Google account browser login (OAuth) no longer works**: Google retired
the individual Gemini Code Assist OAuth client for Gemini CLI, and the CLI reports
*"This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals"*.
Use an **API key** instead:

1. Create a key at <https://aistudio.google.com/apikey>;
2. Store it where Gemini CLI looks (no plugin config required):

```bash
printf 'GEMINI_API_KEY=your-key\n' > ~/.gemini/.env
chmod 600 ~/.gemini/.env
```

Gemini CLI loads `~/.gemini/.env` automatically. Environment variables also work:

- `GEMINI_API_KEY` — Gemini Developer API;
- `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true` + `GOOGLE_API_KEY` — Vertex AI;
- `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA=true` — Google Code Assist license.

To pass variables to the child explicitly, use the plugin's `env` config (see below). The plugin never reads,
logs or returns secret values.

## Usage

The model calls it like any other delegation tool:

```json
{
  "name": "subagent_gemini",
  "arguments": {
    "description": "Fix login timeout",
    "prompt": "In the workspace, find the login request timeout and raise it from 5s to 15s, run the related tests, and reply only with what you changed and the test result."
  }
}
```

- `description` — 3–5 word task name shown in the subagent list;
- `prompt` — a **self-contained** task; the child cannot see the parent conversation, so include paths, constraints and acceptance criteria.

When the run finishes the parent receives a completion notice with Gemini's final answer or a safe failure
diagnostic. The child's tool traffic and reasoning stay out of the parent session.

## Configuration

Override the `subagent-gemini` entry's `config` in a profile patch:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `providerName` | `gemini` | Name registered on `ctx.subagents`; must be unique in one profile |
| `command` | empty (auto-detect) | Path to the `gemini` executable; empty searches `PATH`, then `~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, … |
| `args` | `['--acp', '--skip-trust']` | CLI arguments; `--acp` is always kept, `--skip-trust` is present by default |
| `model` | empty (CLI default) | Fixed model id such as `gemini-2.5-flash`; becomes one `--model` argument |
| `permission` | `allow` | Auto-answer for child permission requests: `allow` approves (edits/shell), `reject` declines (read-only) |
| `env` | `{}` | Extra environment variables layered over the credential-scrubbed parent environment |
| `disposeEofGraceMs` | `6000` | Time the child gets to flush after stdin EOF before escalation |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `3000` | Failure-observation and SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation grace |

Example — fixed model, read-only child:

```yaml
- id: subagent-gemini
  config:
    model: gemini-2.5-flash
    permission: reject
```

## Security and permissions

- `permission: allow` means **unattended**: the child may edit workspace files and run commands without a human
  approval prompt. That is what makes delegated coding tasks possible; use it in trusted workspaces and review
  `git diff` afterwards.
- `--skip-trust` trusts the parent workspace for the child session only, so a delegation never stalls on an
  interactive trust prompt.
- The child is a separate process with its own credential environment: DSH's subprocess seam scrubs credential-like
  variables from the parent environment; only variables in `env` are forwarded.
- No telemetry. No credential is read, logged or returned by this plugin; the key is managed by Gemini CLI itself.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Delegation fails with a `process-start` diagnostic | `gemini` not found. `npm install -g @google/gemini-cli`, or set `command` to an absolute path |
| `Gemini API key is missing or not configured` | No credential. Write `~/.gemini/.env` as above (`chmod 600`) |
| `This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals` | The retired OAuth login is in use. Switch to an API key |
| Child starts but never answers / times out | Check network reachability of the Gemini API; if it needs a proxy, put `HTTPS_PROXY` in the plugin's `env` |
| Want to check the machine setup | Run `npm run smoke` in the plugin checkout (costs one API request and prints PONG) |

## Compatibility and development

- Depends on the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp@0.2.1-rc.2`, so protocol work tracks the official backend;
- Unit tests: `npm test` (32 cases: config normalization, executable discovery, credential detection);
- End-to-end self-check: `npm run smoke` (requires an API key);
- Reference implementations: the official Codex subagent (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`) and the official ACP
  backend (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp`); all three share the same `ctx.subagents` contract.

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile des

无证据不算完成（evidence-first completion）软提示哨兵 for DeepSeek Harness。

## 行为契约

node dod_check.mjs <报告文件>   # 输出 JSON，不通过 exit=1

```

plugins.description: Version browser for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: list published versions, switch or roll back, and uninstall from the Plugins page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-versions

Version browser for **DeepSeek Harness** plugins. It adds a **Versions** tab to the Web **Plugins** page where you can see every published version of an installed plugin, switch to one, roll back, or uninstall it — all through the host's own `pluginManager` service.

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

## Why

The official plugin manager intentionally has no version picker: third-party plugins are upgraded by uninstalling and reinstalling, and only official on-demand bundles get an explicit **Update** button. Pinning a known-good version, or returning to one after a regression, means editing `package.json` by hand.

This plugin adds exactly that missing surface, without replacing the market or the installer.

## Features

- Lists the bundles the current profile installs, with version, source spec, and whether the bundle is removable
- Expands a bundle into its full published version list from the registry (publish date, `latest`, deprecated flags)
- Switches version through `pluginManager.removeBundle` → `pluginManager.installBundle`, saving an exact dependency
- **Automatic rollback**: if the target version fails to install (peer gate, missing version, network), the previous version is installed back and the failure is reported
- Uninstalls a profile bundle from the same tab
- Works with the profile's configured registry (private registries included) and falls back to `registry.npmjs.org`

## Install

The npm package is not published yet, so install straight from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions
```

or with an explicit Git URL:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add git+https://github.com/DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions.git
```

In DSH Desktop the `desktop` profile is managed by the application, so use **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `github:DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions` instead of the CLI. Restart or refresh the page afterwards. Add `#<tag>` or `#<commit>` to pin a revision.

Once published to npm, `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-versions` will work as well.

## Use

1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar.
2. Select the **Versions** tab.
3. Expand a plugin to see its versions. The current one is tagged, and the newest is tagged `latest`.
4. **Switch** asks for confirmation, then removes and reinstalls the plugin at that version. A failure rolls back automatically.
5. **Uninstall** removes the bundle; its configuration is kept.

Refresh the page after a switch so the browser loads the other version's client half.

## How a switch works

```
pluginManager.listBundles()        find the installed bundle, remember its version
pluginManager.removeBundle(name)   unload + remove the dependency
pluginManager.installBundle(name@version, { saveExact: true, enabled: true })
   ├─ success → ChangeResult.application: applied | restart-required
   └─ failure → remove the half-installed package, install the previous version
```

`installBundle` refuses a package the profile already depends on (`already-installed`) in HMR profiles, which is why the removal is not optional. The host performs the same check before pnpm runs, so an incompatible peer range is reported without touching the profile.

## HTTP surface

The client half talks to the host half over one loopback-only route:

```
POST /plugin-versions/api/{list|versions|switch|remove}
```

Requests must carry `x-requested-with: XMLHttpRequest`, must not be `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`, and must arrive on a loopback `Host` (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`). Only bundles already installed in this profile can be switched or removed, so the route cannot be used as a general package installer.

## Limitations

- Loopback only: a page served with `--trusted-host` from another machine is refused.
- No automatic update check; this is a version browser, not an updater.
- Compatibility is not pre-checked per version — the host rejects an incompatible version and the switch rolls back.
- A switch needs `HMR` to apply live; without it the host reports `restart-required`.
- The page must be refreshed before the new version's client half runs.

## Development

Plain ESM, no build step:

```
index.js          host half: HTTP route + pluginManager calls
client.js         browser bundle: registers the Versions tab into plugins.tab
cordis.patch.yml  inserts the bundle row
locale/*.json     bundle title and description
```

Point the installer at this directory (`dsh plugin add <path>`, or **Add plugin** with an absolute path). The directory is linked, so edits take effect after a restart.

## License

MIT
