plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: DSH 原生「同花顺 AI」插件：复用本机已登录浏览器 profile 查询同花顺问财，提供右侧面板、/ths skill 与 ths_query/ths_status 工具。非官方。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ths-ai · 同花顺问财 DSH 插件

[![CI](https://github.com/buyou-claw/dsh-ths-ai/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/buyou-claw/dsh-ths-ai/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

把**同花顺问财（iwencai）**接进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）：右侧多一个「同花顺 AI」面板，对话里多一个 `/ths` 命令，模型手里多两个工具 `ths_query` / `ths_status`。

> **它不是 API，也不是 MCP。** 它复用你**本机已经登录的浏览器 profile**，像你本人一样打开问财页面读取结果。
> 因此没有 API Key、没有服务端、没有任何数据离开你的电脑 —— 代价是你的账号、你的登录态、你所在平台的使用协议，责任都在你这边。**使用前请先读 [合规与免责声明](docs/LEGAL.md)。**

![面板截图](docs/assets/panel.png)

---

## 目录

- [它能做什么](#它能做什么)
- [环境要求](#环境要求)
- [安装](#安装)
- [首次使用](#首次使用)
- [两种使用方式](#两种使用方式)
- [配置项](#配置项)
- [常见问题](#常见问题)
- [隐私与安全](#隐私与安全)
- [项目结构](#项目结构)
- [开发与测试](#开发与测试)
- [Roadmap](#roadmap)
- [许可](#许可)

---

## 它能做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 右侧面板 | 输入自然语言问题 → 直接拿回问财表格；显示登录状态、可一键登录、可刷新状态 |
| `/ths <问题>` | 对话里让 AI 调用工具查问财，并把结果总结成「结论 + 精简表格 + 口径 + 异常项」，而不是甩一张原始表格 |
| `ths_query` 工具 | 模型可直接调用：`{"query": "最近一周涨幅最大的个股"}` |
| `ths_status` 工具 | 只读判断当前 profile 是否已登录（不猜、不编） |
| 状态缓存 | 状态检查要拉起一次浏览器（10–20 s），因此结果缓存 5 分钟并启动后台预热，面板打开基本秒回 |
| 查询节流 | 两次查询之间默认强制 ≥3 秒间隔，避免把问财打到限流 |

**它不是什么：**

- 不是行情数据源：没有内置数据、没有行情缓存，不保证数据完整或实时；
- 不是投资建议工具：结果来自问财页面，内容由 AI 生成，请自行甄别；
- 不绕过登录 / 验证码 / 付费墙，也不内置任何反检测隐身参数；
- 不承诺跨平台：**Windows + Edge 是实测路径**，其它平台见 [配置项](#配置项)。

## 环境要求

| 依赖 | 要求 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` | 0.2.x 起 agent 工具必须声明 `output { schema, render }` |
| Node.js | `>= 20` | 用 DSH 自带运行时即可，无需单独安装 |
| 浏览器 | Edge（默认） | 走 Playwright `channel: 'msedge'`，用**系统已安装**的 Edge，不下载内核 |
| 账号 | 你自己的同花顺问财账号 | 登录在可见窗口里由你本人完成 |
| 平台 | Windows（实测） | macOS / Linux 见 `DSH_THS_BROWSER` |

> 只依赖 `playwright-core`（约 13 MB，不含浏览器二进制），`npm install` 不会触发浏览器下载。

## 安装

### 方式 A：一键脚本（Windows，推荐）

```powershell
# 1. 把仓库放到 DSH 插件目录
git clone https://github.com/buyou-claw/dsh-ths-ai "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\plugins\dsh-ths-ai"

# 2. 装依赖并接进 DSH 桌面端 profile
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\plugins\dsh-ths-ai"
npm install --omit=dev
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install\install.ps1

# 3. 重启 DSH 桌面端
```

脚本做三件事：① 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 登记依赖与 bundle（先备份为 `package.json.bak-ths-ai`）；② 建 `node_modules/dsh-ths-ai` 目录联接；③ 打印下一步。可重复运行（幂等）。

### 方式 B：手工（任何平台）

1. 把仓库放到 `~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ths-ai`，执行 `npm install --omit=dev`；
2. 编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`：
   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": { "dsh-ths-ai": "file:../../plugins/dsh-ths-ai" },
     "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...原有项", "dsh-ths-ai" ] } }
   }
   ```
3. 建联接：Windows `New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-ths-ai" -Target "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\plugins\dsh-ths-ai"`；macOS/Linux 用 `ln -s`；
4. 重启 DSH。

完整步骤（含校验与卸载回滚）见 [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md)。

### 验证安装

1. 右侧栏应出现「同花顺 AI」面板；
2. 对话里发 `/ths 今日涨幅前10的股票`，应直接返回结果；
3. 工具注册情况见 `~/.dsh/logs/dsh-ths-ai.log`：应有 `ths_query registered` / `ths_status registered`。

> 工具没出现？先看下面「常见问题」，90% 是 DSH 版本或没重启。

## 首次使用

1. 打开右侧「同花顺 AI」面板 → 点 **登录问财**；
2. 弹出的浏览器窗口里用**你自己的账号**完成登录；
3. **登录完成后关闭那个窗口**（登录态已写入本地 profile）；
4. 回面板点 **刷新状态**，出现「已登录」即可查询。

> 同一个 profile 同时只能被一个浏览器进程使用。登录窗口开着时不要查询，会报 profile 被占用。

## 两种使用方式

**面板**：随手查，结果直接渲染成表格。

**对话 `/ths`**：

```text
/ths 最新一周涨幅最大的个股
/ths 低市盈率且主力净流入的股票
/ths status          # 只看登录状态
```

AI 会调用 `ths_query` 取数，再按「结论 → 精简表格 → 口径 → 异常项（ST/新股/北交所/单日大跌但区间大涨）」组织回答，不编数据。

## 配置项

全部通过环境变量覆盖，**不设置时行为与默认完全一致**：

| 变量 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_THS_PROFILE_DIR` | `<插件目录>/profile` | 浏览器持久化配置目录。装到只读目录时改成可写路径 |
| `DSH_THS_BROWSER` | `msedge` | Playwright channel。macOS/Linux 可试 `chrome` / `chromium`（未实测，欢迎反馈） |
| `DSH_THS_WAIT_MS` | `12000` | 结果页渲染等待毫秒数。网络慢/表格空可上调 |
| `DSH_THS_STATUS_WAIT_MS` | `3500` | 状态检查页等待毫秒数 |
| `DSH_THS_MIN_INTERVAL_MS` | `3000` | 两次查询的最小间隔（节流） |
| `DSH_THS_LOG_DIR` | `~/.dsh/logs` | 诊断日志目录（`dsh-ths-ai.log`，超过 512 KB 自动清空） |
| `DSH_THS_NODE` | 自动探测 | 指定用哪个 node 跑子进程（默认用 DSH 自带运行时） |

## 常见问题

| 现象 | 最可能的原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 面板能用，但模型说没有 `ths_query` 工具 | DSH 版本不匹配 / 未重启 | 确认 DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`；重启桌面端；看 `~/.dsh/logs/dsh-ths-ai.log` |
| 登录状态一直「检查中…」很久 | 首次检查要拉起浏览器（10–20 s），之后走缓存 | 等一次即可；之后 5 分钟内秒回 |
| 提示「未登录」但明明登录过 | 查询与登录用的不是同一个 profile | 统一 `DSH_THS_PROFILE_DIR`；登录后关闭窗口再刷新状态 |
| `browser has been closed` / profile 被占用 | 登录窗口还开着，或并发查询 | 关掉登录窗口；不要并发 |
| 返回 `blocked` / 访问受限 | 触发问财限流或风控 | 调大 `DSH_THS_MIN_INTERVAL_MS`，过段时间再试 |
| 表格列为空 / 结构错乱 | 问财前端改版 | 带日志开 issue |
| macOS/Linux 报 browser not found | 默认 channel 是 `msedge` | `DSH_THS_BROWSER=chrome` 或 `chromium` |

完整排查树见 [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)。

**提 issue 请附**：DSH 版本、操作系统、`~/.dsh/logs/dsh-ths-ai.log` 相关片段、复现用问句。**不要贴 Cookie / 账号信息。**

## 隐私与安全

- 登录态（Cookie，含 `u_ukey`）只存在**本机** `profile/` 目录，插件不上传任何数据；`.gitignore` 已排除 `profile/`。
- 想彻底清除登录态：关掉 DSH → 删除 `profile/` 目录（下次重新登录）。
- 不要在 issue / 截图里暴露 Cookie、手机号、验证码。
- 安全问题的报告流程见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

## 项目结构

```text
dsh-ths-ai/
├── index.js            # 宿主侧：路由 /ths-ai/*、2 个 agent 工具、子进程桥、状态缓存
├── client.js           # 客户端侧：右侧「同花顺 AI」面板
├── config.mjs          # 运行期配置（目录 / 浏览器 channel / 等待时间 / 日志）
├── login.mjs           # 打开可见窗口让你本人登录
├── query.mjs           # 无头打开问财、抽取表格、输出 THS_RESULT
├── status.mjs          # 只读判断登录态、输出 THS_STATUS
├── cordis.patch.yml    # DSH bundle patch：注册插件
├── skills/ths/SKILL.md # /ths skill 指令（模型侧行为约束）
├── docs/               # 安装 / 排查 / 架构 / 合规
└── install/            # 一键安装与卸载脚本
```

细节见 [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)。

## 开发与测试

```bash
npm install --omit=dev
npm run check            # 6 个文件语法检查（CI 跑这个）
npm run verify:status    # 真实检查登录态（会拉起浏览器）
THS_QUERY="今日涨幅前10的股票" npm run verify:query   # 真实查询一次
```

CI 只做语法检查，不做联网测试（不在 CI 里使用任何账号）。改动问财选择器时请本地跑 `verify:query` 并附日志。

贡献流程见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，Issue/PR 约定见 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)，版本发布与市场提交见 [docs/PUBLISHING.md](docs/PUBLISHING.md)。

## Roadmap

- [ ] macOS / Linux 浏览器探测实测（当前靠 `DSH_THS_BROWSER` 手动指定）
- [ ] 用 `waitForSelector` 替换固定 12 s 等待，缩短查询耗时
- [ ] 表格结构适配层：问财改版时集中改一处
- [ ] 结构化输出（`ths_query` 返回 JSON，便于二次加工）
- [x] 上架 DSH 插件市场（GitHub topic `dsh-plugin`，见 [docs/PUBLISHING.md](docs/PUBLISHING.md)）

## 许可

代码以 [MIT](LICENSE) 发布。项目与浙江核新同花顺网络信息股份有限公司**无任何关联**，不含任何同花顺/问财的商标、数据或静态资源；「同花顺」「问财」等名称仅作描述性使用。使用前请阅读 [合规与免责声明](docs/LEGAL.md)。

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that intercepts repeated tool calls, caps per-turn budgets, and breaks failure loops to reduce token waste.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tool-governor

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops runaway tool calls before they burn through your token budget.

## What it does

- **Repeat-call breaker** — denies the same tool + argument combination after N repeats
- **Per-turn budget fuse** — hard-caps tool calls and model steps per turn
- **Failure-loop cutoff** — pauses a tool after consecutive failures
- **Monotonic guard** — denies are final; downstream layers cannot re-allow a blocked call

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tool-governor
```

Restart DSH after installing. Verify the bundle is registered:

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | findstr dsh-tool-governor
```

Pin a version, or install directly from source:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tool-governor@1.0.1
dsh plugin --profile web add github:George-Java/dsh-tool-governor
```

## Compatibility

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `0.2.x` (tested on `0.2.1-rc.2`) |
| Platform | Windows / macOS / Linux |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |

The plugin hooks `tools/pre-execute`, `tools/post-execute`, `ctx.tools.guard`, and `agent/pre-step`
at the profile root, so it needs only the global `tools` service. It reads the acting agent from
`exec.agent` / `event.agent`, and takes the current turn from the `agent/pre-step` payload
(`event.turn`), falling back to `agent.currentTurn` on 0.1.x. A new turn starts a fresh budget.

## Configuration

All fields are optional — defaults are applied when omitted.

| Field | Default | Description |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `maxToolCallsPerTurn` | `24` | Max tool calls allowed in one turn |
| `maxStepsPerTurn` | `16` | Max model steps allowed in one turn |
| `repeatThreshold` | `2` | Deny after the same call repeats this many times |
| `consecutiveFailureThreshold` | `2` | Pause a tool after N consecutive failures |
| `denyTools` | `[]` | Glob patterns of tools to always deny (e.g. `["browser_*"]`) |
| `denyMessage` | built-in | Message injected when a call is denied |

Override through the profile `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-tool-governor
  name: dsh-tool-governor
  config:
    maxToolCallsPerTurn: 12
    repeatThreshold: 1
```

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tool-governor
```

## How it works

1. `tools/pre-execute` — denies blacklisted tools, exhausted per-turn budgets, repeated signatures, and failure loops.
2. `tools/post-execute` — counts completed calls and tracks consecutive failures.
3. `ctx.tools.guard` — a monotonic, synchronous guard that makes earlier denials final.
4. `agent/pre-step` — records the current turn for every agent and rejects the turn once its model-step budget is spent.

Per-agent, per-turn ledgers are keyed by agent id and turn number.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: Codex-style selection quote annotations for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-codex-annotate · 划词引用回复

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 Web UI 加一个 Codex 风格的「划词追问」：选中助手回复里的任意文字，右键选择 **在此回答**，写下你的问题或补充；可以连续攒下多条注释，最后一次性发出。发出的消息自带精确出处（消息 id、轮次、段号、小节、字符区间或代码行号）和原文，并在气泡里折叠成一条 `📎 N 条注释` 的附件条。

> 面向 DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** 的 Web 客户端构建，依赖若干尚未承诺稳定的 DOM / React 内部细节（见[兼容性](#兼容性与已知限制)）。

## 特性

- **划词右键即用**：右键菜单里新增「在此回答」，与「复制」并列；没有选中文字时不拦截系统菜单。
- **精确定位**：消息 id、轮次、段号、所在小节标题、字符区间；代码块记录语言与行号。
- **先确认、后统一发送**：每次确认只暂存一条注释，输入框工具行显示 `📎 N 条注释`，点开可逐条删除或清空，最后一次性发送。
- **气泡内折叠**：发出的消息把引用部分收成 `📎 N 条注释 ▾`，点击展开原文，展开后仍可正常划选复制。
- **纯本地**：没有任何网络请求或遥测；引用内容就是一条普通用户消息，fork / 回放 / 搜索 / 上下文压缩都照常工作。

## 环境

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**（Web UI 或桌面版）
- 无构建步骤：仓库里的 `client.js` 就是浏览器直接加载的模块

## 安装

要求 DSH 已安装且 `dsh` 在 PATH 中。从 GitHub 直接安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:mar1259/dsh-plugin-codex-annotate
```

`desktop` 是桌面版的 profile 名；Web 版通常用 `web`，换成你实际启动的 profile 即可。
固定到某个 commit，避免仓库后续改动影响现有环境：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:mar1259/dsh-plugin-codex-annotate#<commit-sha>
```

本地 clone 安装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mar1259/dsh-plugin-codex-annotate.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-codex-annotate
```

卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-codex-annotate
```

本仓库是纯 JS，没有 `prepare` / `build` 脚本，git 安装不需要 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 许可。

> 安装或更新客户端 bundle 后，刷新页面（或重启 DSH）才会加载新的 JS 代际。

## 使用

1. 在助手回复中选中一段文字 → **右键** → `❝ 在此回答`。
2. 在弹出的输入框里写下回复 → 点 **确认**（或按 Enter）。
3. 继续划词、继续确认；输入框工具行左侧出现 `📎 N 条注释` 胶囊。
4. 点胶囊 → 浮层里可逐条删除、清空，或直接 **发送**。
5. 发送后，所有注释与回复合成**一条**用户消息；气泡里显示为 `📎 N 条注释 ▾`，点击展开。

## 发出的消息长这样

段落选区：

```text
> **回复引用** · 助手消息 #4f2a1c · 第 3 轮 · 第 2 段「方案 A」· 字符 12–58
> 「建议把鉴权放到网关层，避免每个服务重复实现。」

那网关自己挂了怎么办？
```

代码选区：

```text
> **回复引用** · 助手消息 #4f2a1c · 第 3 轮 · 代码块 ts · 第 12–18 行
> ```
> for (const x of xs) { ... }
> ```
```

多条注释会按顺序拼接在同一个消息里，每条一个引用块 + 一段回复。

## 工作原理

| 部件 | 挂载点 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 右键菜单 + 引用编辑器 + 注释列表 | `shell.overlay` | 全帧浮层：拦截助手选区上的 `contextmenu`，渲染菜单/编辑器/列表 |
| 待发送胶囊 | `conversation.input.left` | 输入框工具行左侧，显示 `📎 N 条注释` |
| 发送桥 | `conversation.input.overlay` | 从会话作用域拿到 `inputActions`，把文本写入输入框并提交 |
| 气泡折叠 | 注入 CSS + DOM 标记 | 给用户气泡内的引用 `<blockquote>` 打标记，折叠成附件条 |

- 消息身份不依赖 CSS 类名：从选区节点沿 React fiber 链读取 `sessionId` / `messageId` / 轮次，读不到时退回 `data-chat-flow-kind` 属性。
- 发送走宿主自己的输入管线：`insertText`（追加到草稿末尾）或 `setDraft`，随后 `submit()`，因此排队、steer、附件等行为与手动发送一致。
- 引用内容始终是消息正文的一部分，没有被藏进自定义事件；`<blockquote>` 折叠只是视觉呈现。

## 兼容性与已知限制

- 依赖 DSH 客户端内部结构：`__reactFiber$*`、`data-chat-flow-kind` / `data-chat-turn`、用户消息里 `<blockquote>` 的渲染方式。**升级 DSH 后可能需要适配**。
- 目前只支持助手回复正文；跨消息选择、工具调用卡片、流式输出中的消息不会出现菜单项。
- 待发送注释只存在内存里，刷新页面会清空。
- 在助手选区的右键菜单会**替换**系统菜单，当前只提供「复制」与「在此回答」两项；其他区域仍使用系统菜单。
- 长引用会截断：正文 300 字、代码 12 行，超出会标注「已截断」。
- 若输入框在确认到发送之间被改动，发送会中止并提示重试，避免覆盖你的草稿。

## 隐私

插件不做任何网络请求，不收集遥测，也不读写工作区文件。引用的原文与你的回复会作为普通消息文本，经 DSH 原有的发送链路交给模型。

## 开发

仓库即包目录，没有构建产物：

```text
client.js          # 浏览器半边：菜单、编辑器、注释列表、气泡折叠
index.js           # Host 半边：空 apply，仅用于打包
cordis.patch.yml   # Bundle 补丁：插入一行 codex-annotate
package.json       # dsh.bundle / dsh.client 清单
locale/{zh,en}.json# 插件管理器显示的标题与描述
icon.svg           # 插件图标
```

语法自检：

```bash
node --check client.js
node --check index.js
```

## 贡献者

- [mar1259](https://github.com/mar1259) — 作者、产品方向与测试
- **DeepSeek Harness Agent** — AI 结对实现（架构、客户端代码、文档）

提交记录中使用 `Co-authored-by: DeepSeek Harness Agent <agent@dsh.invalid>` 标注 AI 协作；这是保留域名的占位邮箱，不对应任何公开账号。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 mar1259

---

## English

Codex-style selection annotations for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Select text in an assistant reply, right-click, choose **Reply here**, write your note, and confirm — accumulate several notes as a `📎 N notes` chip inside the composer tool row, then send them all at once. The outgoing message quotes the exact location (message id, turn, block, section, character range or code lines) and is folded into an expandable attachment row inside the chat bubble.

Install:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:mar1259/dsh-plugin-codex-annotate
```

Tested against DSH 0.2.1-rc.2. The plugin relies on client internals (`__reactFiber$`, `data-chat-flow-kind`, rendered blockquotes), so DSH upgrades may require adaptation. No network access, no telemetry. MIT licensed.

plugins.description: A panel for the servers and static pages an agent started on localhost: port, directory, registering session, and one switch to stop each.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-localhost > 一个面板，回答"这台机器上现在跑着什么、哪个目录、哪个会话开的、怎么关掉"。 agent 在开发里起服务是常态：`pnpm dev`、`python -m http.server`、一个 `dist/` 静态页。它们是短暂的，但**不会自己消失**——三个小时后你没死，那个端口也没死。这个插件把"起服务"变成一次**登记**，于是端口不用猜、目录不会丢、关掉有地方点。
中文 ## 它做什么 **两种东西，都归它管；第三种它老实承认管不了。** | 类型 | 谁在跑 | 生命周期 | |---|---|---| | `静态页` | 插件自己（127.0.0.1 上的一个小服务器） | 跟着 DSH 一起关 | | `命令` | 插件通过 Harness 的 subprocess 服务启动 | 插件停它就停，DSH 退出时全部停 | | 别的进程 | agent 自己用 bash 起的 | **不在这里**。杀不掉的进程不该显示成"运行中" | 这不是洁癖。一个后台进程如果没人拥有，它就会活过它该活的时间——见 [`docs/plan.md`](docs/plan.md) 里那四个活了十一天的东西。 ## 装 ``` github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-localhost#v0.3.0 ``` 装完**重启桌面端**（host 半边只在启动时加载）。 ## agent 怎么用 给 agent 的是一个工具 `serve`，不是一堆 bash： ```jsonc { "action": "register", "kind": "spawned", "name": "preview", "dir": "/path/to/project", "cmd": "pnpm dev --port $PORT", "path": "/" } { "action": "register", "kind": "static", "name": "deck", "dir": "/path/to/dist" } ``` 返回里带 `port` 和 `url`。**端口是插件分的（8840–8899），不是 agent 挑的**——所以"这个工作区开过哪些服务"这个问题有答案，而不是靠回忆。 其他动作：`list` / `start` / `stop` / `logs`。`logs` 返回最近的输出，排错不用截图。 ## 面板 侧边栏里，紧挨在 Tailscale Remote Access 下面。每行：状态点、名字、类型、端口、状态。展开后有： - **目录** —— 点「用 Finder 打开」 - **入口文件**（静态页）—— 点「显示入口文件」，Finder 里直接选中它 - **登记会话** —— 点「跳到会话」，回到当初开它的那个对话 - **日志** —— 最近 400 行，运行中会自己滚 行上的按钮：打开 / 启动 / 停止 / 收起。 ## 老实说（边界） - **只登记它自己起的**。agent 用 bash 起的服务，这个面板看不见——它杀不掉，就不能声称拥有。 - **DSH 退出 = 全部停止**。重启后所有条目显示"已停止"，需要手动点启动；不会偷偷帮你拉起来。 - **端口是分给它的**，所以别在别的脚本里硬编码 8840。想要固定端口就在 `cmd` 里自己用 `$PORT`。 - **静态页由它自己发**，不是复制文件：`dir` 改了立刻生效，`dir` 删了就 404。 - **只在 127.0.0.1 上**。这个端口没有认证，不要以为它是个"分享"按钮；要给别人看，走 Tailscale。 - **从手机打开**：面板会读 `tailscale serve status`，把已经发布到 tailnet 的端口配上远端地址；此时「打开」在**你的手机浏览器**里打开那个地址，而不是让 Mac 弹浏览器。没发布的端口在手机上不给「打开」按钮，并明说只在本机可访问。 - 静态页的 SPA 回退**只对浏览器导航生效**（`Accept: text/html`），这样 `/etc/hosts` 这类路径不会假装成路由。 ## Compatibility 实测于 **macOS（Apple Silicon）+ DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2**。依赖的上游契约： | 契约 | 来自 | |---|---| | `webServer.register({ kind: 'exact', path })`，以及 `connection.admit(req)` 的准入栅栏 | `dsh-host-webserver`、`dsh-api-remotes` | | `subprocess.spawn` 的句柄、`collected.*.readFrom(offset)`、`terminate()`，以及**服务销毁时杀掉所有在管进程** | `dsh-subprocess-local` | | `ctx.tools.register` 的 `ToolDefinition`（`parameters` 里 `required` 写在字段内） | `dsh-tools` | | `sidebar.panellist` / `main` 两个槽位，`order` 决定导航顺序 | `dsh-client-ui-sidebar`、`dsh-client-ui-layout` | | `locale.bind(ns)` 支持 `{name}` 插值 | `dsh-client-locale` | | `uiWorkspace.openSession(id)` 接受裸 session id | `dsh-client-ui-workspace` | ## 开发 ```sh npm test # 45 条，不需要安装任何依赖 ``` Host 半边没有运行时依赖，所以测试**真的 import 它**，用假 ctx 驱动：静态服务走真实 socket，spawned 走假 subprocess，断言的是 spawn 规格而不是"看起来跑了"。Client 半边按页面加载的方式在 `node:vm` 里求值，再用一个迷你 hooks 运行时把面板渲染出来断言。 没有构建步骤：`client.js` 就是发布物。
English ## What it does Two kinds of things, both owned; a third it refuses to pretend about: | Kind | Who runs it | Lifetime | |---|---|---| | `static` | this plugin (a small 127.0.0.1 server) | stops with DSH | | `command` | this plugin, through the Harness subprocess service | stops when asked, and on DSH exit | | anything else | the agent, with bash | **not listed here**. A process we cannot kill must not read as "running". | The agent gets one tool, `serve`, instead of a pile of bash: it registers a directory or a start command and comes back with the assigned port and URL. Ports come from 8840–8899 and are assigned by the plugin, never typed by the agent — which is what makes "what did I start here" a question with an answer. The panel sits under Tailscale Remote Access: status, name, kind, port, and one switch. Expand a row for the directory (reveal in Finder), the entry file, the registering session (jump back to it), and the log tail. ## Honest limits - It lists only what it started. A server an agent began with bash is invisible — and unkillable — so it is not shown. - DSH exit stops everything; after a restart every entry reads stopped and nothing restarts itself. - Static pages are served from their directory, not copied; the port is not authenticated and is loopback-only. - The SPA fallback applies to browser navigations only (`Accept: text/html`), so a missing file stays a 404. ## Development ```sh npm test # 45 tests, no install step ``` The Host half has no runtime dependencies, so the suite imports it and drives a fake context: the static server over a real socket, the spawned path through a fake `ctx.subprocess`. The Client half is evaluated as a script in `node:vm` and rendered through a small hooks runtime.
## License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Jiaxin Kou

plugins.description: Renders AI-generated HTML as interactive cards inside DeepSeek Harness conversations: playable demos, full-screen, copy and download.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-visual-card **中文** | [English](#english) 可视化回答插件：AI 交一段 HTML，在对话里渲染成一个**可交互的窗口**——能点、能用键盘操作、能全屏、能导出。 ## 效果 工具调用后，本轮回答下方出现一个窗口： - 顶部工具条：标题 + 全屏 / 复制 / 下载 - 内容区是 AI 写的 HTML，脚本会真正执行（按钮、canvas、动画都能跑） - 颜色自动跟随当前亮/暗主题 ## 能做什么 - 图表、色板、布局示意 - 可点击的演示（切换状态、翻页、展开细节） - **完整的小游戏**（WASD 移动、canvas 逐帧动画） - 需要键盘操作时，点进窗口才接管键盘，窗口外按键照常进输入框 ## 键盘规则 | 操作 | 行为 | |---|---| | 点进窗口 | 窗口接管键盘，标题栏提示「键盘已交给窗口」 | | 按 Esc | 释放键盘，回到输入框 | | 点窗口外 | 自动释放 | | 鼠标 | 始终正常（悬停、滚动、点击都不用先聚焦） | 实现上用了 iframe：AI 生成的脚本通常监听 `document` 的键盘事件，如果和宿主共用同一个文档，窗口外按键也会触发它。iframe 有独立的事件作用域，焦点不在里面就收不到键。 ## 工具 ```js render_visual({ title: '标题', html: '
...
', // height 可选：不给就按内容自动定高（推荐） }) ``` **高度是自动的**：宽度固定后，内容多高卡片就多高，不套固定框。内容超过设置的比例上限时，改为卡片内部滚动 —— 再大的卡片也不会逼你滚动整个对话才能看全貌。 写 HTML 时用主题变量，不要写死颜色： `--v-bg-base`、`--v-bg-layer-1/2`、`--v-border`、`--v-text`、`--v-text-dim`、`--v-brand`、`--v-success/warn/error` ## 设置 设置 → 可视化： | 项 | 作用 | |---|---| | **高度上限** | 卡片高度按内容自动决定；超过这个比例（40–100% 视口高）就改成卡片内部滚动，不逼你滚动整个对话才能看全貌 | | **允许执行脚本** | 关掉后按钮、动画、小游戏都不运行，只显示静态内容。脚本运行在宿主页面里，这是唯一的安全风险来源 | | **每个会话保留轮数** | 超出的旧轮次在写入时丢弃（10–2000） | | **每轮最多卡片数** | 一轮里超过这个数量只留最新的（1–50） | | **清空历史** | 清掉 `cards.json`，带二次确认 | 改动即时保存到 `~/.dsh/visual/settings.json`。 ## 存储 卡片按「会话 + 轮次」落盘到 `~/.dsh/visual/cards.json`，重启后仍在。保留轮数与每轮上限由设置决定。 删掉这个目录只会丢失历史可视化，不影响功能。 ## 安装 **推荐：内置插件安装程序。** 打开「设置 → 内置插件」，粘贴包名，点安装，再重启应用： ``` dsh-visual-card ``` 安装程序会自动写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不用手改任何文件。 命令行方式（先完全退出应用）： ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-visual-card ``` 然后把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启应用。 ## 安全说明 AI 生成的脚本**运行在宿主页面里**，不是沙箱。这是「能点击、能跑小游戏」的必然代价。 插件只约束「不引用外部资源」，不做代码审查。自己用没问题；如果要在不信任 AI 输出的场景里用，请先自行加沙箱。 ## 已知限制 - 卡片固定渲染在本轮回答**下方**，不能插入正文中间——宿主的对话节点是固定 19 种，插件无法新增节点类型 - `turnTail` 槽位只在本轮结束后渲染，所以流式输出期间看不到卡片 --- **English** | [中文](#chinese) Visual answers for DeepSeek Harness: the model hands over a block of HTML and it renders as an **interactive window** inside the conversation — clickable, keyboard-operable, fullscreen-capable, exportable. ## What it looks like After the tool call, a window appears below the turn's answer: - Toolbar: title plus Fullscreen / Copy / Download - The content area is the model's HTML, and its scripts really run (buttons, canvas, animation all work) - Colors follow the active light/dark theme automatically ## What you can build - Charts, color swatches, layout sketches - Clickable demos (state toggles, paging, expanding detail) - **Complete small games** (WASD movement, per-frame canvas animation) - When a demo needs the keyboard, clicking into the window takes it over; keys outside keep going to the composer ## Keyboard rules | Action | Behavior | |---|---| | Click into the window | The window takes the keyboard; the title bar says so | | Press Esc | Release the keyboard, back to the composer | | Click outside | Released automatically | | Mouse | Always works — hover, scroll and click need no focus first | The implementation uses an iframe. Scripts generated by the model typically listen for `keydown` on `document`; if they shared the host document, keys pressed anywhere would reach them. An iframe has its own event scope, so it only receives keys while focus is inside. ## Tool ```js render_visual({ title: 'Title', html: '
...
', // height is optional; omit it and the card sizes itself to its content (recommended) }) ``` **Height is automatic**: once the width is fixed, the card is as tall as its content — no fixed frame. When the content exceeds the configured cap, the card scrolls internally, so even a large card never forces you to scroll the whole conversation. Use theme variables instead of hard-coded colors: `--v-bg-base`, `--v-bg-layer-1/2`, `--v-border`, `--v-text`, `--v-text-dim`, `--v-brand`, `--v-success/warn/error` ## Settings Settings → Visual: | Item | Effect | |---|---| | **Height cap** | Card height follows its content; above this share of the viewport (40–100%) the card scrolls internally instead of forcing a page scroll | | **Allow scripts** | When off, buttons, animation and games do not run — only static content renders. Scripts run inside the host page, which is the only source of risk here | | **Turns kept per conversation** | Older turns are dropped on write (10–2000) | | **Max cards per turn** | Beyond this many in one turn only the newest are kept (1–50) | | **Clear history** | Deletes `cards.json`, behind a second confirmation | Changes save immediately to `~/.dsh/visual/settings.json`. ## Storage Cards are persisted per conversation and turn to `~/.dsh/visual/cards.json`, so they survive a restart. Retention is governed by the settings above. Deleting the directory only loses visual history; functionality is unaffected. ## Install **The built-in plugin installer is the recommended way.** Open Settings → Built-in Plugins, paste the package name, press install, then restart the app: ``` dsh-visual-card ``` The installer writes the entry into `dsh.profile.bundles` for you; no manual file edits. From the command line (quit the app completely first): ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-visual-card ``` Add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart the app. ## Security Scripts generated by the model **run inside the host page** — this is not a sandbox. That is the unavoidable cost of "clickable, can run games". The plugin only enforces "no external resources" and performs no code review. Fine for personal use; if you point it at model output you do not trust, add a sandbox first. ## Known limits - Cards always render **below** the turn's answer and cannot be placed mid-text: the host supports a fixed set of 19 conversation node kinds, and a plugin cannot add one - The `turnTail` slot only renders after the turn closes, so nothing appears while the answer is still streaming

plugins.description: KeePassXC-backed secret vault for DeepSeek Harness: store, rotate, list and use credentials without exposing them to the model context, with an optional interactive human confirmation before every credential use.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-secret-vault

A secret vault for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness),
backed by **KeePassXC**. It exposes a `vault_*` tool family to every session of a
profile so an agent can store, rotate, list and use credentials **without the
plaintext entering the model context** by default.

The database is protected by a **key file only**. No master password exists
anywhere: not in code, config, environment, argv, session logs or the model
context. Using an existing credential goes through an **interactive human
confirmation** by default, and a use that cannot be confirmed is denied
(fail-closed).

## Install

Works on Linux, macOS and WSL (the `vault_use` tool runs commands with
`/bin/bash`). Open a terminal and run:

```sh
# 1. pnpm, needed by `dsh plugin`
npm install -g pnpm

# 2. add the plugin to your `web` profile
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-secret-vault

# 3. restart the harness: the bundle layer is read at boot
#    stop `dsh web` (Ctrl+C) and start it again
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

If `dsh` is already installed globally, step 2 is
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-secret-vault`.

After the restart the `vault_*` tools are available to the agent. The first call
creates the vault directory, the key file and the database.

### What the install does

`dsh plugin add` runs pnpm in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/`, so the spec can be a
GitHub repo, a tarball, a local path or a registry name. Because this package
declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, the harness appends the plugin to the profile's
bundle list and the packaged `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the
`tool-secret-vault` row at every boot. Nothing else has to be enabled.

There is **no build step and no native dependency**: plain ESM using Node
built-ins plus the packages the harness already provides.

### Update and uninstall

```sh
# update: re-run the add command (it resolves the repo again), then restart
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-secret-vault   # uninstall, then restart
```

## Requirements

- **DeepSeek Harness** itself, e.g. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`.
- **KeePassXC 2.7 or newer**, with **`keepassxc-cli` on `PATH`** (or point
  `cliPath` at it). Tested with 2.7.10.
- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the range DeepSeek Harness supports).
- **pnpm** on `PATH` — installed in step 1 above.
- A POSIX shell (`/bin/bash`) for `vault_use`; on Windows use WSL.

KeePassXC is the only external program the plugin calls. If it is missing you
get `VAULT_CLI_MISSING`; install it or set `cliPath`. The package is plain ESM
plus a POSIX shell; it has been exercised on Linux with KeePassXC 2.7.10.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `vault_status` | Vault health: auth mode, number of credentials and groups, database name, directory |
| `vault_list` | Every stored credential path and every group (titles only, never values) |
| `vault_generate` | Create or rotate an entry with a strong password generated inside `keepassxc-cli` |
| `vault_store` | Store an existing credential; the value goes to the CLI over stdin |
| `vault_show` | Non-secret metadata of one entry: canonical path, username, whether a password is stored |
| `vault_reveal` | Return the plaintext of one entry — direct human turn + authorization dialog + audit reason; can be disabled |
| `vault_use` | Run one `bash -c` command with `VAULT_PASSWORD` and `VAULT_USERNAME` injected; secret occurrences in the output are redacted |
| `vault_delete` | Soft delete by default (KeePassXC Recycle Bin); `permanent: true` purges with a dated pre-purge snapshot |

Every `entry` argument accepts a **full group path** (`work/github`) or a **bare
title** (`github`). A bare title is resolved by searching every group except the
KeePassXC Recycle Bin; a unique match wins and an ambiguous match is refused with
the candidate paths, so nothing is guessed.

`vault_generate` sizes: 16 to 64 characters, default 26; `noSpecial` and
`excludeAmbiguous` are available for services with narrow password rules.

## Configuration

The plugin works with no configuration at all. Defaults:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `vaultDir` | `''` → `$DSH_HOME/vault` | Vault directory. `DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh` (from `os.homedir()`) |
| `dbName` | `secrets.kdbx` | Database file name inside `vaultDir` (no path separators) |
| `keyName` | `secrets.key` | Key file name inside `vaultDir` (no path separators) |
| `cliPath` | `keepassxc-cli` | Path or name of the KeePassXC CLI |
| `cliTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Timeout for one CLI call (2 s to 5 min) |
| `useTimeoutMs` | `180000` | Timeout for a `vault_use` command (2 s to 15 min) |
| `confirmTimeoutMs` | `180000` | How long the authorization dialog may stay unanswered before the use is denied; `0` removes the deadline (5 s to 15 min) |
| `requireConfirmation` | `true` | Interactive human confirmation before using an existing credential |
| `allowReveal` | `true` | Allow `vault_reveal` at all |
| `binGroup` | `Recycle Bin` | Name of the KeePassXC recycle-bin group (change it for a database created in another language) |

To change a value, override the row by **id** in the profile's
`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`. A patch **replaces the whole config**, so
restate every key you keep:

```yaml
- id: tool-secret-vault
  config:
    vaultDir: '/path/to/your/vault'   # or omit it to use $DSH_HOME/vault
    dbName: 'secrets.kdbx'
    keyName: 'secrets.key'
    cliPath: 'keepassxc-cli'
    cliTimeoutMs: 30000
    useTimeoutMs: 180000
    confirmTimeoutMs: 180000
    requireConfirmation: true
    allowReveal: true
    binGroup: 'Recycle Bin'
```

### Vault layout and groups

The vault is an **arbitrary KeePassXC group tree**. The plugin never creates or
assumes group names: whatever groups your database has are the ones
`vault_list` reports, and an entry path is just `group/subgroup/title`.

Create groups in the KeePassXC GUI before storing below them (the CLI `add` does
not create missing groups). A bare title with no `/` lands in the root group, so
a fresh vault is usable immediately. Titles may repeat across groups: a bare
title that matches more than one entry is refused with the candidate paths, and
the full path picks one. Everything under the recycle-bin group (`binGroup`,
default `Recycle Bin`) is hidden from `vault_list` and from title search.

### Database and key file

The plugin expects a **key-file-only** KeePassXC database. On first use it
creates `secrets.kdbx` plus a 64-byte random `secrets.key` in `vaultDir`, both
mode `0600` inside a `0700` directory, and opens the database with
`--no-password --key-file`.

To use an **existing** KeePassXC database, make sure it authenticates with a key
file only (`Database → Database Settings → Security` in the KeePassXC GUI), then
point `vaultDir`/`dbName`/`keyName` at the pair. A database that also needs a
master password is not supported by the CLI flow of this plugin.

To inspect or edit the vault by hand, open it in the KeePassXC GUI
(`Database → Open…`) and select the key file. Do that **while the harness is not
writing**: `keepassxc-cli` and the desktop app do not coordinate locks, and
saving from the GUI can overwrite a concurrent write.

**Back up both files together.** They only work as a pair; losing either one
means losing the vault, and there is no master password to recover it. Keep the
copy outside `vaultDir`.

## Security model

- **Key file only.** No master password is stored, passed, or handled. The key
  file is 64 random bytes created by the plugin with mode `0600` inside a `0700`
  directory. Permissions are re-enforced on every operation.
- **Secrets stay out of the model context by default.** `vault_generate` creates
  the password inside `keepassxc-cli`; `vault_store` sends the value over stdin;
  `vault_use` injects it into the child environment and redacts every occurrence
  from captured stdout/stderr. None of these return the value.
- **`vault_reveal` is the only deliberate plaintext path.** It needs a reason,
  a direct human turn on the top-level session agent (subagents, background jobs
  and autonomous continuat

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 用量统计插件：侧边栏今日用量卡片、当前对话 token 数、按供应商与模型的明细、账户余额与套餐额度、余量提醒、历史用量补录。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-usage-stat · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 用量统计、账户余额与套餐监控插件 [English](README.en.md) | 中文

   

给 DSH Web GUI 与桌面客户端的 Token 用量台账、账户余额与编程套餐监控
侧边栏用量卡 · 本次对话明细 · 时间范围驱动的用量页 · 余额与套餐 · 余量提醒 · 历史补录

它把每一次模型调用的 token 用量记成一份按「本地日期 / 供应商 / 模型」分桶的账本，再把同一份数据放在三个地方显示：侧边栏左下角的用量卡、输入框下方那枚「本次对话」胶囊、设置里的「用量统计」页。除了用量，它还会查询供应商的账户余额与编程套餐剩余额度，并在余量偏低时标出提醒。 数据只有两个来源：DSH 自己的会话事件（用量）和供应商自己的接口（余额与套餐）。余额与套餐**不做任何本地估算** —— 查不到就写明原因，不猜一个数字出来。 ## 界面 > 下面是 `tools/preview.mjs` 用**插件自己的组件**渲染出来的截图，不是应用截图：把样式表逐字注入，套在一个设置对话框外壳的替身里，颜色取自正在运行的 DSH 主题变量。主题色跟随皮肤变化，这里是原生主题。 | 位置 | 形态 | |---|---| | 侧边栏左下角 | 折叠时一行「今日用量 + 总量」，点开列出各供应商与模型；余量偏低时在对应供应商前点一个红点 | | 输入框下方 | 一枚「本次对话 N tokens」胶囊，点开是这段对话自己的分供应商、分模型明细 | | 设置 → 用量统计 | 三个标签页：用量、账户、设置 |

     

点开可看原尺寸

## 功能 - **用量页**：一排等宽分栏的合计（总 tokens / 输入 / 输出 / 缓存读 / 调用次数，缓存写只在窗口内真的出现过时才占一格）、按供应商与模型的明细、以及覆盖整个所选窗口的每日柱状图。顶部可切换统计范围：今天、近 7 天、近 30 天、全部，或自选起止日期。所有卡片都跟随所选范围，供应商占比条全页共用一个刻度。 - **账户页**：每个供应商的账户余额与套餐窗口合在一处 —— 余额按币种显示，套餐显示 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月窗口的已用百分比与重置时间。查不到数据的供应商折叠在卡片最下面，并写明原因（未配置 API Key、已用账号登录、非官方地址、该供应商没有提供这项数据）。 - **设置页**：用量刷新间隔、账户查询开关与间隔、余量提醒阈值，以及底部的版本号与历史补录状态。 - **余量提醒**：给余额和三个套餐窗口各设一个阈值，低于阈值时在对应供应商旁点一个红点（左下角卡片与账户页都有）。阈值填 0 表示那一项不提醒。判定发生在读取时，所以改完立刻生效。 - **历史补录**：插件只记录它运行期间的用量。首次启用时会自动把 DSH 已经保存在磁盘上的过往会话补进来；中间关过插件的话，可以在设置页手动再补一次。补录按调用发生的那一天入账，不会算成今天。 ### 柱状图的纵轴 纵轴是**相对的**：所选窗口里用量最重的那天就是满格。绝对刻度会把安静的一周压成一条看不见的线，而相对刻度让你一眼看出形状；卡片右上角会写出这个锚点（例如「最高 33.3M（10-17）」），把鼠标停在柱子上能看到当天的总量与调用次数。 ## 安装 要求 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高，Web GUI 与官方桌面客户端都可以。 从 GitHub 安装： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/SereneJi/dsh-usage-stat.git ``` 从本地克隆安装（源码即产物，改完刷新页面就生效，适合自己改）： ```bash git clone https://github.com/SereneJi/dsh-usage-stat.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:./dsh-usage-stat ``` `--profile` 填你在用的 profile 名（桌面客户端是 `desktop`，`dsh web` 一般是 `web`）。 宿主端改动需要重启一次 DSH；此后的界面改动刷新页面即可。设置入口在 **设置 → 用量统计**。 卸载： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-usage-stat ``` ## 配置 设置页里的每一项都对应 `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/config.json` 里的一个键（`$DSH_HOME` 默认是 `~/.dsh`）。 | 键 | 默认 | 含义 | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；关掉后不记账、不探测、界面消失 | | `pollIntervalSec` | `60` | 界面刷新用量的间隔（5–600 秒） | | `probeEnabled` | `true` | 是否查询供应商余额与套餐 | | `probeIntervalSec` | `300` | 余额与套餐的查询间隔（60–3600 秒） | | `alertEnabled` | `true` | 余量提醒总开关 | | `alertBalanceBelow` | `0` | 余额低于这个金额时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindow5h` | `0` | 5 小时窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindowWeek` | `0` | 本周窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindowMonth` | `0` | 本月窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | 记账是本地且廉价的，查询供应商要出门、可能被限流，所以两者有各自独立的开关和周期：关掉 `probeEnabled` 之后用量照常统计，只是余额与套餐不再刷新。 提醒判定用的是「**低于**」：余额刚好等于阈值、或窗口刚好还剩阈值那么多，都**不算**命中。提醒也只在真的有数字可读时出现 —— 没有凭据、查不到余额、窗口没有百分比的供应商不会被点红点。 超出范围的值会被夹到边界，不认识的键会被忽略，手改文件不会把插件弄进界面表达不出的状态。 ## 数据放在哪 | 路径 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/usage.json` | 用量账本 | | `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/providers.json` | 余额与套餐快照 | | `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/config.json` | 配置 | 账本**刻意不设时间与体积上限**。一天一个日期桶在 1 KB 量级，一年也就几百 KB，而任何「只保留 N 天」「超过 N KB 就删」的规则都只会在某一天悄悄丢掉你本来看得到的历史。唯一剩下的上限是会话行的条数（5000），那是防止文件被跑坏的兜底，不是预算。 供应商的 API Key 由 DSH 自己的凭据服务保管，只被宿主端读取，**不会进入浏览器**。 ## 已知限制 - **历史补录只能补回 DSH 日志还在的会话**：日志被删掉的、或在别的工作区里已经清掉的，补不回来。没有序号的事件会被跳过 —— 一个无法与已计过的调用区分开的事件，宁可漏记也不重复计数。补录是一次性的书签，不是持续订阅：日志在插件运行期间仍在增长，那部分由实时事件负责。 - **余额与套餐只覆盖已知端点的供应商**（余额 9 条路由、套餐 8 条）。其余供应商会写「该供应商没有提供这项数据」，不会用本地 token 数折算成钱。 - **余额需要能读到的 API Key**。用账号登录的供应商（例如桌面端的 DeepSeek 账号）不一定提供开放平台的余额接口，界面会如实说明。 - **只统计 token，不做成本估算**：没有价目表，也不把 token 折算成钱。 - **余量提醒是界面上的标记，不是系统通知**：它只出现在左下角卡片与账户页，不会弹窗、不发声。 - **「本次对话」的分供应商明细只对启用之后的对话有效**：更早的对话只留下总量，这时面板会写明「只有总量记录」，而不是把总量算到某个供应商头上。 - **界面文案是插件自带的 zh/en 两套**，按浏览器语言选一次，不跟随 DSH 设置里切换语言。 - 侧边栏卡片依赖 DSH 侧边栏的 DOM 结构，落位失败会退化成「追加到侧边栏底部」，不会崩 —— 这是 DOM 注入的固有代价。 ## 许可证与来源 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 界面布局的灵感来自 [`@linxin666/dsh-usage`](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web)（Apache-2.0）。 ## 开发 面向维护者的内容 —— 数据来源与折叠语义、HTTP 接口、代码结构、设计取舍、测试与预览台、回退与升级路径 —— 都在 [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md)。
